title: Nagaland Temple Recipes
tagline: 62 sattvic recipes for institutional cooking, written for ISKCON Bangalore

recipes.name: Naga Black Tea
recipes.sub: Black tea with ginger, no milk
recipes.sub_l: Aduwa diya kala chah, gakhir nai

method.en: There is no dairy tradition in these hills, so tea here is drunk black. A milk tea is a plains habit and it is worth knowing the difference before deciding a menu.
method.l: Ei pahar te gakhir laga niyom nai, etu karone chah kala khai. Gakhir laga chah plains laga obhyas ase, menu thik kora age etu jani lobi.

method.en: Bruise the ginger hard with the back of a knife rather than grating it. Grated ginger clouds the tea and has to be strained twice.
method.l: Aduwa ke ghohi nokori churi laga pichote diya joreke bhangai lobi. Ghosa aduwa chah ke ghula kore aru duibar chalibo lage.

method.en: Boil the ginger and bruised lemongrass in the water for ten minutes before the tea goes anywhere near it.
method.l: Chah pata halu age, aduwa aru lemon ghas pani te dohh minute uthabi.

method.en: Take the vessel off the fire, then add the tea leaves and steep four minutes. Tea boiled with the leaves in turns bitter and no sugar covers it.
method.l: Bortan ke jui pora namai lobi, titia chah pata halibi aru sari minute rakhibi. Pata logote uthaise koile chah tita hoi jai aru chini pora bhi dhakibo napare.

method.en: Strain at once. Leaves left in the pot go on brewing and the last cup is nothing like the first.
method.l: Loge loge chalibi. Pata bhitorte thakise koile bonai thake aru hekh laga cup prothom logote eke nohoi.

method.en: Keep it in an insulated urn rather than over a flame, and sweeten at the counter — many here drink it without sugar.
method.l: Jui uporte narakhi thermos te rakhibi, aru chini mez te halibi — bisi manu chini nohoile khai.

recipes.why: Black, not milky, and off the fire before the leaves go in. Two things, and both are about not making it bitter.
recipes.why_l: Kala, gakhir nai, aru pata halu age jui bondh. Duita kotha, aru duiyo tita nohobole nimite.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Start twenty-five minutes before serving.
start.l: Eku bhijai nalage. Diya age 25 minute suru koribi.

vessel.en: A 30 L vessel and a strainer. One cook.
vessel.l: 30 L laga bortan aru chalni. Ekjon randhoni.

season.en: All year, and drunk at every hour of the day.
season.l: Pura bosor, din bhitor hodai somoi khai.

recipes.name: Passion Fruit Cooler
recipes.sub: Passion fruit with honey and lime
recipes.sub_l: Mou aru kaji nemu diya passion phol

method.en: Passion fruit grows half-wild across Nagaland and in season it costs almost nothing. This drink is worth making only in those five months.
method.l: Passion phol Nagaland te adha jongoli hoi bare aru mowsom te iyar dam eku nai. Ei pani khali etu pans mahina te bonabole thik ase.

method.en: Halve the fruit and scoop the pulp with the seeds into a bowl. Do not press it through a sieve yet.
method.l: Phol ke duita kori kati, guti logote gudi bati te ulai lobi. Etiya loi chalni te nadhakibi.

method.en: Rub the pulp gently against the sieve with the fingers to release the juice, then discard the seeds.
method.l: Angul pora gudi ke chalni te aste ghohi rosh ulabi, titia guti pheliya dibi.

method.en: Do not crush the seeds. A crushed passion fruit seed is bitter and one pressing too hard spoils the whole drum.
method.l: Guti ke nabhangabi. Bhanga passion guti tita hoi, aru ekbar bisi jor lagaile pura drum kharab hoi.

method.en: Dissolve the sugar in warm water first and cool it completely before the pulp goes in. Sugar stirred into cold juice settles at the bottom.
method.l: Chini prothom gorom pani te galai pura thanda koribi, titia gudi halibi. Thanda rosh te dise koile chini tolote boi jai.

method.en: Add lemon and black salt at the counter, not in the kitchen. Passion fruit is already sour and the balance shifts as it stands.
method.l: Kaji nemu aru kala nimik mez te halibi, rondhon ghor te nohoi. Passion phol nijei tenga ase aru rakhile swad bodli jai.

recipes.why: A fruit that costs nothing for five months of the year. Do not crush the seeds and there is nothing else to it.
recipes.why_l: Ek phol jun pans mahina eku dam nai. Guti nabhangale iyate aru eku nai.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Make the syrup an hour ahead and hold it cold.
start.l: Eku bhijai nalage. Ek ghonta age syrup bonai thanda rakhibi.

vessel.en: A 30 L drum, a strainer and a bowl. One cook.
vessel.l: 30 L laga drum, chalni aru bati. Ekjon randhoni.

season.en: June to October, when the vines are fruiting across the hills.
season.l: June pora October loi, jetia pahar te lota te phol dhore.

recipes.name: Tree Tomato Cooler
recipes.sub: Tamarillo with honey and chilli salt
recipes.sub_l: Mou aru jhaal nimik diya gash bilahi

method.en: Tree tomato is not a tomato and does not behave like one. It is a hill fruit, sharply sour, and it is at its best from October.
method.l: Gash bilahi bilahi nohoi aru bilahi nisina nakore. Etu pahar laga phol ase, bisi tenga, aru October pora iyar somoi bhal ase.

method.en: Drop the fruit into boiling water for one minute, then into cold water. The skin slips off in one piece after that.
method.l: Phol ke ek minute gorom pani te dhali, titia thanda pani te. Etu pichote chal ekbarte ulai jai.

method.en: The skin must come off. Left on it is genuinely bitter and no amount of sugar will hide it.
method.l: Chal ulabo he lage. Thakise koile etu bisi tita ase aru kiman chini dile bhi dhakibo napare.

method.en: Press the peeled pulp through a sieve, keeping the seeds out.
method.l: Chal chula gudi ke chalni te dhaki, guti bahar rakhibi.

method.en: Dissolve the sugar in warm water and cool it completely before the pulp goes in.
method.l: Chini gorom pani te galai pura thanda koribi, titia gudi halibi.

method.en: Use no more than ten grams of dried king chilli in twenty-two litres, ground fine and stirred in at the end. It is there for the warmth behind the sourness, not for heat.
method.l: Baish litre te dohh gram pora bisi sukha raja mircha nalagabi, misi kori pisi hekh te milabi. Etu tengar pichote gorom lagibole nimite ase, jhaal nimite nohoi.

recipes.why: The one cold drink available in a Naga winter, and peeling the fruit is the only step that decides it.
recipes.why_l: Naga jaar somoi te thaka ekmatra thanda pani, aru chal chula he sob thik kore.

start.en: Blanch and peel the fruit an hour ahead. Start ninety minutes before serving.
start.l: Ek ghonta age phol ke gorom pani te dhali chal chulai lobi. Diya age dhur ghonta suru koribi.

vessel.en: A 30 L drum and a strainer. One cook.
vessel.l: 30 L laga drum aru chalni. Ekjon randhoni.

season.en: October to February, when the tree tomato is on.
season.l: October pora February loi, jetia gash bilahi hoi.

recipes.name: Ginger Tea
recipes.sub: Black tea boiled with a great deal of bruised ginger
recipes.sub_l: Bahut ada thecha diya kala chah

method.en: Bruise the ada with a stone and do not grate it. A grated ginger clouds twenty-five litres and the urn has to be strained twice.
method.l: Ada to pathor loi thecha dibi, kasi nadibi. Kasi diya ada pora 25 litre ke ghula kore dibo aru bela to duibar chani lage.

method.en: Boil the water and the ginger together fifteen minutes before the tea leaf goes in. Ginger put in with the leaf gives colour and no heat.
method.l: Chah pata hala nadi kene pani aru ada ke pandhra minute eke logote ukhalibi. Pata logote diya ada pora rong dibo, jhaal nadibo.

method.en: Four minutes on the leaf and no longer. A Naga chah boiled ten minutes is bitter and four hundred grams of leaf is wasted.
method.l: Pata upor te sari minute mattro, tatu bisi nai. Dosh minute ukhalise Naga chah to tita hoi jai aru sari sou gram pata nasto hoi.

method.en: Jaggery and not sugar. In Kohima the bazar gur is forty rupees a kilo against sixty for sugar, and it carries the ginger better.
method.l: Gur, chini nohoi. Kohima bazar te gur to kilo te chalis taka aru chini to sathi; aru gur pora ada ke bhal kore dhoribo pare.

recipes.why: Three rupees eighty a head, and the ginger is most of it. It is the tea a Naga kitchen makes on a borokhun morning when the hall is cold and wet.
recipes.why_l: Ek manu te tin taka assi, aru ada he bisi khoros. Borokhun din laga bhorete, hall thanda aru bhijise homoi te, Naga rasoi te banai diya chah to eitu he.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Thirty minutes from a cold stove.
start.l: Kunu saman bhijai rakha nalage. Thanda chula pora tirish minute.

vessel.en: A 30 L vessel and a straining cloth. One cook.
vessel.l: Tirish litre laga bela aru chani bole kapor. Ekjon randhoni.

season.en: All year, and every morning in borokhun.
season.l: Pura bochor, aru borokhun din te bhore bhore.

recipes.name: Milk Tea
recipes.sub: Black tea boiled with milk and a bruised cardamom
recipes.sub_l: Gakhir aru elaichi thecha diya kala chah

method.en: Boil the water and the leaf first and the milk after. Milk from the start with five hundred grams of leaf gives a vessel the colour of a wall.
method.l: Poila pani aru pata ukhalibi, pasote gakhir dibi. Suru pora gakhir aru pas sou gram pata dile bela laga rong to bera laga rong hoi jai.

method.en: Bruise the elaichi and do not powder it. A powdered cardamom gives everything in the first minute and the last glasses have nothing.
method.l: Elaichi to thecha dibi, gura nakoribi. Gura kora elaichi pora poila minute te sob dibo aru hekh laga glass te kiba nathakibo.

method.en: Four minutes on the boil after the milk and no longer. A tea boiled ten minutes is bitter and nine litres of milk is wasted in it.
method.l: Gakhir diya pasote sari minute ukhalibi, tatu bisi nai. Dosh minute ukhalise chah to tita hoi jai aru no litre gakhir tate nasto hoi.

method.en: Strain it into the counter urn and not into glasses. Tea standing on the leaf goes bitter in twenty minutes however good it was.
method.l: Glass te nohoi, dibole laga bela te chani dibi. Pata upor te thaka chah to kotona bhal hoilebi bis minute te tita hoi jai.

recipes.why: Eleven rupees ninety a head. It is the tea a Naga kitchen is judged by; a Hornbill morning without it is remembered for the wrong reason.
recipes.why_l: Ek manu te egaro taka nobbei. Naga rasoi ke manu pora eitu chah loi jokha kore; Hornbill laga bhore te eitu nathakile bhul karone manu pora monte rakhe.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Forty minutes from a cold stove.
start.l: Kunu saman bhijai rakha nalage. Thanda chula pora chalis minute.

vessel.en: A 30 L vessel, a strainer and a counter urn. One cook.
vessel.l: Tirish litre laga bela, chani aru dibole laga bela. Ekjon randhoni.

season.en: All year, and at Hornbill and Sekrenyi above all.
season.l: Pura bochor, aru Hornbill aru Sekrenyi te bisi kori.

recipes.name: Banana Milk Cooler
recipes.name_l: Kol aru gakhir laga thanda pani
recipes.sub: Ripe banana crushed cold into milk with jaggery
recipes.sub_l: Pakise kol ke gur logote thanda gakhir te thecha diya

method.en: Crush the kol by hand and never in a blender. A blended banana holds air and twenty-two litres froths over the rim of the urn.
method.l: Kol to hath loi thecha dibi, blender te nokoribi. Blender te kora kol pora bhitorte hawa dhore aru 22 litre to bela laga mukh pora ulai jai.

method.en: Boil the milk and let it go completely cold before the banana. Warm milk on a ripe kol turns the whole urn sour in an hour.
method.l: Gakhir to ukhalibi aru kol nadi kene puri thanda hobole dibi. Pakise kol upor te gorom gakhir dile ek ghanta te pura bela to tenga hoi jai.

method.en: Melt the gur in the four litres of water and strain it. Field jaggery carries sand and grit in a drink is what is remembered of it.
method.l: Gur to sari litre pani te gola kene chani dibi. Kheti laga gur te balu thake aru pani laga saman te balu thakile manu pora eitu he monte rakhe.

method.en: Mix it at the counter and not in the kitchen. A banana cooler standing an hour separates and no stirring brings it back.
method.l: Rasoi te nohoi, dibole laga jagate mila dibi. Ek ghanta thakile kol laga pani to alag hoi jai aru kotona ghurale bi wapas nahe.

recipes.why: Fourteen rupees ninety a head. In Peren the kol is on every cart at twenty rupees a kilo and eight kilos does a hundred glasses.
recipes.why_l: Ek manu te souda taka nobbei. Peren te kol to gari khan te kilo te bis taka, aru ath kilo pora ek sou glass hoi.

start.en: The milk boils and cools two hours ahead. Crush the banana at the counter.
start.l: Gakhir to dui ghanta age te ukhali kene thanda kori rakhibi. Kol to dibole laga jagate thecha dibi.

vessel.en: A boiling pot, a cooling tray and a 30 L urn. Two cooks.
vessel.l: Ukhalibole bela, thanda koribole tray aru tirish litre bela. Duijon randhoni.

season.en: All year, and cheapest in borokhun.
season.l: Pura bochor, aru borokhun din te sobse sosta.

recipes.name: Tamarind Cooler
recipes.sub: Tamarind soaked cold, strained and sweetened with black salt
recipes.sub_l: Teteli ke thanda pani te bhijai, chani kene kala nimok diya

method.en: Soak the teteli in cold water two hours and work it with the hand. Boiled tamarind turns the colour of a wet road and the urn is brown.
method.l: Teteli to thanda pani te dui ghanta bhijai kene hath loi mosalibi. Ukhalise teteli laga rong to bhija rasta nisina hoi aru bela to mati rong hoi.

method.en: Strain it through two cloths and press the pulp. One cloth leaves a fibre that sits on the tongue and every glass comes back.
method.l: Duitta kapor loi chani kene tar sansh to sipi dibi. Ek kapor pora jibha te bohi thaka tantu chari diye aru glass sob wapas ahe.

method.en: Black salt and not white. A teteli pani without it is flat and half the hall leaves the glass standing.
method.l: Kala nimok, boga nimok nohoi. Eitu nathakile teteli pani to swad nathaka hoi aru hall laga adha manu pora glass to rakhi diye.

method.en: Serve it cold. Warm, a teteli pani tastes of the pot and in gorom din the hall is at thirty degrees and nobody will take a warm glass.
method.l: Thanda kori kene dibi. Gorom hoile teteli pani to bela laga swad hoi, aru gorom din te hall to tirish degree thake aru kunbi gorom glass nolobo.

recipes.why: Four rupees ninety a head, no fire under it at all. Two kilos of teteli gives a hundred glasses and a Dimapur tree drops more than the kitchen can use.
recipes.why_l: Ek manu te sari taka nobbei, tar tolote jui eku nai. Dui kilo teteli pora ek sou glass hoi, aru Dimapur laga ekta gos pora rasoi te labhoi pora bi bisi phol pore.

start.en: Tamarind soaks two hours in cold water. Nothing cooks.
start.l: Teteli to thanda pani te dui ghanta bhijai. Kiba randha nalage.

vessel.en: A soaking tub, two straining cloths and a 30 L urn. One cook.
vessel.l: Bhijai rakhibole bela, chani bole duitta kapor aru tirish litre bela. Ekjon randhoni.

season.en: Gorom din to borokhun, and on any day above thirty degrees.
season.l: Gorom din pora borokhun tak, aru tirish degree upor laga din khan te.

recipes.name: Rice Water
recipes.sub: The water off boiled rice, salted and drunk warm
recipes.sub_l: Bhat ukhala pani, nimok diya, gorom thaka homoi te khabole

method.en: Wash the chaul twice only and keep the second water. The starch that a third wash takes away is the whole drink.
method.l: Chaul to duibar mattro dhuibi aru duita number pani to rakhibi. Tinita number dhuwa pora ulai juwa mar to eitu pani laga sob he.

method.en: Boil three kilos of rice in twenty-eight litres and drain the water off at twelve minutes. The rice goes to the next vessel and only the water is drunk.
method.l: Tin kilo chaul ke athais litre te ukhali kene baro minute te pani to jhari dibi. Bhat to dusra bela te jai aru pani he khai.

method.en: Bruise the ada and drop it in whole, then take it out. Grated ginger clouds the drink and a chaul pani should be looked through.
method.l: Ada to thecha kene pura hi hala dibi, pasote ulai anibi. Kasi diya ada pora pani ke ghula kore aru chaul pani to par dekha jabole lage.

method.en: Serve it warm within the hour. A chaul pani gone cold sets to a jelly and twenty-five litres of it cannot be given away.
method.l: Ek ghanta bhitorte gorom kori kene dibi. Thanda hoi juwa chaul pani to jam hoi jai aru 25 litre ke kunke bi dibole napare.

recipes.why: One rupee twenty a head, the cheapest thing in this book. The rice is not lost — it goes into the next vessel — so all this drink costs is the ginger and the salt.
recipes.why_l: Ek manu te ek taka bis, eitu boi te sobse sosta. Bhat to nasto nohoi — dusra bela te jai — karone eitu pani laga khoros to ada aru nimok mattro.

start.en: Nothing soaks. It comes off the rice vessel at noon.
start.l: Kunu saman bhijai rakha nalage. Dupor te bhat laga bela pora ulai.

vessel.en: The rice vessel, a draining basket and a 30 L urn. No extra cook.
vessel.l: Bhat laga bela, pani jharibole tukri aru tirish litre bela. Aru randhoni nalage.

season.en: All year, and every day in thanda din.
season.l: Pura bochor, aru thanda din te din din.

recipes.name: Sticky Rice in Leaf
recipes.name_l: Pata te bhap diya chipchipe bhat
recipes.sub: Glutinous rice steamed in banana leaf
recipes.sub_l: Kol pata te bhap diya chipchipe bhat

method.en: Soak the sticky rice at least six hours. Unlike ordinary rice it will not soften in the steamer, and a short soak gives a hard centre that no amount of steaming fixes.
method.l: Chipchipe chaul komti kori choi ghonta bhijabi. Sadharon chaul nisina etu bhap te norom nohoi, aru komti bhijaile majote tan thake aru kiman bhap dile bhi thik nohoi.

method.en: Pass the banana leaves over an open flame until they turn glossy and go limp. Unheated leaves crack along the fold and the parcel opens in the steamer.
method.l: Kol pata ke jui uporte ghurai chikna aru norom nohua loi rakhibi. Nagorom kora pata bhaj te phati jai aru pura bhap bhitorte khuli jai.

method.en: Roast the sesame on a dry pan until it pops, cool it, and crush it coarsely with the salt.
method.l: Til ke sukha bortan te photka loi bhaji, thanda kori, nimok logote dhala kori bhangabi.

method.en: Drain the rice thoroughly, mix the sesame through, and fill each leaf loosely — no more than two-thirds full.
method.l: Chaul bhal kori pani ulai, til milai, aru pata te dhila kori bhorabi — dui bhag pora bisi nohoi.

method.en: Loosely, not tightly. Sticky rice swells hard in the steamer and a full parcel bursts its leaf and comes out a solid brick.
method.l: Dhila kori, tan nohoi. Chipchipe chaul bhap te bisi phule aru bhorti pura pata phatai dei aru tan hoi ulai.

method.en: Fold, tie with a strip of leaf, and steam forty minutes. They keep a full day without refrigeration, which is why they exist.
method.l: Bhaj kori, pata laga pati pora bandhi, salish minute bhap dibi. Fridge nohoile bhi pura ek din thake, etu karone he etu ase.

recipes.why: Keeps a day in its own wrapper with no vessel and no reheating. Nothing else in this set travels like it.
recipes.why_l: Nijor pata bhitorte ek din thake, bortan nalage aru gorom nokoribo lage. Ei kitab te aru eku eneka safar nakore.

start.en: Soak the sticky rice six hours — overnight is better. Start two hours before serving.
start.l: Chipchipe chaul choi ghonta bhijabi — rati bhor bhal. Diya age dui ghonta suru koribi.

vessel.en: Three large steamers and a stack of banana leaves. Four cooks — wrapping is the bottleneck.
vessel.l: Tinta dangor bhap laga bortan aru kol pata. Sarijon randhoni — bandha he deri hoi.

season.en: All year. What a field hand carries out at dawn.
season.l: Pura bosor. Kheti manu bhorte loi juwa saman.

recipes.name: Rice Flour Steamed Cake
recipes.sub: Plain steamed rice cake
recipes.sub_l: Sadharon bhap diya chaul pitha

method.en: Soak both rices together five hours and grind to a smooth batter, thick enough to drop slowly from a ladle.
method.l: Duita chaul eke logote pans ghonta bhijai, misi ghol pisibi, jun hatai pora aste porile.

method.en: The kilo of sticky rice in eight is what holds the cake together. All plain rice gives a cake that crumbles as it is lifted.
method.l: Ath te ek kilo chipchipe chaul he pitha ke dhori rakhe. Khali sadharon chaul dile pitha uthaite bhangi jai.

method.en: Leave the batter overnight in a warm corner. It sours slightly and that slight sour is the whole character of the cake.
method.l: Ghol ke rati bhor gorom kunate rakhibi. Etu olop tenga hoi aru etu olop tenga he pitha laga asol swad ase.

method.en: Do not let it go past a night. Over-soured batter gives a cake that smells sharp and nobody eats a second one.
method.l: Ek rati pora bisi nadibi. Bisi tenga hoile pitha tita gundh hoi aru kunei dusra nakhai.

method.en: Stir in the roasted sesame and salt, pour into greased flat trays, and steam twenty minutes.
method.l: Bhaja til aru nimok milai, tel lagai rakha tray te dhali, kudi minute bhap dibi.

method.en: Test with a skewer before cutting, and let the cake cool ten minutes in the tray. Cut hot it tears along every line.
method.l: Kata age ek kathi pora sai lobi, aru pitha ke tray te dohh minute thanda hobo dibi. Gorom katile hodai jagate phati jai.

recipes.why: One overnight ferment and twenty minutes of steam. No oil at all, which is true of most of this book.
recipes.why_l: Ek rati laga khomir aru kudi minute bhap. Eku tel nai, jun ei kitab laga bisi bhag te thik ase.

start.en: Grind the soaked rice the night before and let the batter stand. Start ninety minutes before serving.
start.l: Bhija chaul rati age pisibi aru ghol rakhibi. Diya age dhur ghonta suru koribi.

vessel.en: Three steamers with flat trays. Three cooks.
vessel.l: Tinta bhap bortan aru samatal tray. Tinjon randhoni.

season.en: All year.
season.l: Pura bosor.

recipes.name: Boiled Tubers with Chilli Salt
recipes.sub: Colocasia, yam and sweet potato, boiled
recipes.sub_l: Kacchu, sweet potato aru yam, siddha

method.en: This is the plainest thing in the book and it is what a Naga household eats before daylight. Nothing is fried and nothing is spiced.
method.l: Ei kitab te iman sadharon eku nai aru Naga ghor te puwa age etu he khai. Eku bhaja nai aru eku masala nai.

method.en: Boil each tuber separately. Colocasia, yam and sweet potato cook at quite different rates and together the sweet potato is mush before the yam is done.
method.l: Hodai kacchu alag kori siddha koribi. Kacchu, yam aru mitha alu alag somoi loi, aru eke logote yam siddha nohua age mitha alu gali jai.

method.en: Handle raw colocasia with oiled hands or cloth. The raw sap makes the palms itch badly and it does not wash off easily.
method.l: Kacha kacchu ke tel lagai hath pora nohoile kapor pora dhoribi. Kacha rosh pora hath bisi khujli kore aru sohoje nadhui.

method.en: Boil the colocasia with the skin on and peel it after. Peeled raw it goes slimy in the water.
method.l: Kacchu ke chal logote siddha kori, pichote chal chulabi. Kacha chal chulaile pani te lasa hoi jai.

method.en: Roast the sesame, cool it, and pound it with the salt and a very small quantity of dried king chilli into a dry dip.
method.l: Til bhaji, thanda kori, nimok aru bisi olop sukha raja mircha logote sukha chutney bonabi.

method.en: Serve the tubers whole and hot with the chilli salt beside them. Nothing is mashed and nothing is dressed.
method.l: Kacchu ke pura aru gorom, jhaal nimok logote dibi. Eku nadhorbi aru eku nalagabi.

recipes.why: No oil, no vessel to scrub, and it is what the hills actually eat at dawn. The cheapest breakfast in this set.
recipes.why_l: Eku tel nai, bortan majibole nai, aru pahar te bhorte etu he khai. Ei kitab laga sob pora sosta bhorer khana.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Start fifty minutes before serving.
start.l: Eku bhijai nalage. Diya age pochas minute suru koribi.

vessel.en: Two 40 L vessels. One cook.
vessel.l: Duita 40 L bortan. Ekjon randhoni.

season.en: October to March, when the tubers come out of the ground.
season.l: October pora March loi, jetia mati pora kacchu ulai.

recipes.name: Perilla Rice Porridge
recipes.sub: Rice porridge with ground perilla seed
recipes.sub_l: Pisa nakhup diya bhat laga jaul

method.en: Perilla seed — nakhup — is the Naga equivalent of sesame and it is used far more here than anywhere else in India.
method.l: Nakhup, mane perilla guti, Naga manu laga til nisina ase aru India laga aru kunba jaga pora iyate bisi cholai.

method.en: Roast the seed on a dry pan on the lowest flame until it begins to pop, then take it off at once.
method.l: Guti ke sukha bortan te bisi dhimai jui te photka suru nohua loi bhaji, titia loge loge namai lobi.

method.en: Perilla burns faster than sesame — about twenty seconds separates roasted from ruined — and burnt perilla is bitter right through.
method.l: Nakhup til pora joldi jole — bhaja aru pura kharab hua majote kudi second he ase — aru jola nakhup bhitorte tita hoi.

method.en: Cool completely and grind coarse, not fine. Ground fine the seed releases its oil and turns to a paste that will not mix in.
method.l: Pura thanda kori dhala kori pisibi, misi nohoi. Misi pisile guti tel ulai aru lasa hoi jai jun milibo napare.

method.en: Cook the rice with plenty of water until the grains have burst completely — this is a porridge, not a khichdi, and it should pour.
method.l: Chaul ke bisi pani logote dana phata loi siddha koribi — etu jaul ase, khichdi nohoi, aru dhalibo lage.

method.en: Stir the ground perilla in only in the last five minutes, with the ginger and salt. Cooked longer it goes flat and slightly bitter.
method.l: Pisa nakhup ke hekh laga pans minute te he halibi, aduwa aru nimok logote. Bisi rondhile etu fika aru olop tita hoi jai.

recipes.why: Perilla is what this state has instead of dairy — the fat and the body come from a seed. Roast it carefully or not at all.
recipes.why_l: Gakhir laga bodli te ei rajya te nakhup ase — tel aru gadha etu guti pora ahe. Bhal kori bhajibi nohoile eku nokoribi.

start.en: Roast and grind the perilla the day before. Start fifty minutes before serving.
start.l: Nakhup ek din age bhaji pisibi. Diya age pochas minute suru koribi.

vessel.en: A heavy 40 L vessel. One cook who stays with it.
vessel.l: Bhari 40 L bortan. Ekjon randhoni jun logote thake.

season.en: All year, and given to anyone who is unwell.
season.l: Pura bosor, aru bemar manu ke etu he dei.

recipes.name: Steamed Sweetcorn
recipes.sub: Sweetcorn steamed on the cob and turned with sesame and salt
recipes.sub_l: Makai ke tar sipi logote bhap di kene til aru nimok loi mosala

method.en: Steam it on the cob and strip it after. Kernels cut off first lose their milk into the water and twenty kilos comes out dry.
method.l: Sipi logote bhap dibi aru pasote guti khan sarabi. Poila sarai diya guti pora tar gakhir to pani te hera jai aru bis kilo to sukha ulai.

method.en: Twelve minutes in the steamer and no more. A makai steamed twenty minutes is a starch and the sweetness is in the water.
method.l: Bhap laga bela te baro minute mattro, tatu bisi nai. Bis minute bhap diya makai to mar hoi jai aru mitha to pani te thake.

method.en: Roast the til until the seeds jump and crush it coarse. A powder disappears into twenty kilos and nothing is tasted.
method.l: Til to guti khan uphal thaka tak bhajibi aru mota kore thecha dibi. Gura kora til to bis kilo bhitorte hera jai aru kiba swad nathake.

method.en: Raw mustard oil turned through at the counter. Heated oil on hot makai cooks the kernel again and the tray goes leathery.
method.l: Dibole laga jagate kacha sorisa tel mila dibi. Gorom makai upor te gorom kora tel dile guti to aru randhi jai aru tray to chamra nisina hoi.

recipes.why: Seven rupees fifty a head. In borokhun the Peren makai is fifteen rupees a kilo and this is the breakfast a kitchen can put out with one vessel and one cook.
recipes.why_l: Ek manu te sat taka pachas. Borokhun din te Peren laga makai to kilo te pandhra taka, aru eitu he ekta bela aru ekjon randhoni loi rasoi pora dibole para bhorer khana.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Forty minutes, most of it stripping the cobs.
start.l: Kunu saman bhijai rakha nalage. Chalis minute, tar bisi bhag to sipi pora guti sarai.

vessel.en: A large steamer and two wide trays. Two cooks for the stripping.
vessel.l: Ekta dangor bhap bela aru duita chaura tray. Guti sarabole duijon randhoni.

season.en: Borokhun to sarot, while the makai is in the fields.
season.l: Borokhun pora sarot tak, makai kheti te thaka homoi te.

recipes.name: Semolina Upma
recipes.sub: Semolina roasted dry and turned with the winter vegetables
recipes.sub_l: Sooji ke sukha bhaji kene thanda din laga sabji loi mosala

method.en: Roast the sooji dry until it smells of it and no further. Under-roasted, six kilos goes to a single lump the moment the water is in.
method.l: Sooji to tar gonda ulai thaka tak sukha bhajibi, tatu bisi nai. Kom bhajile pani hala loge loge sou kilo to ekta dola hoi jai.

method.en: Two and a half measures of water to one of sooji. Three gives a porridge and two gives a sand and neither can be corrected on the fire.
method.l: Ek bhag sooji te dui bhag aru adha pani. Tin dile jaul hoi, dui dile balu hoi, aru duita bi jui upor te thik koribole napare.

method.en: Add the water boiling and never cold. Cold water on hot sooji seizes and the vessel is lumps that no ladle will break.
method.l: Pani to ukhala homoi te hala dibi, thanda kotina bi nohoi. Gorom sooji upor te thanda pani dile jam hoi jai aru bela to dola hoi, kunu chamos pora bi bhangibole napare.

method.en: Off the fire, lid on, five minutes. A sooji that has not stood is raw in the middle and twenty-six kilos cannot be recooked.
method.l: Jui pora namai, dhaki dibi, pas minute. Rakha nathaka sooji to majote kacha thake aru sabbis kilo ke aru randhibole napare.

recipes.why: Ten rupees ninety a head and it is on the counter in forty minutes. On a morning when the pitha steamers are not free, this is what the kitchen sends out.
recipes.why_l: Ek manu te dosh taka nobbei, aru chalis minute te dibole taiyar hoi. Pitha laga bhap bela khali nathaka bhore te rasoi pora eitu he pothai diye.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Forty minutes, and five of them under the lid.
start.l: Kunu saman bhijai rakha nalage. Chalis minute, tar pas minute to dhaki kene.

vessel.en: A wide 30 L kadai with a lid. Two cooks.
vessel.l: Dhakoni thaka tirish litre chaura kadai. Duijon randhoni.

season.en: All year, and every second morning in thanda din.
season.l: Pura bochor, aru thanda din te dui din te ekbar bhore.

recipes.name: Banana Rice Cake
recipes.name_l: Kol diya chaul gura laga pitha
recipes.sub: Ripe banana mashed into rice flour and steamed in a leaf
recipes.sub_l: Pakise kol ke chaul gura te micha kene pata te bhap diya

method.en: Mash the kol by hand and keep some lumps. A blended banana gives a batter with nothing to find and four hundred pitha taste the same as a plain one.
method.l: Kol to hath loi micha dibi aru kunba dola thakibole dibi. Blender te kora kol pora bisari pabole kiba nathaka gura hoi aru sari sou pitha to sadharon pitha nisina he lage.

method.en: Warm the kol pata over the flame a moment before it is folded. A cold leaf cracks along the vein and the batter is in the water.
method.l: Bhaj nadi kene kol pata to jui upor te olop gorom kori lobi. Thanda pata to tar sira zonote phati jai aru gura to pani te pori jai.

method.en: The riper the kol the less gur. A green banana in a pitha is bitter and no amount of jaggery covers it.
method.l: Kol jiman pakise, gur titan kom lage. Pitha bhitorte kacha kol dile tita hoi aru kotona gur dile bi dhakibole napare.

method.en: Twenty minutes in the steamer and take one out to test it. A pitha that sticks to the leaf has four minutes more to go.
method.l: Bhap bela te bis minute rakhi kene ekta ulai kene sabi. Pata te lagise pitha to aru sari minute lage.

recipes.why: Nine rupees fifty a head. The banana leaves come off the tree behind the kitchen and in Peren the kol is twenty rupees a kilo.
recipes.why_l: Ek manu te no taka pachas. Kol pata to rasoi laga pisote thaka gos pora ahe aru Peren te kol to kilo te bis taka.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Ninety minutes for four hundred, most of it folding.
start.l: Kunu saman bhijai rakha nalage. Sari sou karone nobboi minute, tar bisi bhag to bhaj.

vessel.en: Two large steamers and a folding table. Three cooks.
vessel.l: Duita dangor bhap bela aru bhaj koribole mez. Tinjon randhoni.

season.en: All year, and at Moatsu above all.
season.l: Pura bochor, aru Moatsu te bisi kori.

recipes.name: Millet Porridge
recipes.sub: Millet cooked to a porridge and finished with ginger and pepper
recipes.sub_l: Kodo ke jaul howa tak randhi kene ada aru gul mircha diya

method.en: Roast the kodo dry five minutes before it is washed. It is what keeps five kilos from going to a single paste and it costs nothing.
method.l: Kodo to dhuwa nadi kene pas minute sukha bhajibi. Eitu pora pas kilo ke ekta dola hobole nadiye aru eitu te khoros eku nai.

method.en: Stir the bottom every four minutes. Millet sinks and thirty litres burns under it with no smell reaching the cook.
method.l: Sari minute pisote tolote ghurai dibi. Kodo to tolote bohi jai aru tirish litre to tar tolote juli jai, randhoni tak gonda bi napai.

method.en: Ginger and pepper at the counter and not on the fire. Boiled twenty minutes the ada is gone and the porridge tastes of nothing.
method.l: Ada aru mircha to jui upor te nohoi, dibole laga jagate dibi. Bis minute ukhalile ada to hera jai aru jaul to swad nathaka hoi.

method.en: Keep it thin enough to drink from the bowl. A thick kodo jaul is a solid by the time the vessel crosses the yard.
method.l: Bati pora khabole para tak polka rakhibi. Gadha kodo jaul to bela to bari par howa homoi te tan hoi jai.

recipes.why: Eight rupees thirty a head. Kodo grows on a Phek jhum where rice will not, and five kilos of it feeds a hundred at breakfast.
recipes.why_l: Ek manu te ath taka tirish. Bhat nahua Phek laga jhum te kodo hoi, aru pas kilo pora bhorer khana te ek sou manu khai.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Fifty minutes on a low fire.
start.l: Kunu saman bhijai rakha nalage. Olop jui te pachas minute.

vessel.en: A heavy 40 L vessel. One cook who does not leave it.
vessel.l: Bhari chalis litre bela. Ekjon randhoni, tai eitu chari najabo.

season.en: Sarot to thanda din, after the jhum is cut.
season.l: Sarot pora thanda din tak, jhum kata pasote.

recipes.name: Raja Mircha Chutney
recipes.sub: King chilli and tomato, roasted
recipes.sub_l: Puri diya raja mircha aru bilahi

method.en: Raja mircha is among the hottest chillies in the world. Wear cloth or gloves on the hands, do not touch the face, and wash the board with salt afterwards rather than water alone.
method.l: Raja mircha prithibi laga sob pora jhaal mircha bhitorte ase. Hath te kapor nohoile glove lagabi, mukhot nachubi, aru pichote taktar ke khali pani nohoi nimok pora dhubi.

method.en: One hundred and fifty grams serves a hundred people. That is not a misprint — it is roughly one chilli for four, and a first-time cook should use half of that and taste.
method.l: Ek sou pochas gram ekso manu nimite ase. Etu bhul nohoi — sari jon nimite ek mircha nisina, aru notun randhoni adha loi sai lobo lage.

method.en: Roast the chillies whole over an open flame until the skin blisters and blackens in patches, and stand upwind while doing it.
method.l: Mircha ke pura khula jui te chal phula aru kala daag ulai nohua loi puribi, aru kora somoi te bhatah laga ulta phale thakibi.

method.en: Roast the tomatoes and ginger the same way. The roasting is what makes this a Naga chutney rather than a ground one — nothing here is raw.
method.l: Bilahi aru aduwa ke bhi eneka he puribi. Puri diya he etu ke Naga chutney bonai, pisa chutney nohoi — iyate eku kacha nai.

method.en: Rub the blackened skins off the chilli and tomato but do not wash them. Washing takes the smoke off and the smoke is the point.
method.l: Mircha aru bilahi laga kala chal ghohi ulabi kintu nadhubi. Dhuile dhuwa laga swad jai aru dhuwa he asol kotha ase.

method.en: Pound in a mortar rather than grinding. A machine emulsifies it and it turns thin; pounded it stays rough, which is how it is eaten.
method.l: Machine te napisi hamandista te kutibi. Machine te etu pathla hoi jai; kutile dhala thake, aru eneka he khai.

recipes.why: On the table at every Naga meal. The whole method is roasting rather than grinding, and the whole risk is quantity.
recipes.why_l: Hodai Naga khana logote mez te thake. Pura tarika pisa nohoi puri diya ase, aru pura khatra kiman lagai etu ase.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Keeps three days. Start forty minutes before serving.
start.l: Eku bhijai nalage. Tin din thake. Diya age salish minute suru koribi.

vessel.en: An open flame, a mortar and a 5 L bowl. One cook, wearing cloth on the hands.
vessel.l: Khula jui, hamandista aru 5 L bati. Ekjon randhoni, hath te kapor lagai.

season.en: All year. On every Naga table at every meal.
season.l: Pura bosor. Hodai Naga mez te hodai khana logote.

recipes.name: Perilla Seed Chutney
recipes.sub: Roasted perilla with chilli and ginger
recipes.sub_l: Jaluk aru aduwa diya bhaja nakhup

method.en: Roast the perilla on the lowest flame, moving it constantly, until it just begins to pop and smells nutty.
method.l: Nakhup ke bisi dhimai jui te hodai ghurai, photka suru aru bhal gundh ulai nohua loi bhajibi.

method.en: Take it off the instant it pops. Perilla goes from roasted to burnt in about twenty seconds and burnt perilla is bitter through and through.
method.l: Photka loge loge namai lobi. Nakhup bhaja pora jola loi kudi second te jai aru jola nakhup pura tita hoi.

method.en: Cool it completely on a tray before pounding. Warm seed releases its oil and turns to a sticky paste.
method.l: Kutna age tray te pura thanda koribi. Gorom guti tel ulai aru lasa hoi jai.

method.en: Roast the ginger and tomato over an open flame and rub the skins off without washing.
method.l: Aduwa aru bilahi khula jui te puri, nadhui chal ghohi ulabi.

method.en: Pound everything together in a mortar to a coarse paste. This chutney should be gritty — that texture is what it is for.
method.l: Sob eke logote hamandista te dhala kori kutibi. Ei chutney khorkhoria hobo lage — etu he iyar kaam ase.

method.en: Make it fresh. Perilla oil turns rancid quickly and a chutney kept past two days smells of old oil.
method.l: Notun bonabi. Nakhup laga tel joldi kharab hoi aru dui din pora bisi rakha chutney purana tel laga gundh dei.

recipes.why: The seed that stands in for dairy and for oil across this whole book. Twenty seconds decides whether it works.
recipes.why_l: Ei pura kitab te gakhir aru tel laga bodli te thaka guti. Kudi second te thik nohoile bigare.

start.en: Roast and cool the perilla ahead. Keeps two days. Start forty minutes before serving.
start.l: Nakhup age bhaji thanda koribi. Dui din thake. Diya age salish minute suru koribi.

vessel.en: A heavy pan and a mortar. One cook.
vessel.l: Bhari bortan aru hamandista. Ekjon randhoni.

season.en: All year; the seed is harvested in November and keeps a year.
season.l: Pura bosor; guti November te uthai aru ek bosor thake.

recipes.name: Roasted Tomato Chutney
recipes.sub: Fire-roasted tomato with ginger
recipes.sub_l: Aduwa diya jui te puri diya bilahi

method.en: This is the mild chutney, made for people who cannot take raja mircha. Every Naga table needs one of each.
method.l: Etu norom chutney ase, jun manu raja mircha khabo napare tai nimite. Hodai Naga mez te duiyo lage.

method.en: Roast the tomatoes whole directly on the coals or an open flame until the skin blackens and splits.
method.l: Bilahi ke pura, angar nohoile khula jui te chal kala hoi phata loi puribi.

method.en: Do not use a pan. A pan gives a cooked tomato; the flame gives a smoked one, and that smoke is the whole difference.
method.l: Bortan nacholabi. Bortan pora siddha bilahi hoi; jui pora dhuwa laga hoi, aru etu dhuwa he pura antor ase.

method.en: Rub the blackened skin off with the fingers and do not wash it. Washing takes the smoke straight off.
method.l: Kala chal angul pora ghohi ulabi aru nadhubi. Dhuile dhuwa loge loge jai.

method.en: Roast the ginger and green chilli the same way, and toast the sesame separately on a dry pan.
method.l: Aduwa aru kesa jaluk ke bhi eneka he puribi, aru til alag sukha bortan te bhajibi.

method.en: Pound coarsely in a mortar, stir in the coriander by hand, and serve at room temperature.
method.l: Hamandista te dhala kori kutibi, dhonia pata hath pora milai, aru sadharon gorom te dibi.

recipes.why: The chutney for anyone who cannot manage the king chilli, and the smoke does the work instead of the heat.
recipes.why_l: Jun raja mircha khabo napare tai nimite chutney, aru jhaal laga bodli te dhuwa kaam kore.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Keeps three days. Start forty minutes before serving.
start.l: Eku bhijai nalage. Tin din thake. Diya age salish minute suru koribi.

vessel.en: An open flame and a mortar. One cook.
vessel.l: Khula jui aru hamandista. Ekjon randhoni.

season.en: All year, cheapest November to February.
season.l: Pura bosor, November pora February loi sob pora sosta.

recipes.name: Sesame Chutney
recipes.sub: Sesame roasted and ground with a great deal of ginger
recipes.sub_l: Til bhaji kene bahut ada logote pisi diya

method.en: Roast the til until the seeds jump and take it off at once. Sesame past that point is bitter and a kilo and a half cannot be salvaged.
method.l: Til to guti khan uphal thaka tak bhajibi aru loge loge namai lobi. Tar pisote bhajile til to tita hoi aru ek kilo adha ke bachabole napare.

method.en: Seven hundred grams of ada and it is not a mistake. In a kitchen with no onion the ginger is the whole base of this chutney.
method.l: Sat sou gram ada, aru eitu bhul nohoi. Pyaj nathaka rasoi te eitu chutney laga pura bhetti to ada he.

method.en: Grind it warm and it gives up its own oil. That oil is the binding and no mustard oil is needed anywhere in it.
method.l: Gorom thaka homoi te pisibi aru tai nijor tel ulai dibo. Etu tel he bandhi rakhe aru tar bhitorte kotina bi sorisa tel nalage.

method.en: Keep it thick enough to stand on a spoon. A thin til chutney runs off the bhat and the plate is a grey wash.
method.l: Chamos upor te thiya hobole para tak gadha rakhibi. Polka til chutney to bhat pora bohi jai aru thali to dhusor pani hoi jai.

recipes.why: Five rupees twenty a head. Til grows on a Mokokchung jhum and this is the chutney that goes beside a plain bhat on a thanda din.
recipes.why_l: Ek manu te pas taka bis. Til to Mokokchung laga jhum te hoi, aru thanda din te sadharon bhat laga kasote juwa chutney to eitu he.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Thirty minutes, and it is ground warm.
start.l: Kunu saman bhijai rakha nalage. Tirish minute, aru gorom thaka homoi te pisi.

vessel.en: A dry pan and a grinding stone. One cook.
vessel.l: Sukha kadai aru pisibole pathor. Ekjon randhoni.

season.en: All year, and after the sarot harvest above all.
season.l: Pura bochor, aru sarot laga dhan kata pasote bisi kori.

recipes.name: Mustard Leaf Chutney
recipes.sub: Mustard leaves wilted and ground with sesame and chilli
recipes.sub_l: Sorisa pata ke molai kene til aru mircha logote pisi diya

method.en: Wilt the leaves in a dry pan two minutes and no more. Boiled, four kilos of pata gives a chutney the colour of a wet road.
method.l: Pata khan ke sukha kadai te dui minute molai dibi, tatu bisi nai. Ukhalile sari kilo pata pora bhija rasta rong laga chutney hoi.

method.en: Squeeze the wilted leaf dry before grinding. The water that comes out is bitter and a chutney made with it goes back to the kitchen.
method.l: Pisa nadi kene molai diya pata to sipi kene sukha koribi. Ulai juwa pani to tita hoi aru etu loi bona chutney to rasoi te wapas ahe.

method.en: Roast the til separately. Ground raw with the leaf it tastes of nothing and five hundred grams is wasted.
method.l: Til to alag kori bhajibi. Pata logote kacha pisile tar swad eku nathake aru pas sou gram nasto hoi.

method.en: Lemon at the counter and not in the grinding. Lemon in a green chutney turns it grey within the hour.
method.l: Nemu to pisa homoi te nohoi, dibole laga jagate dibi. Hariyali chutney te nemu dile ek ghanta bhitorte dhusor hoi jai.

recipes.why: Three rupees fifty a head, the cheapest chutney on this shelf. In thanda din the pata is fifteen rupees a kilo at Kohima bazar and four kilos does a hundred plates.
recipes.why_l: Ek manu te tin taka pachas, eitu thak te sobse sosta chutney. Thanda din te Kohima bazar te sorisa pata to kilo te pandhra taka, aru sari kilo pora ek sou thali hoi.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Thirty minutes, and it is made on the day.
start.l: Kunu saman bhijai rakha nalage. Tirish minute, aru etu din te he bonai.

vessel.en: A dry pan, a squeezing cloth and a grinding stone. One cook.
vessel.l: Sukha kadai, sipibole kapor aru pisibole pathor. Ekjon randhoni.

season.en: Sarot to gorom din, while the pata is in the market.
season.l: Sarot pora gorom din tak, pata bazar te thaka homoi te.

recipes.name: Bastenga Chutney
recipes.sub: Fermented bamboo squeezed dry and crushed with roasted chilli
recipes.sub_l: Bastenga ke sipi kene sukhai, bhaja mircha logote thecha diya

method.en: Squeeze the bastenga dry and throw the liquor. The liquor is the whole smell and in a chutney eaten a spoon at a time it is far too much.
method.l: Bastenga to sipi kene sukhai lobi aru tar pani to phelai dibi. Etu pani te sob gonda thake aru ek chamos kori khuwa chutney te eitu bahut bisi hoi.

method.en: Roast the mircha on the flame and crush it in the hand. A powder gives heat only; the pieces are what a Naga plate looks for beside the bhat.
method.l: Mircha to jui upor te bhaji kene hath loi thecha dibi. Gura pora jhaal mattro diye; Naga thali te bhat kasote bisara to tukra khan he.

method.en: No oil anywhere in it. The bastenga carries its own and a spoon of oil turns two and a half kilos into a paste.
method.l: Tar bhitorte kotina bi tel nai. Bastenga te tar nijor tel thake aru ek chamos tel dile dui kilo adha to dola hoi jai.

method.en: Make it the morning it is served. A bastenga chutney standing a day ferments again in the jar and the lid comes off by itself.
method.l: Jun din dibo, etu din laga bhore te bonabi. Ek din rakhise bastenga chutney to bela bhitorte aru gali jai aru dhakoni to nijorei ulai.

recipes.why: Four rupees a head. Two and a half kilos of bastenga out of a jar put down in borokhun gives a hundred plates the one thing a Naga will name first.
recipes.why_l: Ek manu te sari taka. Borokhun din te rakhise bela pora dui kilo adha bastenga pora ek sou thali te Naga manu pora poila kowa saman to diye.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Twenty minutes on the morning it is served.
start.l: Kunu saman bhijai rakha nalage. Jun din dibo, etu bhore te bis minute.

vessel.en: A squeezing cloth, an open flame and a grinding stone. One cook.
vessel.l: Sipibole kapor, khula jui aru pisibole pathor. Ekjon randhoni.

season.en: All year, out of the jar put down in borokhun.
season.l: Pura bochor, borokhun din te rakhise bela pora.

recipes.name: Ginger Chutney
recipes.sub: Ginger scraped, crushed raw with lemon and no oil
recipes.sub_l: Ada laga chal sarai, nemu logote kacha thecha, tel eku nai

method.en: Scrape the skin with a spoon and never peel it with a knife. The layer just under the skin is where the whole smell sits.
method.l: Chal to chamos loi sarabi, churi loi kotina bi nachilabi. Sob gonda to chal laga niche laga stor te thake.

method.en: Crush it and do not grind it fine. A fine ada chutney is a paste that cannot be picked up on a finger.
method.l: Thecha dibi, misi kori napisibi. Misi kora ada chutney to dola hoi jai aru angoli loi lobole napare.

method.en: No oil and no heat at any point. The lemon is the whole preservative and it works only if the jar is dry.
method.l: Kotina bi tel aru gorom nai. Nemu he sob rakhibole kaam kore aru bela sukha thakile mattro kaam kore.

method.en: Two kilos and no more at a time. An ada chutney is at its best for four days and after that it is a hot water.
method.l: Ekbar te dui kilo mattro, tatu bisi nai. Ada chutney to sari din tak sobse bhal thake aru tar pasote jhaal pani he hoi jai.

recipes.why: Four rupees forty a head, and it is the one thing on a heavy Naga plate that will settle a stomach after an axone dish.
recipes.why_l: Ek manu te sari taka chalis, aru bhari Naga thali te axone laga khana pisote pet ke thanda kora saman to eitu he.

start.en: Nothing cooks. Twenty minutes at the stone.
start.l: Kiba randha nalage. Pathor te bis minute.

vessel.en: A grinding stone and a dry jar. One cook.
vessel.l: Pisibole pathor aru sukha bela. Ekjon randhoni.

season.en: All year, and made twice a week.
season.l: Pura bochor, aru hafta te duibar bonai.

recipes.name: Axone Chutney
recipes.sub: Fermented soybean crushed raw with roasted chilli and no oil
recipes.sub_l: Axone ke bhaja mircha logote kacha thecha, tel eku nai

method.en: Roast the axone on the flame a moment before it is crushed. That one minute of fire is what turns the smell from raw to something a hall will eat.
method.l: Thecha nadi kene axone ke jui upor te olop bhaji lobi. Etu ek minute jui pora gonda to kacha pora hall khabole para kiba hoi jai.

method.en: Crush it on the stone and not in a mixer. A mixed axone is a paste and the whole point of this chutney is the bean showing.
method.l: Mixer te nohoi, pathor te thecha dibi. Mixer te kora axone to dola hoi jai aru eitu chutney laga mukhyo kotha to guti dekha juwa he.

method.en: Make it in a corner of the yard and not in the kitchen. A kilo and a half of roasting axone is smelt across the compound and it stays in the walls.
method.l: Rasoi te nohoi, bari laga ek kone te bonabi. Ek kilo adha axone bhaja laga gonda to pura bari te pai aru bera te thaki jai.

method.en: A spoon on the plate and no more. This is the strongest thing on this shelf and a ladle of it takes the meal away from everything else.
method.l: Thali te ek chamos mattro, tatu bisi nai. Eitu thak te sobse tez saman aru ekta dangor chamos dile pura khana pora dusra sob swad hera jai.

recipes.why: Six rupees ten a head. Axone comes out of a Zunheboto jar and of everything on this shelf it is the one a Naga away from home asks for first.
recipes.why_l: Ek manu te sou taka dosh. Axone to Zunheboto laga bela pora ahe aru eitu thak te ghor pora dur thaka Naga manu pora poila mangise saman to eitu he.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Twenty minutes on the morning it is served.
start.l: Kunu saman bhijai rakha nalage. Jun din dibo, etu bhore te bis minute.

vessel.en: An open flame in the yard and a grinding stone. One cook.
vessel.l: Bari te khula jui aru pisibole pathor. Ekjon randhoni.

season.en: All year, out of the jar put down in sarot.
season.l: Pura bochor, sarot te rakhise bela pora.

recipes.name: Kholar
recipes.sub: Naga red kidney beans, slow-boiled
recipes.sub_l: Naga rangoli rajma, dhimai siddha

method.en: Kholar is the Naga kidney bean and it is smaller, darker and thinner-skinned than a plains rajma. If it can be got, it is worth the price.
method.l: Kholar Naga laga rajma ase aru etu plains laga rajma pora sotu, kala aru pathla chal ase. Pabo parile dam diya thik ase.

method.en: Soak ten hours and throw the soaking water away. A short-soaked bean stays hard in the middle however long it is cooked.
method.l: Dohh ghonta bhijai, bhija pani pheliya dibi. Komti bhija guti kiman rondhile bhi majote tan thake.

method.en: Cook until a bean crushes to nothing between finger and thumb. Merely soft is not cooked.
method.l: Guti ke angul majote pura gali juwa loi rondhibi. Khali norom hua siddha nohoi.

method.en: This is not a North Indian rajma and should not be made like one. There is no onion, no garlic, no garam masala and no cream — only ginger, chilli and the bean itself.
method.l: Etu North India laga rajma nohoi aru eneka nabonabi. Iyate piyaj nai, rosun nai, garam masala nai aru cream nai — khali aduwa, mircha aru guti nijei.

method.en: Add the tomato and a very small quantity of king chilli in the last thirty minutes and let it break down into the beans.
method.l: Bilahi aru bisi olop raja mircha hekh laga tirish minute te halibi aru guti logote galibo dibi.

method.en: Stir the ground roasted perilla in off the fire. It thickens the pot and does the work cream would do elsewhere.
method.l: Bhaja pisa nakhup ke jui bondh kori milabi. Etu bortan gadha kore aru aru jagate cream laga kaam kore.

recipes.why: The one bean these hills are known for, cooked plain. Perilla instead of cream is the only thing standing in for anything.
recipes.why_l: Ei pahar laga naam thaka ekmatra guti, sadharon kori bona. Cream laga bodli te nakhup — aru eku bodli nai.

start.en: Soak the kholar ten hours — overnight. Start three hours before serving.
start.l: Kholar dohh ghonta bhijabi — rati bhor. Diya age tin ghonta suru koribi.

vessel.en: A 40 L pressure vessel. Two cooks.
vessel.l: 40 L pressure bortan. Dujon randhoni.

season.en: All year. The bean the Kohima hills are known for.
season.l: Pura bosor. Kohima pahar laga naam thaka guti.

recipes.name: Fresh Soybean Curry
recipes.sub: Green soybean with ginger and chilli
recipes.sub_l: Aduwa aru jaluk diya kesa soybean

method.en: Soybean is the crop these hills are built on, and for about ten weeks a year it can be had fresh rather than fermented.
method.l: Soybean ei pahar laga asol kheti ase, aru bosor te prai dohh hoptah etu khomir nohoi notun pabo pare.

method.en: Shell by hand the evening before. Eight kilos takes two people most of an evening and there is no way round it.
method.l: Ek din age hath pora chulabi. Ath kilo nimite dujon manu laga prai pura sondhya lage aru aru rasta nai.

method.en: Boil the shelled beans in plenty of water for twenty minutes and drain. Fresh soybean has a raw green taste that only a hard boil removes.
method.l: Chula guti ke bisi pani te kudi minute uthai, pani pheliya dibi. Notun soybean te kacha swad thake jun khali jor uthaile he jai.

method.en: Do not skip that first boil and do not keep the water. Both the taste and the heaviness go out with it.
method.l: Prothom uthowa nachari bi aru etu pani narakhibi. Swad aru bharti duiyo etu logote ulai jai.

method.en: Cook the drained beans with ginger, chilli and tomato until they are soft enough to press flat, about thirty minutes.
method.l: Pani ulai diya guti ke aduwa, jaluk aru bilahi logote norom nohua loi prai tirish minute rondhibi.

method.en: Stir the roasted ground perilla in off the fire and finish with coriander.
method.l: Bhaja pisa nakhup jui bondh kori milabi aru dhonia pata halibi.

recipes.why: Ten weeks a year, and worth building a September menu around. The rest of the year it comes back as axone.
recipes.why_l: Bosor te dohh hoptah, aru September laga menu etu logote bonabole thik ase. Baki bosor etu axone hoi ahe.

start.en: Shell the soybean the evening before — it is slow work. Start seventy minutes before serving.
start.l: Soybean ek din age chulabi — etu dhimai kaam ase. Diya age sattar minute suru koribi.

vessel.en: A 30 L vessel. Two cooks — shelling is the bottleneck.
vessel.l: 30 L bortan. Dujon randhoni — chula he deri hoi.

season.en: September to November only, while the fresh pods are in.
season.l: Khali September pora November loi, jetia notun pod thake.

recipes.name: Rice Bean
recipes.sub: Small hill beans, plainly boiled
recipes.sub_l: Sotu pahar guti, sadharon siddha

method.en: Rice bean is the small hill pulse grown on the terraces alongside the rice, and it stores dry for a year.
method.l: Naga guti pahar laga sotu dal ase jun bhat laga khet logote hoi, aru sukha ek bosor thake.

method.en: Soak eight hours and throw the soaking water away.
method.l: Ath ghonta bhijai, bhija pani pheliya dibi.

method.en: Cook with the ginger until the beans are completely soft. These take longer than they look — allow forty minutes in a pressure vessel.
method.l: Aduwa logote guti pura norom nohua loi rondhibi. Etu dikha pora bisi somoi loi — pressure bortan te salish minute dibi.

method.en: Add the tomato and green chilli only when the beans are already soft. Acid added early stops a pulse softening and it will stay hard however long it cooks.
method.l: Bilahi aru kesa jaluk khali guti norom hoile he halibi. Age tenga dile dal norom nohoi aru kiman rondhile bhi tan thake.

method.en: Mash a ladleful of beans against the side and stir them back in to thicken it.
method.l: Ek hatai guti ke bortan laga kinar te ghohi, gadha kori bole wapas milabi.

method.en: Stir the roasted ground perilla in off the fire and finish with coriander.
method.l: Bhaja pisa nakhup jui bondh kori milabi aru dhonia pata halibi.

recipes.why: Stores dry for a year, costs less than kholar, and it is what a hill kitchen falls back on in March.
recipes.why_l: Sukha ek bosor thake, kholar pora sosta ase, aru March te pahar laga rondhon ghor etu te ghurai ahe.

start.en: Soak eight hours. Start two and a half hours before serving.
start.l: Ath ghonta bhijabi. Diya age dhai ghonta suru koribi.

vessel.en: A 30 L pressure vessel. One cook.
vessel.l: 30 L pressure bortan. Ekjon randhoni.

season.en: All year. The bean that is always in the store.
season.l: Pura bosor. Bhandar te hodai thaka guti.

recipes.name: Whole Masoor Dal
recipes.sub: Whole masoor cooked till the skins split, with tomato
recipes.sub_l: Gutia masoor ke chal phata tak randhi, bilahi logote

method.en: Soak the masoor two hours. The whole lentil carries a skin and an unsoaked one is still a bead when the vessel comes off the fire.
method.l: Masoor to dui ghanta bhijai rakhibi. Gutia masoor te chal thake aru bhijai nathaka to bela jui pora namai luwa homoi te bi guti nisina thake.

method.en: Salt only after the skins split. Salted early, masoor holds its skin and an hour more on the fire will not open it.
method.l: Chal phata pasote mattro nimok dibi. Age te nimok dile masoor tar chal dhori thake aru jui te aru ek ghanta rakhile bi nakhulibo.

method.en: Tomato in the last ten minutes only. Cooked from the start it goes to a paste and the dal is a soup with no lentil to be seen.
method.l: Bilahi to hekh laga dosh minute te mattro. Suru pora randhile dola hoi jai aru dal to masoor nadekha soup hoi jai.

method.en: Take it off looser than it should be. Masoor drinks for twenty minutes in the vessel and comes to the counter right.
method.l: Jiman lage tatu polka thaki kene namai lobi. Masoor pora bela bhitorte bis minute pani suse aru dibole laga jagate thik hoi ahe.

recipes.why: Eight rupees seventy a head, and masoor is the cheapest whole pulse at Dimapur bazar eight months of the year. It cooks in half the time a kholar takes.
recipes.why_l: Ek manu te ath taka sathi, aru bochor laga ath mah Dimapur bazar te masoor he sobse sosta gutia dal. Kholar laga adha homoi te randhi jai.

start.en: Masoor soaks two hours. Three hours before the bell in all.
start.l: Masoor to dui ghanta bhijai. Ghanta baja age te sob milai tin ghanta.

vessel.en: A 25 L vessel with a lid. One cook.
vessel.l: Dhakoni thaka pachis litre bela. Ekjon randhoni.

season.en: All year, and every second day in thanda din.
season.l: Pura bochor, aru thanda din te dui din te ekbar.

recipes.name: Chana Dal
recipes.sub: Chana dal soaked long and cooked to hold its shape
recipes.sub_l: Chana dal ke bahut homoi bhijai kene tar akar thaka tak randha

method.en: Soak it four hours and not two. Chana is the hardest dal in this store room and a short soak means an hour more on the fire.
method.l: Sari ghanta bhijai rakhibi, dui nohoi. Eitu bhoral te chana he sobse tan dal aru olop bhijaile jui te aru ek ghanta lage.

method.en: This is the one dal in the book where a whole grain is a good sign. Keep it loose and let the chana be seen.
method.l: Eitu boi te gutia dal thaka to bhal hoa dal to eitu ekta he. Polka rakhibi aru chana to dekha jabole dibi.

method.en: Skim the froth off in the first ten minutes. Chana froth left in the vessel gives twenty litres a taste of soap.
method.l: Poila dosh minute te phen to ulai dibi. Bela te rakhi diya chana phen pora bis litre te sabon laga swad ahe.

method.en: Ghee generously at the end. Chana dal is dry in the mouth and without the ghee a devotee stops halfway down the plate.
method.l: Hekh te ghee bahut kori dibi. Chana dal to mukh te sukha lage aru ghee nathakile bhokot pora thali laga adha te rukhi jai.

recipes.why: Ten rupees thirty a head and it holds a devotee longer than any other dal here. On the morning of a long walk this is what the kitchen sends out.
recipes.why_l: Ek manu te dosh taka tirish, aru ithote thaka dusra dal pora eitu pora bhokot ke bisi homoi dhori rakhe. Dur jabole din laga bhore te rasoi pora eitu he pothai diye.

start.en: Chana dal soaks four hours. Five hours before the bell in all.
start.l: Chana dal to sari ghanta bhijai. Ghanta baja age te sob milai pas ghanta.

vessel.en: A 25 L vessel with a close lid. One cook.
vessel.l: Bhal kori dhaka pachis litre bela. Ekjon randhoni.

season.en: All year, and before any long walking day.
season.l: Pura bochor, aru dur jabole din laga age te.

recipes.name: Toor Dal
recipes.sub: Toor dal cooked thin with tomato and a leaf of coriander
recipes.sub_l: Arhar dal ke bilahi logote polka randhi, dhania pata diya

method.en: Roast the arhar dry five minutes before it is washed. It is what keeps three kilos from going to a single paste and it costs nothing.
method.l: Arhar to dhuwa nadi kene pas minute sukha bhajibi. Eitu pora tin kilo ke ekta dola hobole nadiye aru eitu te khoros eku nai.

method.en: Nothing soaks. Arhar goes soft in forty minutes from dry and a soaked one falls apart before the tomato is in.
method.l: Kiba bhijai rakha nalage. Arhar to sukha pora chalis minute te molom hoi jai aru bhijai diya to bilahi hala age te bhangi jai.

method.en: Keep it thin enough to drink. A thick arhar dal on a Naga plate is eaten with the fingers and nobody finishes it.
method.l: Khabole para tak polka rakhibi. Naga thali te gadha arhar dal to angoli loi khai aru kunbi puri nakhai.

method.en: The tempering goes over it at the counter. Poured in the kitchen, the smell is gone by the time the vessel crosses the yard.
method.l: Phoron to dibole laga jagate tar upor te dibi. Rasoi te dile bela to bari par howa homoi te gonda hera jai.

recipes.why: Nine rupees fifty a head and it is on the counter in fifty minutes. It is the dal for the day a kitchen is short of both time and cooks.
recipes.why_l: Ek manu te no taka pachas, aru pachas minute te dibole taiyar hoi. Rasoi te homoi aru randhoni duita kom thaka din laga dal to eitu he.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Fifty minutes from a cold stove.
start.l: Kunu saman bhijai rakha nalage. Thanda chula pora pachas minute.

vessel.en: A 25 L vessel and a tempering pan. One cook.
vessel.l: Pachis litre bela aru phoron laga kadai. Ekjon randhoni.

season.en: All year, and twice a week in thanda din.
season.l: Pura bochor, aru thanda din te hafta te duibar.

recipes.name: White Bean Dal
recipes.sub: White beans cooked long until a quarter of them break
recipes.sub_l: Boga guti ke tar sari bhag ekta phata tak bahut homoi randha

method.en: Soak them twelve hours and cook them in the soaking water. Fresh water gives a pale vessel however long it boils.
method.l: Baro ghanta bhijai rakhi kene bhijai diya pani te he randhibi. Notun pani dile kotona ukhalile bi bela to phika thake.

method.en: Cook it until a quarter of the beans break by themselves. That quarter is what thickens twenty-two litres with no flour in it.
method.l: Guti laga sari bhag ekta nijorei phata tak randhibi. Etu sari bhag ekta pora gura nadi kene 22 litre ke gadha kore.

method.en: Salt only after the bean is soft. Salted early, a boga guti hardens and no amount of time brings it back.
method.l: Guti molom howa pasote mattro nimok dibi. Age te nimok dile boga guti to tan hoi jai aru kotona homoi dile bi wapas nahe.

method.en: Roast the nakhup and crush it in at the end. It is what carries this vessel and there is no oil to spare for it.
method.l: Nakhup to bhaji kene hekh te thecha dibi. Eitu bela ke jai diya to etu he aru tar karone tel bachi thaka nai.

recipes.why: Twelve rupees a head. Three and a half kilos of boga guti gives a hundred people the protein of a meal and the vessel keeps overnight without a fridge.
recipes.why_l: Ek manu te barota taka. Boga guti tin kilo adha pora ek sou manu ke ek bela khana laga bol diye, aru bela to fridge nathaki kene raat bharikhon thake.

start.en: Beans soak twelve hours. Start the evening before.
start.l: Guti khan baro ghanta bhijai. Age din laga sanjote suru koribi.

vessel.en: A 30 L vessel with a lid. One cook.
vessel.l: Dhakoni thaka tirish litre bela. Ekjon randhoni.

season.en: Sarot to gorom din, out of the granary.
season.l: Sarot pora gorom din tak, bhoral pora.

recipes.name: Black Gram Dal
recipes.sub: Black gram cooked three hours and finished with ghee
recipes.sub_l: Kala mati dal ke tin ghanta randhi kene ghee diya

method.en: Soak it twelve hours and cook it in the soaking water. That dark water is half the colour of the finished dal.
method.l: Baro ghanta bhijai rakhi kene bhijai diya pani te he randhibi. Etu kala pani he sesh dal laga rong laga adha.

method.en: Three hours on a low fire and no shortcut. A black gram boiled hard for one hour is a bead with a broken skin and nothing else.
method.l: Olop jui te tin ghanta, chuti rasta eku nai. Ek ghanta joror pora ukhalise kala mati dal to chal phata guti mattro hoi.

method.en: Salt only after the bean is soft. Salted early, it hardens and two hours more will not save it.
method.l: Guti molom howa pasote mattro nimok dibi. Age te nimok dile tan hoi jai aru aru dui ghanta dile bi bachibo nohoi.

method.en: The ghee goes in off the fire and is not stirred through. It should sit on the surface where the hall can see it.
method.l: Ghee to jui pora namai kene dibi aru mila nadibi. Hall pora dekha pabole tar upor te bohi thakibole lage.

recipes.why: Thirteen rupees sixty a head. Three and a half kilos of it holds a hall through a thanda din afternoon better than five of any other pulse.
recipes.why_l: Ek manu te tera taka sathi. Tin kilo adha pora dusra dal pas kilo pora bi thanda din laga dupor te hall ke bhal kore dhori rakhe.

start.en: Beans soak twelve hours and cook three. Start the evening before.
start.l: Guti khan baro ghanta bhijai aru tin ghanta randhe. Age din laga sanjote suru koribi.

vessel.en: A heavy 30 L vessel with a lid. One cook.
vessel.l: Dhakoni thaka bhari tirish litre bela. Ekjon randhoni.

season.en: Thanda din above all, and all year besides.
season.l: Thanda din te bisi kori, aru pura bochor bi.

recipes.name: Galho
recipes.sub: Angami rice and vegetable porridge
recipes.sub_l: Angami manu laga bhat aru sabji laga jaul

method.en: Galho is the Angami one-pot meal and it is closer to a thick porridge than to a khichdi. It should pour slowly off a ladle.
method.l: Galho Angami manu laga ek bortan laga khana ase aru etu khichdi pora gadha jaul nisina bisi ase. Hatai pora aste poribo lage.

method.en: Add the colocasia first and cook it twenty minutes before the rice goes in. Taro is dense and needs the head start.
method.l: Kacchu prothom halibi aru chaul halu age kudi minute rondhibi. Kacchu tan ase aru age suru koribo lage.

method.en: Cook the rice until the grains have burst completely. A galho with separate grains has not been cooked long enough.
method.l: Chaul ke dana pura phata loi rondhibi. Alag dana thaka galho thik kori rondha nai.

method.en: Add the greens only in the last eight minutes. Cooked from the start they go grey-brown and the whole pot looks tired.
method.l: Pata ke hekh laga ath minute te he halibi. Suru pora rondhile etu kala-boga hoi jai aru pura bortan purana nisina dikhe.

method.en: Stir the roasted ground perilla in at the very end, off the fire. This is what thickens a galho and what gives it its fat — there is no ghee here and none is wanted.
method.l: Bhaja pisa nakhup ekdom hekh te, jui bondh kori milabi. Etu he galho gadha kore aru tel dei — iyate ghee nai aru lage bhi nai.

method.en: Keep hot water aside. Galho thickens a great deal as it stands and a doubled count is met by loosening it rather than by cooking more.
method.l: Gorom pani alag rakhibi. Galho rakhile bisi gadha hoi aru manu dugun hoile aru narandhi pathla koribo pare.

recipes.why: One pot, one fire, no oil worth counting, and it stretches with hot water. The cheapest full meal in this book.
recipes.why_l: Ek bortan, ek jui, ginibole tel nai, aru gorom pani pora bare. Ei kitab laga sob pora sosta pura khana.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Start seventy minutes before serving.
start.l: Eku bhijai nalage. Diya age sattar minute suru koribi.

vessel.en: A heavy 50 L vessel. Two cooks.
vessel.l: Bhari 50 L bortan. Dujon randhoni.

season.en: All year, and the one-pot meal of the Angami villages.
season.l: Pura bosor, aru Angami gaon laga ek bortan laga khana.

recipes.name: Rice and Greens Boil
recipes.sub: Rice boiled with whatever green came in
recipes.sub_l: Jun pata paise etu logote siddha bhat

method.en: This is not a recipe so much as a method, and it is what a Naga kitchen does with whatever came down from the terraces that morning.
method.l: Etu recipe pora bisi ek tarika ase, aru khet pora etu puwa jun ahise, Naga rondhon ghor etu logote eneka kore.

method.en: Mustard leaf, pumpkin leaf, colocasia leaf, roselle, fern tips and squash tendrils all work. Keep the tender and the tough separate.
method.l: Lai pata, kumra pata, kacchu pata, tenga pata, dhekia aru lota agor sob cholai. Norom aru tan pata alag rakhibi.

method.en: Wash in three changes of water. Forest greens come in with more grit than anything grown on a bed.
method.l: Tin bar pani bodli kori dhubi. Jongol laga pata bagan laga pora bisi mati loi ahe.

method.en: Cook the tough greens with the rice from the start and add the tender ones in the last five minutes.
method.l: Tan pata suru pora chaul logote rondhibi aru norom pata hekh laga pans minute te halibi.

method.en: Salt it late. Greens salted early collapse and release all their water, and the pot goes grey.
method.l: Nimok deri te dibi. Age nimok dile pata bhangi jai aru pura pani ulai, aru bortan kala hoi jai.

method.en: Stir the roasted ground perilla in off the fire. Without it this is boiled rice and leaves; with it, it is a meal.
method.l: Bhaja pisa nakhup jui bondh kori milabi. Etu nohoile etu khali siddha bhat aru pata ase; etu logote, khana ase.

recipes.why: Costs almost nothing, uses what would otherwise be thrown, and it is what these hills genuinely eat.
recipes.why_l: Prai eku dam nai, jun pheli dibole thakise etu cholai, aru ei pahar te asol te etu he khai.

start.en: Wash the greens three times. Start fifty minutes before serving.
start.l: Pata tin bar dhubi. Diya age pochas minute suru koribi.

vessel.en: A heavy 50 L vessel. One cook.
vessel.l: Bhari 50 L bortan. Ekjon randhoni.

season.en: All year with whatever the forest and the terrace gave.
season.l: Pura bosor, jongol aru khet pora jun paise etu logote.

recipes.name: Bamboo Shoot Rice
recipes.sub: Rice cooked with fermented bamboo shoot
recipes.sub_l: Khomir uthi bahor gaj logote bona bhat

method.en: Rinse the bastenga twice in cold water and squeeze it out. Straight from the jar it is far too sour and it will take over the whole pot.
method.l: Bastenga ke thanda pani te duibar dhui, nisuri lobi. Bortan pora sidha halile etu bisi tenga ase aru pura bortan dhori loi.

method.en: Keep the second rinse water. A little of it goes back in at the end if the rice needs lifting.
method.l: Dusra dhua pani rakhibi. Bhat te olop tenga lagile hekh te etu pora olop wapas dibo pare.

method.en: Fry the drained bastenga in the oil for five minutes before the rice goes in. This takes the raw edge off the ferment.
method.l: Chaul halu age nisura bastenga ke tel te pans minute bhajibi. Etu pora khomir laga kacha swad jai.

method.en: Add the rice and water and cook covered on a low flame twenty minutes.
method.l: Chaul aru pani halibi aru dhaki kori dhimai jui te kudi minute rondhibi.

method.en: Do not add salt until the last five minutes. Bastenga is already salted from the jar and a heavy hand early cannot be taken back.
method.l: Hekh laga pans minute loi nimok nadibi. Bastenga bortan te nimok logote thake aru age bisi dile wapas nahoi.

method.en: Stir the ground perilla in off the fire and rest ten minutes with the lid on.
method.l: Pisa nakhup jui bondh kori milai, dhakni lagai dohh minute rakhibi.

recipes.why: One jar of bastenga turns plain rice into a meal, and the jar keeps a year. Rinse it twice or it takes over.
recipes.why_l: Ek bortan bastenga sadharon bhat ke khana bonai dei, aru bortan ek bosor thake. Duibar dhubi nohoile etu sob dhori loi.

start.en: Rinse the bastenga twice. Start fifty minutes before serving.
start.l: Bastenga duibar dhubi. Diya age pochas minute suru koribi.

vessel.en: A heavy 45 L vessel with a close lid. One cook.
vessel.l: Bhari 45 L bortan aru tan dhakni. Ekjon randhoni.

season.en: All year — bastenga keeps a year in its jar.
season.l: Pura bosor — bastenga nijor bortan te ek bosor thake.

recipes.name: Pumpkin Broth
recipes.sub: Pumpkin cooked down thin with perilla and chilli
recipes.sub_l: Kumra ke nakhup aru mircha logote polka randha

method.en: Keep the skin on if it is a jhum kumra. The skin is what stops fourteen kilos collapsing into a single orange mass.
method.l: Jhum laga kumra hoile chal to rakhibi. Choudda kilo ke ekta komla rong laga dola hobole nadiye to chal he.

method.en: No sugar and no gur. A sarot kumra is sweet on its own and sweetened further it is a mitha in the wrong vessel.
method.l: Chini aru gur eku nai. Sarot laga kumra to nijorei mitha hoi aru aru mitha dile bhul bela te thaka mitha hoi jai.

method.en: Let it fall apart on its own and do not mash it. Kumra mashed with a ladle goes watery within twenty minutes of standing.
method.l: Nijorei bhangi jabole dibi, micha nadibi. Chamos loi micha kumra to bis minute rakhile pani hoi jai.

method.en: Roast the nakhup and crush it in at the end. It is what thickens twenty-six litres with no flour anywhere in it.
method.l: Nakhup to bhaji kene hekh te thecha dibi. Kotina bi gura nadi kene 26 litre ke gadha kora to eitu he.

recipes.why: Four rupees ninety a head, the cheapest wet dish in this book. In sarot a Peren jhum gives more kumra than the kitchen can use and fourteen kilos costs the carrying.
recipes.why_l: Ek manu te sari taka nobbei, eitu boi te sobse sosta jhol laga khana. Sarot te Peren laga jhum pora rasoi te labhoi pora bi bisi kumra hoi, aru choudda kilo laga khoros to bhuka mattro.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Forty minutes from a cold stove.
start.l: Kunu saman bhijai rakha nalage. Thanda chula pora chalis minute.

vessel.en: A 35 L vessel with a lid. One cook.
vessel.l: Dhakoni thaka paitirish litre bela. Ekjon randhoni.

season.en: Sarot to thanda din, from the jhum and then the store room.
season.l: Sarot pora thanda din tak, jhum pora aru tar pasote bhoral pora.

recipes.name: Chayote Broth
recipes.sub: Chayote cooked thin with its leaf and a little perilla
recipes.sub_l: Iskus ke tar pata logote polka randha, olop nakhup diya

method.en: The leaf goes in and it is not a garnish. Three kilos of iskus pata is half the taste of this vessel and a kitchen that throws it is throwing the dish.
method.l: Pata to hala hi, eitu sajai luwa nohoi. Tin kilo iskus pata to eitu bela laga swad laga adha, aru etu phelai diya rasoi pora khana he phelai.

method.en: The iskus goes in first and the leaf in the last four minutes. Cooked together the leaf is the colour of a wet road and the vessel looks boiled twice.
method.l: Iskus to poila hala aru pata to hekh laga sari minute te. Eke logote randhile pata to bhija rasta rong hoi aru bela to duibar ukhalise nisina lage.

method.en: Peel it only if the skin is rough. A young iskus skin is thinner than a kumra and peeling twelve kilos of it wastes an hour and a kilo.
method.l: Chal khosa hoile mattro chilabi. Suku iskus laga chal to kumra pora bi misi hoi aru baro kilo chilaile ek ghanta aru ek kilo nasto hoi.

method.en: Roast the nakhup and crush it in at the end. It is what thickens twenty-six litres with no flour anywhere in it.
method.l: Nakhup to bhaji kene hekh te thecha dibi. Kotina bi gura nadi kene 26 litre ke gadha kora to eitu he.

recipes.why: Five rupees seventy a head. An iskus vine on a Kohima fence gives fruit and leaf for eight months and nobody plants it twice.
recipes.why_l: Ek manu te pas taka sathi. Kohima laga bera te thaka iskus laga lota pora ath mah dhori phol aru pata diye aru kunbi duibar naropai.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Fifty minutes, and the leaf is chopped while the iskus cooks.
start.l: Kunu saman bhijai rakha nalage. Pachas minute, aru iskus randha homoi te pata katibi.

vessel.en: A 35 L vessel with a lid. One cook.
vessel.l: Dhakoni thaka paitirish litre bela. Ekjon randhoni.

season.en: Borokhun to thanda din, off the fence behind the kitchen.
season.l: Borokhun pora thanda din tak, rasoi pisote thaka bera pora.

recipes.name: Mustard Leaf Broth
recipes.sub: Mustard leaves cooked thin with ginger and nothing else
recipes.sub_l: Sorisa pata ke ada logote polka randha, aru kiba nai

method.en: No oil at any point and none is wanted. A Naga jhol is leaf and water and salt, and a spoon of oil turns twenty-four litres into something else.
method.l: Kotina bi tel nai aru lage bi nai. Naga jhol to pata, pani aru nimok he, aru ek chamos tel dile 24 litre to dusra saman hoi jai.

method.en: Cut the stalk in and do not throw it. The stalk is a third of the weight and it goes in eight minutes before the leaf.
method.l: Dala to kati kene hala dibi, phelai nadibi. Dala to gathi laga tin bhag ekta aru pata laga ath minute age te hala.

method.en: Eight minutes on the leaf and no more. Sorisa pata cooked twenty minutes is grey and twenty-four litres of it comes back to the kitchen.
method.l: Pata upor te ath minute mattro, tatu bisi nai. Bis minute randhise sorisa pata to dhusor hoi aru 24 litre to rasoi te wapas ahe.

method.en: Serve it within the half hour. A green jhol in a warm vessel goes from green to grey faster than anything else on this shelf.
method.l: Adha ghanta bhitorte dibi. Gorom bela te hariyali jhol to eitu thak te thaka dusra sob pora bhi joldi hariyali pora dhusor hoi jai.

recipes.why: Three rupees ninety a head, no oil and no dal. In thanda din the pata is fifteen rupees a kilo at Kohima bazar and this is the vessel a Naga house eats four days a week.
recipes.why_l: Ek manu te tin taka nobbei, tel aru dal eku nai. Thanda din te Kohima bazar te sorisa pata to kilo te pandhra taka, aru Naga ghor te hafta te sari din khuwa bela to eitu he.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Twenty-five minutes, and the stalk goes in first.
start.l: Kunu saman bhijai rakha nalage. Pochish minute, aru dala to poila hala.

vessel.en: A 30 L vessel, uncovered. One cook.
vessel.l: Tirish litre bela, dhaki nadi kene. Ekjon randhoni.

season.en: Sarot to gorom din, while the pata is in the market.
season.l: Sarot pora gorom din tak, pata bazar te thaka homoi te.

recipes.name: Colocasia Broth
recipes.sub: Colocasia boiled in its skin and cooked thin with chilli
recipes.sub_l: Kacchu ke chal logote siddha kori kene mircha loi polka randha

method.en: Boil the kacchu in the skin and peel it after. Peeled raw it itches the hands of whoever is cutting and the itch lasts the afternoon.
method.l: Kacchu to chal logote siddha kori kene pasote chilabi. Kacha thaka homoi te chilaile kata manu laga hath khajuwai aru etu khajuwani to dupor tak thake.

method.en: Break the pieces by hand and do not cut them. A knife-cut kacchu holds its edges and the jhol never takes hold of it.
