method.l: Tukra khan hath loi bhangibi, churi loi nakatibi. Churi loi kata kacchu to tar dhar dhori thake aru jhol pora kotina bi dhoribole napare.

method.en: Perilla and not coconut. It grows on the hills here and it is what thickens twenty-six litres with no flour in it.
method.l: Nakhup, narikol nohoi. Eitu ithote thaka pahar te hoi aru gura nadi kene 26 litre ke gadha kora to eitu he.

method.en: Keep it thin. A kacchu jhol is drunk off the plate at the end of the meal and a thick one sits in the stomach for the afternoon.
method.l: Polka rakhibi. Kacchu jhol to khana laga hekh te thali pora khai aru gadha hoile dupor bhori pet te thake.

recipes.why: Six rupees fifty a head. Kacchu grows in the wet corner behind every Naga kitchen and nobody plants it; in sarot fourteen kilos costs less than a kilo of paneer.
recipes.why_l: Ek manu te sou taka pachas. Naga rasoi sob laga pisote thaka bhija kone te kacchu hoi aru kunbi naropai; sarot te choudda kilo laga daam ek kilo paneer pora bi kom.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Fifty minutes, most of it boiling and peeling.
start.l: Kunu saman bhijai rakha nalage. Pachas minute, tar bisi bhag to siddha kora aru chilai.

vessel.en: A boiling pot and a 35 L vessel. Two cooks for the peeling.
vessel.l: Ukhalibole bela aru paitirish litre bela. Chilaibole duijon randhoni.

season.en: Sarot to thanda din, out of the ground behind the kitchen.
season.l: Sarot pora thanda din tak, rasoi pisote thaka mati pora.

recipes.name: Boiled White Beans
recipes.sub: White beans boiled dry and turned with chilli and sesame
recipes.sub_l: Boga guti ke sukha siddha kori kene mircha aru til loi mosala

method.en: Soak them twelve hours and boil them until they are soft but whole. This is a siddha and not a jhol; a broken bean has no place in the tray.
method.l: Baro ghanta bhijai rakhi kene molom hoi jai kintu pura thake tak ukhalibi. Eitu siddha, jhol nohoi; phata guti laga jaga tray te nai.

method.en: Drain them completely and keep the water for a jhol. Four kilos of boga guti leaves three litres of dark water and that water is a vessel of its own.
method.l: Pani to puri jhari dibi aru etu pani to jhol karone rakhibi. Sari kilo boga guti pora tin litre kala pani thake aru etu pani nijorei ekta bela hoi.

method.en: Roast the mircha on the flame and crush it in the hand. A powder gives heat only; the pieces are what a Naga tray is looked at for.
method.l: Mircha to jui upor te bhaji kene hath loi thecha dibi. Gura pora jhaal mattro diye; Naga tray te sabole thaka to tukra khan he.

method.en: Salt only after the bean is soft. Salted early, a boga guti hardens and no amount of time brings it back.
method.l: Guti molom howa pasote mattro nimok dibi. Age te nimok dile boga guti to tan hoi jai aru kotona homoi dile bi wapas nahe.

recipes.why: Nine rupees twenty a head, and the three litres of bean water that comes off it is a second vessel for nothing. Four kilos of boga guti feeds a hundred.
recipes.why_l: Ek manu te no taka bis, aru tar pora ulai juwa tin litre guti pani to khoros nathaka dusra bela hoi. Sari kilo boga guti pora ek sou manu khai.

start.en: Beans soak twelve hours. Start the evening before.
start.l: Guti khan baro ghanta bhijai. Age din laga sanjote suru koribi.

vessel.en: A boiling pot, a draining basket and a wide tray. One cook.
vessel.l: Ukhalibole bela, pani jharibole tukri aru chaura tray. Ekjon randhoni.

season.en: Sarot to gorom din, out of the granary.
season.l: Sarot pora gorom din tak, bhoral pora.

recipes.name: Kuttu ki Puri
recipes.sub: Buckwheat puri for fasting days
recipes.sub_l: Ekadashi laga kuttu laga puri

method.en: This observance came with the temple rather than from the hills, and every ingredient on this page is brought in from outside Nagaland. It is worth saying so on the menu.
method.l: Ei niyom pahar pora nohoi mandir logote ahise, aru ei pata laga hodai saman Nagaland bahar pora ahe. Menu te etu likha thik ase.

method.en: Buckwheat has no gluten, so the dough has nothing holding it together. Boiled mashed potato does that job — roughly one part potato to two of flour.
method.l: Kuttu te lesa nai, etu karone ata te bandhi rakha eku nai. Siddha ghosa alu etu kaam kore — prai ek bhag alu, dui bhag ata.

method.en: Use cold boiled potato, grated rather than mashed, so no lumps go into the dough.
method.l: Thanda siddha alu, ghosa, ghosi nohoi, eneka hoile ata te dola nohoi.

method.en: Knead with as little water as possible, greasing the palms with ghee. The dough must be firm.
method.l: Jiman komti pani hobo pare, hath te ghee lagai lobi. Ata tan hobo lage.

method.en: Do not let it stand. Kuttu dough turns slack within twenty minutes, so roll and fry as you go.
method.l: Rakhi nadibi. Kuttu laga ata kudi minute te dhila hoi jai, etu karone bela aru bhaji thakibi.

method.en: Fry in medium-hot ghee. Kuttu browns faster than wheat and needs a lower flame than an ordinary puri.
method.l: Majot gorom ghee te bhajibi. Kuttu gehu pora joldi rangoli hoi aru sadharon puri pora dhimai jui lage.

recipes.why: The dough is the whole difficulty, and everything here is bought in rather than grown.
recipes.why_l: Pura kotin kotha ata te ase, aru iyate sob kina saman ase, khet laga nohoi.

start.en: Boil and cool the potatoes first. Start seventy minutes before serving.
start.l: Prothom alu siddha kori thanda koribi. Diya age sattar minute suru koribi.

vessel.en: Two deep kadhais and a rolling board. Three cooks.
vessel.l: Duita gobhir kadhai aru bela laga taktar. Tinjon randhoni.

season.en: Ekadashi and Navratri only.
season.l: Khali Ekadashi aru Navratri.

recipes.name: Samak ke Chawal
recipes.sub: Barnyard millet cooked like rice
recipes.sub_l: Bhat nisina bona samak

method.en: Rinse the samak and drain it well, then let it stand twenty minutes. Wet grain in hot ghee steams and turns the vessel sticky.
method.l: Samak dhui bhal kori pani ulai, titia kudi minute rakhibi. Bhija dana gorom ghee te bhap hoi aru bortan lasa kore.

method.en: Use two parts water to one of grain, not three. Samak swells more and takes less water than it looks.
method.l: Dana laga ek bhag te dui bhag pani, tin nohoi. Samak bisi phule aru dikha pora komti pani loi.

method.en: Temper the cumin in ghee, add the ginger and green chilli, then the drained samak and fry two minutes.
method.l: Ghee te jeera dibi, aduwa aru kesa jaluk halibi, titia pani ulai diya samak halikori dui minute bhajibi.

method.en: Add water and rock salt, bring to a boil, cover, and cook twelve minutes on the lowest flame.
method.l: Pani aru sendha nimok halibi, uthai lobi, dhaki kori, bisi dhimai jui te bara minute rondhibi.

method.en: Rest ten minutes with the lid on before opening. Stirred hot, samak becomes paste faster than any rice.
method.l: Khula age dhakni lagai dohh minute rakhibi. Gorom te ghurale samak hodai bhat pora joldi lasa hoi jai.

method.en: Fork through the crushed peanut, coriander and lemon just before serving.
method.l: Diya age loge loge bhanga badam, dhonia pata aru kaji nemu kata pora milabi.

recipes.why: Twelve minutes and it feeds a fasting hall. The only trap is treating it like rice and drowning it.
recipes.why_l: Bara minute te upobas laga pura hall khilai. Ekmatra bhul etu ke bhat bhabi pani te dubai diya.

start.en: Rinse and drain twenty minutes before cooking. Start forty minutes before serving.
start.l: Rondha age kudi minute dhui pani ulabi. Diya age salish minute suru koribi.

vessel.en: A heavy 30 L vessel with a close lid. One cook.
vessel.l: Bhari 30 L bortan aru tan dhakni. Ekjon randhoni.

season.en: Ekadashi and Navratri only.
season.l: Khali Ekadashi aru Navratri.

recipes.name: Vrat ke Aloo
recipes.sub: Potato with cumin and rock salt
recipes.sub_l: Jeera aru sendha nimok diya alu

method.en: Boil the potatoes the day before and chill them. Cold potato breaks into clean pieces; warm potato mashes at a touch.
method.l: Alu ek din age siddha kori thanda koribi. Thanda alu bhal tukra hoi bhange; gorom alu chuile ghosi jai.

method.en: Break them by hand rather than cutting — torn faces hold the tempering.
method.l: Kata nohoi hath pora bhangabi — bhanga jagate masala dhori loi.

method.en: Temper a generous quantity of cumin in ghee. On a fasting day there is no asafoetida, so cumin carries the dish alone.
method.l: Ghee te bisi jeera dibi. Upobas din te hing nai, etu karone jeera he sob dhori loi.

method.en: Add the ginger and green chilli, then the chopped tomato, and cook until it collapses.
method.l: Aduwa aru kesa jaluk halibi, titia kata bilahi, aru gali juwa loi rondhibi.

method.en: Add the potato with rock salt and crushed pepper and turn with a flat ladle rather than stirring.
method.l: Alu ke sendha nimok aru bhanga kala jaluk logote halibi aru ghurai nohoi samatal hatai pora ulta koribi.

method.en: Add a little hot water if it looks dry and finish with coriander and lemon off the fire.
method.l: Sukha lagile olop gorom pani dibi aru jui bondh kori dhonia pata aru kaji nemu halibi.

recipes.why: Rock salt only, no asafoetida, and cumin doing all the work.
recipes.why_l: Khali sendha nimok, hing nai, aru jeera he sob kaam kore.

start.en: Boil the potatoes the evening before. Start forty minutes before serving.
start.l: Alu ek din age siddha koribi. Diya age salish minute suru koribi.

vessel.en: A wide 30 L kadhai. One cook.
vessel.l: Chaura 30 L kadhai. Ekjon randhoni.

season.en: Ekadashi and Navratri only.
season.l: Khali Ekadashi aru Navratri.

recipes.name: Singhare ka Halwa
recipes.sub: Water chestnut flour halwa
recipes.sub_l: Singhara ata laga halwa

method.en: Roast the singhara flour in ghee on a low flame for a full thirty minutes. It is heavier than semolina and takes longer to lose its raw smell.
method.l: Singhara ata ke ghee te dhimai jui te pura tirish minute bhajibi. Etu suji pora bhari ase aru kacha gundh jabole bisi somoi loi.

method.en: It is ready when it turns pinkish-brown and smells sweet. Under-roasted it tastes chalky and sits heavy.
method.l: Tiar ase jetia etu golapi-rangoli hoi aru mitha gundh dei. Komti bhajile etu kacha lage aru bhari hoi.

method.en: Stir constantly. Singhara flour is fine and catches on the bottom faster than semolina.
method.l: Hodai ghurai thakibi. Singhara ata misi ase aru suji pora joldi tolote lage.

method.en: Boil the water and sugar separately and keep the syrup at a rolling boil.
method.l: Pani aru chini alag uthai, syrup ke jor uthi thaka rakhibi.

method.en: Pour the boiling syrup into the roasted flour and stand back. Syrup that is not boiling lumps the halwa instantly.
method.l: Uthi thaka syrup ke bhaja ata te dhalibi aru pichote hatibi. Nauthi thaka syrup loge loge halwa te dola bonai.

method.en: Stir until the ghee separates, then fold in cardamom and nuts and cover five minutes off the fire.
method.l: Ghee alag nohua loi ghurabi, titia elaichi aru badam milai jui bondh kori pans minute dhakibi.

recipes.why: The fasting sweet that does not feel like a compromise, provided the flour is properly roasted.
recipes.why_l: Upobas laga mitha jun komti nalage, jodi ata thik kori bhajise.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Start sixty minutes before serving.
start.l: Eku bhijai nalage. Diya age saathh minute suru koribi.

vessel.en: A wide 40 L kadhai. One cook who does not leave it.
vessel.l: Chaura 40 L kadhai. Ekjon randhoni jun nahate.

season.en: Ekadashi and Navratri only.
season.l: Khali Ekadashi aru Navratri.

recipes.name: Sabudana Khichdi
recipes.sub: Sago soaked to the grain and turned with groundnut and potato
recipes.sub_l: Sabudana ke guti guti hobole bhijai, badam aru alu loi mosala

method.en: Wash the sabudana three times and soak it in water that only just covers it. Sago under two inches of water is a paste by morning.
method.l: Sabudana to tinbar dhui kene taike dhaka mattro pani te bhijai rakhibi. Dui inch pani laga niche te thaka sabudana to bhore tak dola hoi jai.

method.en: Six hours is enough here and not the overnight the plains use. A longer soak makes it wetter and a wet sabudana will not separate.
method.l: Ithote sou ghanta he tho, samtal desh khan pora kora raat bharikhon nalage. Bisi homoi bhijaile bisi bhija hoi aru bhija sabudana to alag nohobo.

method.en: Roast the badam, skin it and crush it coarse. Whole groundnut rolls off the spoon and the crushed part stops the sago sticking.
method.l: Badam to bhaji, chal sarai kene mota kore thecha dibi. Pura badam to chamos pora ghurai pore aru thecha diya bhag pora sabudana lagi juwa rukhai.

method.en: Rock salt only and taste it at the pan. On a fast day the difference matters to the devotee even where it does not to the cook.
method.l: Sendha nimok mattro, aru kadai te he swad sabi. Upobas laga din te randhoni karone eitu bhed nathakile bi bhokot karone eitu asol kotha.

recipes.why: Twenty-one rupees sixty a head. It is the Ekadashi dish a Dimapur kitchen can make with nothing that grew on a jhum, which matters in thanda din.
recipes.why_l: Ek manu te ekhis taka sathi. Jhum te nahua saman eku nadi kene Dimapur rasoi pora banabole para Ekadashi laga khana to eitu he, aru thanda din te eitu asol kotha.

start.en: Sago soaks six hours in barely enough water. Start before dawn for a noon meal.
start.l: Sabudana to lagi thaka mattro pani te sou ghanta bhijai. Dupor laga khana karone bhore howa age te suru koribi.

vessel.en: A wide 25 L kadai and a soaking tray. Two cooks.
vessel.l: Chaura pachis litre kadai aru bhijai rakhibole tray. Duijon randhoni.

season.en: All year, on every Ekadashi.
season.l: Pura bochor, Ekadashi sob te.

recipes.name: Makhana Kheer
recipes.sub: Fox nuts roasted in ghee and cooked down in milk
recipes.sub_l: Makhana ke ghee te bhaji kene gakhir te randha

method.en: Roast the makhana in ghee until it snaps between the fingers. Unroasted it turns to sponge in the milk and there is nothing to chew.
method.l: Makhana to angoli majote phata tak ghee te bhajibi. Bhaja nathakile gakhir te sponge hoi jai aru sabole kiba nathake.

method.en: Break half of it coarse and leave half whole. The broken half thickens the vessel and the whole half is what is eaten.
method.l: Tar adha to mota kore bhangibi aru adha to pura rakhibi. Bhanga adha pora bela ke gadha kore aru pura adha to khabole hoi.

method.en: Reduce the milk by a fifth before the makhana goes in. Makhana in cold milk drinks it up and the vessel never thickens on its own.
method.l: Makhana hala age te gakhir ke pas bhag ekta homai lobi. Thanda gakhir te makhana dile sob suse aru bela to nijorei gadha nohoi.

method.en: Sugar in the last ten minutes only. Added early it stops the makhana softening and it stays rubbery through the vessel.
method.l: Chini to hekh laga dosh minute te mattro. Age te dile makhana molom hobole nadiye aru pura bela te rubber nisina thake.

recipes.why: Thirty-six rupees fifty a head. Makhana is dear but a kilo and a half does twenty litres, and on a Nirjala Ekadashi it is the only sweet the hall can be given.
recipes.why_l: Ek manu te chattis taka pachas. Makhana to dami hoi kintu ek kilo adha pora bis litre hoi, aru Nirjala Ekadashi te hall ke dibole para mitha to eitu mattro.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Ninety minutes from a cold stove.
start.l: Kunu saman bhijai rakha nalage. Thanda chula pora nobboi minute.

vessel.en: A heavy 30 L vessel. One cook who does not leave it.
vessel.l: Bhari tirish litre bela. Ekjon randhoni, tai eitu chari najabo.

season.en: All year, and on Nirjala Ekadashi above all.
season.l: Pura bochor, aru Nirjala Ekadashi te bisi kori.

recipes.name: Vrat ki Kadhi
recipes.sub: Curd thickened with water chestnut flour instead of gram
recipes.sub_l: Besan laga bodli singhara gura loi gadha kora dahi

method.en: Singhara flour in place of the besan, and it behaves differently. It thickens twice as fast and half as much is needed.
method.l: Besan laga bodli singhara gura, aru tar kaam alag. Duigun joldi gadha hoi aru adha he lage.

method.en: Whisk the flour into cold curd and get every lump out before any heat. A lump that reaches hot kadhi never breaks up again.
method.l: Gura to thanda dahi te mila kene gorom nadi kene sob dola ulai dibi. Gorom kadhi te puwa dola to aru kotina bi nabhangibo.

method.en: Stir in one direction until it comes to the boil, then leave it. A kadhi splits in the first four minutes or not at all.
method.l: Ukhala tak ek zonote ghurabi, tar pasote chari dibi. Kadhi to poila sari minute te phate, nohoile kotina bi nohoi.

method.en: Rock salt after the boil and not before. Salted curd on the way up splits eight kilos before the vessel is warm.
method.l: Ukhala pasote sendha nimok dibi, age te nohoi. Uthi thaka homoi te nimok diya dahi to bela gorom howa age te ath kilo ke phatai diye.

recipes.why: Sixteen rupees fifty a head, and it is the only wet dish a Dimapur kitchen can put out on Ekadashi. A plate of sabudana and puri needs one.
recipes.why_l: Ek manu te sula taka pachas, aru Ekadashi te Dimapur rasoi pora dibole para jhol laga khana to eitu mattro. Sabudana aru puri laga thali te ekta lage.

start.en: The curd should be a day old and sour. Set it the morning before. Fifty minutes on the day.
start.l: Dahi to ek din puran aru tenga hobole lage. Age din laga bhore te jomabi. Etu din te pachas minute.

vessel.en: A 30 L vessel and a tempering pan. One cook who does not leave it.
vessel.l: Tirish litre bela aru phoron laga kadai. Ekjon randhoni, tai eitu chari najabo.

season.en: All year, on every Ekadashi.
season.l: Pura bochor, Ekadashi sob te.

recipes.name: Sabudana Kheer
recipes.sub: Sago pearls cooked slow in milk with cardamom
recipes.sub_l: Sabudana guti ke gakhir te dhire dhire randha, elaichi diya

method.en: A kilo and a half in eighteen litres and no more. Sago swells to five times its weight and two kilos is a vessel that cannot be poured.
method.l: Athara litre te ek kilo adha mattro, tatu bisi nai. Sabudana to tar gathi laga pas gun phuli jai aru dui kilo dile bela to hala nadibole para hoi.

method.en: Wash it three times and add it dry to the boiling milk. Soaked sago in milk goes to a single lump that no ladle will break.
method.l: Tinbar dhui kene sukha thaka homoi te ukhala gakhir te hala dibi. Bhijai diya sabudana to gakhir te ekta dola hoi jai aru kunu chamos pora bi bhangibole napare.

method.en: Stir the bottom every three minutes. Sago sinks and eighteen litres of milk burns under it with no smell reaching the cook.
method.l: Tin minute pisote tolote ghurai dibi. Sabudana to tolote bohi jai aru athara litre gakhir tar tolote juli jai, randhoni tak gonda bi napai.

method.en: Sugar in the last ten minutes. Added early, the pearl stays hard at the centre and the whole vessel is gritty.
method.l: Chini to hekh laga dosh minute te. Age te dile guti to majote tan thake aru pura bela to balu nisina hoi.

recipes.why: Twenty-six rupees ninety a head. It is the one Ekadashi sweet a Dimapur kitchen can put out for a full hall, and a kilo and a half of sago does it.
recipes.why_l: Ek manu te chabbis taka nobbei. Pura hall karone Dimapur rasoi pora dibole para Ekadashi laga mitha to eitu ekta he, aru ek kilo adha sabudana pora hoi jai.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Ninety minutes from a cold stove.
start.l: Kunu saman bhijai rakha nalage. Thanda chula pora nobboi minute.

vessel.en: A heavy 30 L vessel. One cook who does not leave it.
vessel.l: Bhari tirish litre bela. Ekjon randhoni, tai eitu chari najabo.

season.en: All year, on every Ekadashi.
season.l: Pura bochor, Ekadashi sob te.

recipes.name: Bamboo Shoot Fritters
recipes.sub: Fresh bamboo shoot in rice flour batter
recipes.sub_l: Chaul gura laga ghol te notun bahor gaj

method.en: Fresh bamboo shoot must be boiled twice in fresh water, twenty minutes each time, and the water thrown away both times.
method.l: Notun bahor gaj ke notun pani te duibar, hodai bar kudi minute uthabo lage, aru duiyo bar pani pheliya dibo lage.

method.en: This is not optional. Raw bamboo shoot contains a compound that is genuinely toxic, and it is the boiling and discarding that removes it.
method.l: Etu chari bole napare. Kacha bahor gaj te ek bostu ase jun asol te bikh ase, aru uthai pani pheliya diya pora he etu jai.

method.en: Peel down to the pale tender core and slice thin. Anything that resists the knife is too old and goes on the fire, not in the pot.
method.l: Bhitor laga norom sada bhag loi chal chulai pathla kori katibi. Churi te tan lagile etu purana ase aru etu jui te jabo, bortan te nohoi.

method.en: Use rice flour with a quarter part besan. Rice flour is what keeps a Naga fritter crisp; all besan gives a soft plains pakora.
method.l: Chaul gura logote sari bhag laga ek besan lobi. Chaul gura he Naga bhaji ke kurkuri rakhe; khali besan dile plains laga norom pakora hoi.

method.en: Beat air into the batter by hand for three minutes and keep it thick enough to coat without dripping.
method.l: Ghol ke hath pora tin minute fetibi aru iman gadha rakhibi ki nagirai chipke.

method.en: Fry at a steady medium heat and drain on mesh, never in a heap.
method.l: Sthir majot jui te bhajibi aru jali te ulabi, dhup kori kitia bhi nohoi.

recipes.why: Boil it twice or do not cook it at all. After that it is the cheapest snack in these hills for four months.
recipes.why_l: Duibar uthabi nohoile eku norandhi bi. Etu pichote char mahina ei pahar laga sob pora sosta namkin ase.

start.en: Boil the fresh shoot twice, an hour ahead. Start eighty minutes before serving.
start.l: Notun gaj duibar uthabi, ek ghonta age. Diya age assi minute suru koribi.

vessel.en: Three deep kadhais. Three cooks.
vessel.l: Tinta gobhir kadhai. Tinjon randhoni.

season.en: June to September, while the fresh shoots are coming up.
season.l: June pora September loi, jetia notun gaj ulai.

recipes.name: Colocasia Leaf Fritters
recipes.sub: Taro leaves in rice flour batter
recipes.sub_l: Chaul gura laga ghol te kacchu pata

method.en: Use only young leaves, still pale and soft. An older colocasia leaf makes the throat itch however long it is cooked, and no batter hides it.
method.l: Khali kesa pata lobi, jun etiya loi halka aru norom ase. Purana kacchu pata kiman rondhile bhi gola khujli kore, aru kunba ghol pora nadhake.

method.en: Add lemon juice to the batter rather than to the finished fritter. The acid is what neutralises the crystals that cause the itch.
method.l: Kaji nemu laga rosh ghol te dibi, bona bhaji te nohoi. Etu tenga pora he khujli kora bostu marise.

method.en: Wash the leaves and dry them completely on cloth before cutting. Wet leaves slide out of the batter in the oil.
method.l: Pata dhui, kata age kapor te pura sukhabi. Bhija pata tel te ghol pora phichli jai.

method.en: Strip out the thick central vein of each leaf and roll the halves together into a tight cigar before slicing.
method.l: Hodai pata laga majot laga mota naar ulai, adha duita eke logote tan kori bandhi katibi.

method.en: Use rice flour with a quarter part besan, and beat air into the batter for three minutes.
method.l: Chaul gura logote sari bhag laga ek besan lobi, aru ghol ke tin minute fetibi.

method.en: Fry at a steady medium heat until the edges are crisp, and taste one before the batch goes out.
method.l: Sthir majot jui te kinar kurkuri nohua loi bhajibi, aru bahar ulai age ekta chaki lobi.

recipes.why: Young leaves and lemon in the batter. Get either wrong and the whole hall complains of an itching throat.
recipes.why_l: Kesa pata aru ghol te kaji nemu. Ekta bhi bhul hoile pura hall te gola khujli laga kotha hobo.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Start sixty minutes before serving.
start.l: Eku bhijai nalage. Diya age saathh minute suru koribi.

vessel.en: Three deep kadhais. Three cooks.
vessel.l: Tinta gobhir kadhai. Tinjon randhoni.

season.en: June to October, while the leaves are young.
season.l: June pora October loi, jetia pata kesa thake.

recipes.name: Rice Flour Crisps
recipes.sub: Thin fried rice crackers
recipes.sub_l: Pathla bhaja chaul laga papor

method.en: Cook the rice flour with boiling water into a stiff dough, beating it hard. It must be cooked through at this stage — a raw dough gives a crisp that stays chalky.
method.l: Chaul gura ke uthi thaka pani logote tan ata bonabi, jor pora fetibi. Iyate he pura rondhibo lage — kacha ata dile papor kacha thake.

method.en: Roll or press it very thin between sheets and steam ten minutes.
method.l: Duita sheet majote bisi pathla bela nohoile dabai, dohh minute bhap dibi.

method.en: Dry the steamed sheets in full sun for two days until they snap cleanly. In a damp week they will not dry, and a half-dry crisp will not puff.
method.l: Bhap diya sheet ke pura roud te duita din sukhabi jetia loi bhal kori bhange. Bhija hoptah te etu nasukhe, aru adha sukha papor phule nai.

method.en: This is why they are made in the dry season. Nagaland has a long monsoon and there is no point attempting these in July.
method.l: Etu karone sukha mahina te bonai. Nagaland te lamba borikhon ase aru July te etu kori labh nai.

method.en: Store the dried sheets in a tin with a lid. They keep months undried and are fried as needed.
method.l: Sukha sheet ke dhakni thaka bortan te rakhibi. Etu mahina thake aru dorkar hoile bhaji lobo pare.

method.en: Fry in hot oil for a few seconds only — they puff at once. Drain and cool completely before tinning.
method.l: Gorom tel te kisu second he bhajibi — etu loge loge phule. Ulai kori bortan te halu age pura thanda koribi.

recipes.why: Dried sheets keep for months and fry in seconds. The one thing in this book that can be prepared far in advance.
recipes.why_l: Sukha sheet mahina thake aru second te bhaji jai. Ei kitab te bisi age bonai rakhibole para ekmatra saman.

start.en: Steam and dry the sheets two days ahead. Frying takes an hour.
start.l: Sheet duita din age bhap dikori sukhabi. Bhajibole ek ghonta lage.

vessel.en: A steamer, drying trays and two kadhais. Two cooks.
vessel.l: Bhap bortan, sukhai laga tray aru duita kadhai. Dujon randhoni.

season.en: Made in the dry months, October to March.
season.l: Sukha mahina te bonai, October pora March loi.

recipes.name: Mustard Leaf Fritters
recipes.sub: Whole mustard leaves dipped in a thin besan batter and fried
recipes.sub_l: Pura sorisa pata ke polka besan gura te lagai kene bhaja

method.en: Take whole leaves with the stalk left on. The stalk is the handle for dipping and it comes off in the mouth without anyone noticing.
method.l: Dala thaki thaka pura pata loi lobi. Dala to lagai lobole hath dhora jaga aru kunbi najani kene mukh te ulai jai.

method.en: Dry every leaf on a cloth before dipping. A wet leaf slides out of the batter in the oil and fries as a bare leaf.
method.l: Lagai nadi kene pata sob kapor te sukhai lobi. Bhija pata to tel te gura pora hukhi jai aru khali pata nisina bhaji jai.

method.en: A handful of chaul gura in the batter is what makes the coat crisp. Besan alone gives a soft skin that goes limp in ten minutes.
method.l: Gura te ek muthi chaul gura dile tar chal to kurkuri hoi. Besan mattro dile molom chal hoi aru dosh minute te molai jai.

method.en: Fry in lots of forty and strain the oil between them. Bits that fall off the first lot burn and colour every bhaji after them.
method.l: Ekbar te chalis kori bhajibi aru majote tel to chani dibi. Poila lot pora pori juwa tukra khan juli jai aru tar pasote bhaji sob laga rong bigarai diye.

recipes.why: Twelve rupees ninety a head. Sorisa pata is the cheapest green at Kohima bazar from sarot to gorom din and four kilos of it becomes eight hundred bhaji.
recipes.why_l: Ek manu te bara taka nobbei. Sarot pora gorom din tak Kohima bazar te sorisa pata he sobse sosta hariyali, aru sari kilo pora ath sou bhaji hoi.

start.en: Nothing soaks. The batter rests fifteen minutes. Ninety minutes in all.
start.l: Kunu saman bhijai rakha nalage. Gura to pandhra minute rakhibi. Sob milai nobboi minute.

vessel.en: A deep kadai and a strainer. Two cooks — one dips, one fries.
vessel.l: Gobhir kadai aru chani. Duijon randhoni — ekjon lagai, ekjon bhaji.

season.en: Sarot to gorom din, while the pata is in the market.
season.l: Sarot pora gorom din tak, pata bazar te thaka homoi te.

recipes.name: Pumpkin Fritters
recipes.sub: Pumpkin grated, squeezed dry and fried in a thick batter
recipes.sub_l: Kumra kasi kene sipi sukhai, gadha gura te bhaja

method.en: Grate, salt and leave twenty minutes, then squeeze with both hands. Five kilos gives up a litre and it has to come out or the batter will not hold.
method.l: Kasi, nimok dibi aru bis minute rakhibi, tar pasote dui hath loi sipi dibi. Pas kilo pora ek litre ulai aru eitu ulai jabole lage; nohoile gura pora dhoribole napare.

method.en: No water at all in the batter. The kumra gives up enough after the squeezing and any added is a bhaji that will not hold together.
method.l: Gura te eku pani nai. Sipa pasote kumra pora tho ulai aru aru pani dile bhaji to eke logote nathakibo.

method.en: Drop them in with the fingers and not a spoon. A kumra bhaji should be ragged; a neat ball of it fries raw in the middle.
method.l: Chamos loi nohoi, angoli loi hala dibi. Kumra bhaji to bemela hobole lage; sundor dola bonaile majote kacha bhaji jai.

method.en: Fry on a medium flame right through. Pumpkin needs longer than a mustard leaf and a hot kadai browns the outside while the inside is still raw.
method.l: Hekh tak majhiya jui te bhajibi. Kumra to sorisa pata pora bisi homoi lage aru gorom kadai pora bhitorte kacha thaka homoi te bahar to mati rong kore.

recipes.why: Twelve rupees a head, and in sarot the kumra is the cheapest thing on a Peren cart. This is the tray a kitchen can put out at no notice.
recipes.why_l: Ek manu te barota taka, aru sarot te Peren laga gari te kumra he sobse sosta. Age pora nakoi kene rasoi pora dibole para tray to eitu he.

start.en: Grate and salt twenty minutes ahead for the squeezing. Ninety minutes in all.
start.l: Sipa karone bis minute age te kasi kene nimok dibi. Sob milai nobboi minute.

vessel.en: A grater, a colander and a deep kadai. Two cooks.
vessel.l: Kasoni, pani jharibole jali aru gobhir kadai. Duijon randhoni.

season.en: Sarot to thanda din, from the jhum and then the store room.
season.l: Sarot pora thanda din tak, jhum pora aru tar pasote bhoral pora.

recipes.name: Potato Fritters
recipes.sub: Potato rounds in a thin besan batter, fried to order
recipes.sub_l: Alu laga chakti ke polka besan gura te, mangise homoi te bhaja

method.en: Slice the alu thin and hold the rounds in cold water until the kadai is hot. Cut potato left dry goes black at the edge within twenty minutes.
method.l: Alu to misi kori katibi aru kadai gorom howa tak chakti khan thanda pani te rakhibi. Sukha rakha kata alu to bis minute te tar dhar te kala hoi jai.

method.en: Dry every round on a cloth before it meets the batter. A wet round slides out of the batter in the oil and fries bare.
method.l: Gura te lagai nadi kene chakti sob kapor te sukhai lobi. Bhija chakti to tel te gura pora hukhi jai aru khali he bhaji jai.

method.en: A pinch of hing in the batter. In a kitchen with no onion it is the only thing standing where the onion would.
method.l: Gura te olop hing. Pyaj nathaka rasoi te pyaj laga jagate thiya thaka saman to eitu mattro.

method.en: Fry in lots of forty and strain the oil between them. Bits that fall off the first lot burn and colour every bhaji after them.
method.l: Ekbar te chalis kori bhajibi aru majote tel to chani dibi. Poila lot pora pori juwa tukra khan juli jai aru tar pasote bhaji sob laga rong bigarai diye.

recipes.why: Thirteen rupees sixty a head. Alu is in a Dimapur store room every month of the year, and eight bhaji with a chah holds a devotee to the evening prasad.
recipes.why_l: Ek manu te tera taka sathi. Bochor laga mah sob te Dimapur bhoral te alu thake, aru ath bhaji aru ek cup chah pora bhokot ke sanjor prasad tak dhori rakhe.

start.en: Nothing soaks. The batter rests fifteen minutes. Ninety minutes in all.
start.l: Kunu saman bhijai rakha nalage. Gura to pandhra minute rakhibi. Sob milai nobboi minute.

vessel.en: A deep kadai, a holding pot of cold water and a strainer. Two cooks.
vessel.l: Gobhir kadai, thanda pani thaka bela aru chani. Duijon randhoni.

season.en: All year, and the thanda din counter bhaji when the greens have gone.
season.l: Pura bochor, aru hariyali hera juwa thanda din laga bhaji.

recipes.name: Chayote Fritters
recipes.sub: Chayote grated with its leaf and fried in a thick batter
recipes.sub_l: Iskus ke tar pata logote kasi kene gadha gura te bhaja

method.en: Grate the iskus and chop the leaf fine. The leaf holds the batter together and without it seven hundred bhaji fall apart in the oil.
method.l: Iskus to kasibi aru pata to misi kori katibi. Pata pora gura ke eke logote dhori rakhe aru eitu nathakile sat sou bhaji to tel te bhangi jai.

method.en: Grate, salt and squeeze twenty minutes ahead. Five kilos of iskus gives up a litre and a wet batter cannot be dropped in oil at all.
method.l: Bis minute age te kasi, nimok di kene sipi dibi. Pas kilo iskus pora ek litre ulai aru bhija gura to tel te kotina bi hala nadibole lage.

method.en: Drop them with the fingers and not a spoon. An iskus bhaji should be ragged; a neat ball of it fries raw in the middle.
method.l: Chamos loi nohoi, angoli loi hala dibi. Iskus bhaji to bemela hobole lage; sundor dola bonaile majote kacha bhaji jai.

method.en: Fry on a medium flame right through. Iskus carries more water than a kumra and a hot kadai browns the outside while the inside is wet.
method.l: Hekh tak majhiya jui te bhajibi. Iskus te kumra pora bisi pani thake aru gorom kadai pora bhitorte bhija thaka homoi te bahar to mati rong kore.

recipes.why: Eleven rupees sixty a head. An iskus vine on a Kohima fence gives fruit and leaf for eight months and both of them go into this batter.
recipes.why_l: Ek manu te egaro taka sathi. Kohima laga bera te thaka iskus laga lota pora ath mah dhori phol aru pata diye aru duita bi eitu gura te jai.

start.en: Grate and salt twenty minutes ahead. Ninety minutes in all.
start.l: Bis minute age te kasi kene nimok dibi. Sob milai nobboi minute.

vessel.en: A grater, a colander and a deep kadai. Two cooks.
vessel.l: Kasoni, pani jharibole jali aru gobhir kadai. Duijon randhoni.

season.en: Borokhun to thanda din, off the fence behind the kitchen.
season.l: Borokhun pora thanda din tak, rasoi pisote thaka bera pora.

recipes.name: Sweetcorn Fritters
recipes.sub: Sweetcorn crushed coarse and fried as fritters with no besan
recipes.sub_l: Makai ke mota kore thecha kene besan nadi kene bhaja

method.en: Crush two thirds of the kernels and leave a third whole. The crushed part binds and the whole part is what a makai bhaji is asked for.
method.l: Guti laga tin bhag duita thecha dibi aru tin bhag ekta pura rakhibi. Thecha diya bhag pora bandhe aru pura bhag karone he manu pora makai bhaji mange.

method.en: No besan at all. Sweetcorn has enough starch of its own and six hundred grams of chaul gura is only there to steady the drop.
method.l: Besan eku nai. Makai te tar nijor mar tho thake aru sou sou gram chaul gura to hala diya to thik rakhibole mattro.

method.en: Crush it in a stone mortar and not a mixer. A mixed makai is a milk and eight kilos of it runs straight off the ladle.
method.l: Mixer te nohoi, pathor laga ural te thecha dibi. Mixer te kora makai to gakhir hoi jai aru ath kilo to chamos pora sidha bohi jai.

method.en: Fry on a medium flame right through. A hot kadai browns the outside in a minute and the kernel inside is raw and it is not seen.
method.l: Hekh tak majhiya jui te bhajibi. Gorom kadai pora ek minute te bahar to mati rong kore aru bhitorte guti to kacha thake, aru eitu nadekhe.

recipes.why: Ten rupees forty a head, and there is no besan in it at all. In borokhun the Peren makai is fifteen rupees a kilo and eight kilos becomes seven hundred fritters.
recipes.why_l: Ek manu te dosh taka chalis, aru tar bhitorte besan eku nai. Borokhun din te Peren laga makai to kilo te pandhra taka, aru ath kilo pora sat sou bhaji hoi.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Ninety minutes, most of it stripping the cobs.
start.l: Kunu saman bhijai rakha nalage. Nobboi minute, tar bisi bhag to sipi pora guti sarai.

vessel.en: A stone mortar, a deep kadai and a strainer. Two cooks.
vessel.l: Pathor laga ural, gobhir kadai aru chani. Duijon randhoni.

season.en: Borokhun to sarot, while the makai is in the fields.
season.l: Borokhun pora sarot tak, makai kheti te thaka homoi te.

recipes.name: Axone
recipes.sub: Sumi fermented soybean cake
recipes.sub_l: Sumi manu laga khomir uthi soybean

method.en: Axone is fermented soybean and it is the single most important thing in this book. It is entirely vegetarian and it does the work that fermented fish does in every other kitchen in this region.
method.l: Axone khomir uthi soybean ase aru etu ei kitab laga sob pora dangor saman ase. Etu pura niramish ase aru ei jagate aru hodai rondhon ghor te machor khomir jun kaam kore, etu he kore.

method.en: Soak the soybean overnight and boil it four to five hours until a bean crushes to paste between the fingers.
method.l: Soybean rati bhor bhijai, char pora pans ghonta uthabi jetia loi angul majote guti pura gali jai.

method.en: Drain it thoroughly and let it cool to just warm — not hot. Wrapped hot it goes sour instead of fermenting.
method.l: Bhal kori pani ulai, olop gorom loi thanda koribi — bisi gorom nohoi. Gorom bandhile etu khomir nohoi tenga hoi jai.

method.en: Wrap in banana leaves, pack into a covered basket, and keep it in a warm place — traditionally above the hearth — for five to six days.
method.l: Kol pata te bandhi, dhaka tukri te bhorabi, aru gorom jagate — purana niyom te chulha uporte — pans pora choi din rakhibi.

method.en: It is ready when it smells strongly and a sticky white thread pulls between two beans. That thread is the sign the ferment has taken; without it, throw the batch away and start again.
method.l: Tiar ase jetia jor gundh ulai aru duita guti majote sada lasa suta ulai. Etu suta he khomir hoise laga chinha ase; etu nohoile pura pheliya di notun kori suru koribi.

method.en: Pound the fermented beans to a paste, press into flat cakes, and smoke them over the hearth for two days. The cakes keep six months.
method.l: Khomir uthi guti ke kuti lasa bonabi, samatal roti nisina dabai, aru duita din chulha uporte dhuwa dibi. Etu roti choi mahina thake.

recipes.why: Six months from ten kilos of soybean, entirely vegetarian, and the flavour that makes this whole book possible.
recipes.why_l: Dohh kilo soybean pora choi mahina, pura niramish, aru ei pura kitab hobole diya swad.

start.en: This is a six-day ferment and then a smoking. Plan a week.
start.l: Etu choi din laga khomir aru pichote dhuwa dibole. Ek hoptah laga niyom bonabi.

vessel.en: A large pot, banana leaves, a basket and a place above the fire. One cook, twenty minutes a day.
vessel.l: Dangor bortan, kol pata, tukri aru jui uporte ek jaga. Ekjon randhoni, hodai din kudi minute.

season.en: Made in the cold months, November to February.
season.l: Jaar mahina te bonai, November pora February loi.

recipes.name: Bastenga
recipes.sub: Fermented bamboo shoot in brine
recipes.sub_l: Nimok pani te khomir uthi bahor gaj

method.en: Peel down to the pale tender core. Anything that resists the knife is too old to ferment and will stay woody in the jar.
method.l: Bhitor laga norom sada bhag loi chal chulabi. Churi te tan lagile etu khomir hobole bisi purana ase aru bortan te tan he thakibo.

method.en: Boil the shoots twice in fresh water, twenty minutes each, discarding the water both times, before the ferment starts.
method.l: Khomir suru kora age gaj ke notun pani te duibar, hodai bar kudi minute uthai, duiyo bar pani pheliya dibi.

method.en: Slice thin, pack tight into the jar, and cover with a brine of one part salt to about seven of water.
method.l: Pathla kori kati, bortan te tan kori bhorabi, aru ek bhag nimok aru prai sath bhag pani laga nimok pani halibi.

method.en: Weigh the shoots down so they stay under the brine. Any piece above the liquid grows mould and the mould takes the jar.
method.l: Gaj ke bhar dikori nimok pani laga tolote rakhibi. Pani uporte thaka tukra te phuki lage aru etu pura bortan loi jai.

method.en: Cover with cloth rather than a lid and keep it in the shade for three weeks. A sealed jar builds pressure and bursts.
method.l: Dhakni nohoi kapor pora dhaki chai jagate tin hoptah rakhibi. Bondh bortan te hawa bhorti hoi aru phati jai.

method.en: It is ready when it smells sharply sour and the shoot has gone translucent. Sealed under its brine it keeps a year.
method.l: Tiar ase jetia jor tenga gundh ulai aru gaj pariskar hoi jai. Nimok pani tolote bondh kori rakhile ek bosor thake.

recipes.why: Fifteen kilos of a four-month vegetable turned into a year of flavour. Keep it under the brine and it cannot fail.
recipes.why_l: Char mahina laga sabji laga pondhero kilo pora ek bosor laga swad. Nimok pani tolote rakhile etu kitia bhi bigare nai.

start.en: A three-week ferment. Start in the monsoon and use from September.
start.l: Tin hoptah laga khomir. Borikhon te suru kori September pora cholabi.

vessel.en: A 20 L glazed jar or a length of green bamboo. One cook, ten minutes a day.
vessel.l: 20 L laga bortan nohoile kesa bahor laga tukra. Ekjon randhoni, hodai din dohh minute.

season.en: Made June to August, when the fresh shoots are up.
season.l: June pora August loi bonai, jetia notun gaj ulai.

recipes.name: Anishi
recipes.sub: Ao fermented colocasia leaf cakes
recipes.sub_l: Ao manu laga khomir uthi kacchu pata laga roti

method.en: Anishi is the Ao preparation and it is made from mature colocasia leaves, not the young ones used for fritters.
method.l: Anishi Ao manu laga saman ase aru etu dangor kacchu pata pora bonai, bhaji nimite cholai diya kesa pata pora nohoi.

method.en: Wilt the leaves in the sun for a day until they go limp but not brittle.
method.l: Pata ke ek din roud te norom nohua loi rakhibi, kintu bhurbhuria nohoi.

method.en: Pack them tightly into banana leaves, bind the parcel, and keep it in a warm dark place for six to seven days.
method.l: Kol pata te tan kori bhorabi, pura bandhi, aru gorom andhar jagate choi pora sath din rakhibi.

method.en: The leaves turn yellow-brown and smell strongly. That colour change is the sign of a good ferment — leaves that stay green have not taken.
method.l: Pata halodi-rangoli hoi aru jor gundh dei. Etu rong bodla he bhal khomir laga chinha ase — kesa thaka pata te khomir laga nai.

method.en: Pound the fermented leaves with the ginger and salt, press into flat cakes about a finger thick, and dry them over the hearth for a week.
method.l: Khomir uthi pata ke aduwa aru nimok logote kutibi, ek angul mota samatal roti bonabi, aru chulha uporte ek hoptah sukhabi.

method.en: Dry them slowly and completely. A cake with any moisture left in the centre will grow mould within a month.
method.l: Aste aru pura sukhabi. Majote olop bhi bhija thakise koile ek mahina te phuki lagibo.

recipes.why: A leaf that is free in October turned into a year of flavour. Nothing else in India is made quite this way.
recipes.why_l: October te muft pua pata pora ek bosor laga swad. India te aru eku eneka kori nabonai.

start.en: A one-week ferment and then a long drying. Plan two weeks.
start.l: Ek hoptah khomir aru pichote lamba sukhai. Dui hoptah laga niyom bonabi.

vessel.en: Banana leaves, a basket and a rack above the hearth. One cook, twenty minutes a day.
vessel.l: Kol pata, tukri aru chulha uporte ek rack. Ekjon randhoni, hodai din kudi minute.

season.en: Made in October and November, when the leaves are mature.
season.l: October aru November te bonai, jetia pata dangor hoi.

recipes.name: Raja Mircha Pickle
recipes.sub: King chilli preserved in salt
recipes.sub_l: Nimok te rakha raja mircha

method.en: Wear gloves or bind the hands in cloth for this entire recipe, and do not rub the eyes for an hour afterwards even after washing.
method.l: Ei pura recipe nimite glove lagabi nohoile hath te kapor bandhibi, aru pichote ek ghonta loi, dhuise koile bhi, suku nachubi.

method.en: Wipe each chilli dry rather than washing it on the day. A single drop of water in the jar grows mould and takes the batch.
method.l: Etu din te dhua nohoi hodai mircha kapor pora sukhai lobi. Bortan te ek bindu pani pora phuki lage aru pura kharab kore.

method.en: Slit each chilli along one side but leave it whole. Cut through and the seeds come out into the jar and the pickle is far hotter than intended.
method.l: Hodai mircha ek phale kati kintu pura rakhibi. Pura katile guti bortan te ulai aru achar bhabise pora bisi jhaal hoi.

method.en: Pack into the jar in layers with salt and sliced ginger, and add lemon juice to cover.
method.l: Bortan te nimok aru kata aduwa logote parat kori bhorabi, aru dhaki bole kaji nemu laga rosh dibi.

method.en: Cover with cloth and stand in the sun a fortnight, shaking the jar daily.
method.l: Kapor pora dhaki, poinchi din roud te rakhibi, hodai din bortan lorabi.

method.en: There is no oil in this pickle and none is needed. Salt and lemon alone keep it a year, and it is served a chilli at a time on the side of the plate.
method.l: Ei achar te tel nai aru dorkar bhi nai. Khali nimok aru kaji nemu pora ek bosor thake, aru thali laga kinar te ekta ekta kori dei.

recipes.why: No oil, a year on the shelf, and it is served one chilli at a time. Handle it with cloth on the hands.
recipes.why_l: Tel nai, ek bosor thake, aru ekta ekta kori dei. Hath te kapor lagai kaam koribi.

start.en: A two-week salt cure. No oil at all.
start.l: Dui hoptah nimok te rakhibo. Eku tel nai.

vessel.en: A 10 L glass jar and cloth. One cook, ten minutes a day, wearing gloves.
vessel.l: 10 L kaach laga bortan aru kapor. Ekjon randhoni, hodai din dohh minute, glove lagai.

season.en: August to October, when the chillies ripen red.
season.l: August pora October loi, jetia mircha rangoli pake.

recipes.name: Passion Fruit Jam
recipes.sub: Passion fruit pulp cooked down with sugar to a set
recipes.sub_l: Passion phol laga sansh ke chini logote jomi juwa tak randha

method.en: Keep half the seeds and strain the rest out. Seedless, a passion jam looks like a bought one; all the seeds and it cannot be spread.
method.l: Guti laga adha rakhibi aru baki chani ulai dibi. Guti nathakile passion jam to dukan pora kina nisina lage; sob guti thakile lagabole napare.

method.en: Test it on a cold plate every four minutes near the end. A passion jam goes from loose to hard in ninety seconds and there is no warning.
method.l: Hekh laga usor te sari minute pisote thanda thali te sabi. Passion jam to nobboi second te polka pora tan hoi jai aru age pora kiba nakoi.

method.en: Lemon in the last minute. It is what stops five kilos of sugar crystallising in the jar by the second month.
method.l: Nemu to hekh laga minute te. Eitu pora dui mah te bela bhitorte pas kilo chini ke dana hobole nadiye.

method.en: Fill the jars hot and close them hot. A jam cooled in the pan and then jarred grows a skin on the top within a fortnight.
method.l: Bela khan gorom thaka homoi te bhorabi aru gorom thaka homoi te bondh koribi. Kadai te thanda kori kene bela te bhora jam to dui hafta te tar upor te chal ulai.

recipes.why: Eighteen rupees seventy a kilo of jam and it keeps a year. Passion grows over every Mokokchung fence and eight kilos costs the picking.
recipes.why_l: Ek kilo jam te athara taka sathi, aru ek bochor thake. Mokokchung laga bera sob te passion lota uthe aru ath kilo laga khoros to tula mattro.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Two hours from the first cut fruit.
start.l: Kunu saman bhijai rakha nalage. Poila phol kata pora dui ghanta.

vessel.en: A heavy pan, a strainer and wide-mouthed glass jars. One cook.
vessel.l: Bhari kadai, chani aru chaura mukh laga glass bela. Ekjon randhoni.

season.en: Made in borokhun and eaten all year.
season.l: Borokhun din te bonai aru pura bochor khai.

recipes.name: Ginger Pickle
recipes.sub: Ginger cut in matchsticks and set in lemon juice, no oil
recipes.sub_l: Ada ke misi kori kati kene nemu rox te rakha, tel eku nai

method.en: Scrape the skin with a spoon and never peel it with a knife. The layer just under the skin is where the whole smell sits and a knife takes it away.
method.l: Chal to chamos loi sarabi, churi loi kotina bi nachilabi. Sob gonda to chal laga niche laga stor te thake aru churi pora eitu ulai loi jai.

method.en: Cut in matchsticks and not rounds. A round of ada is too much in one mouthful and the jar goes untouched on the counter.
method.l: Misi kori katibi, chakti nohoi. Ada laga chakti to ek muthi te bisi hoi aru bela to dibole laga jagate hath nalagai kene thake.

method.en: No oil and no heat at any point. The lemon is the whole preservative and it works only if the jar is dry and the ginger is dry.
method.l: Kotina bi tel aru gorom nai. Nemu he sob rakhibole kaam kore aru bela sukha aru ada sukha thakile mattro kaam kore.

method.en: Leave it a week in the sun before it goes to the counter. On the day it is made it is ginger and salt; the week is when it becomes an achar.
method.l: Dibole laga jagate najuwa age te ek hafta rodh te rakhibi. Bonai diya din te eitu ada aru nimok he; ek hafta pisote he achar hoi.

recipes.why: Twenty-three rupees twenty a kilo, and it is the one thing on a heavy Naga plate that will settle a stomach after an axone dish. The vaidya asks for it before the cook does.
recipes.why_l: Ek kilo te teis taka bis, aru bhari Naga thali te axone laga khana pisote pet ke thanda kora saman to eitu he. Randhoni pora mangibole age te doctor pora mange.

start.en: Nothing cooks. Cut, salt and jar in one afternoon, then a week in the sun.
start.l: Kiba randha nalage. Ek dupor te kati, nimok di kene bela te bhorabi, tar pasote ek hafta rodh te.

vessel.en: A glass or clay jar with a dry lid. One cook for the cutting.
vessel.l: Sukha dhakoni thaka glass nohoile mati laga bela. Katibole ekjon randhoni.

season.en: Made in sarot and eaten from thanda din to gorom din.
season.l: Sarot te bonai aru thanda din pora gorom din tak khai.

recipes.name: Lemon Pickle
recipes.sub: Lemon cut in wedges and salted down a month before use
recipes.sub_l: Nemu ke tukra kori kati kene labhoi laga ek mah age te nimok te rakha

method.en: Cut them and put them in salt alone for a month before any spice goes near them. This is not an achar that can be made on the day it is wanted.
method.l: Kati kene masala usor nadi kene ek mah nimok te mattro rakhibi. Eitu laga karone je din lage, etu din te bonabole para achar nohoi.

method.en: Weigh the fruit down under a stone so the brine covers it. Any wedge standing above the brine grows a white skin and has to be thrown.
method.l: Nimok pani pora dhakibole karone phol khan pathor niche te chapi rakhibi. Nimok pani upor te thiya thaka tukra te boga chal ulai aru phelai dibole lage.

method.en: Keep the white pith out. The pith is the bitterness in a nemu and it does not go away in a jar however long it stands.
method.l: Bhitorte thaka boga bhag to ulai dibi. Nemu laga tita to etu bhag te thake aru bela te kotona din rakhile bi eitu nayai.

method.en: The spices go on cold and never into a hot pan with the fruit. Heat at this stage turns a lemon achar bitter and there is no recovering it.
method.l: Masala khan thanda thaka homoi te he dibi, phol logote gorom kadai te kotina bi nohoi. Eitu homoi te gorom dile nemu achar to tita hoi jai aru wapas anibole napare.

recipes.why: Fourteen rupees twenty a kilo and it keeps two years. A temple that salts down five kilos in sarot has achar till the next sarot.
recipes.why_l: Ek kilo te souda taka bis, aru dui bochor thake. Sarot te pas kilo nimok te rakhise mandir te ahibole sarot tak achar thake.

start.en: A month in salt before the spices go on. Planned in sarot for thanda din.
start.l: Masala dibole age te ek mah nimok te. Thanda din karone sarot te thik kori loi.

vessel.en: A clay jar, a flat stone to weigh it down and a dry ladle. One cook, a month apart.
vessel.l: Mati laga bela, chapibole saman pathor aru sukha chamos. Ekjon randhoni, ek mah pisote.

season.en: Made in sarot, ready in thanda din, eaten two years.
season.l: Sarot te bonai, thanda din te taiyar hoi, dui bochor khai.

recipes.name: Mustard Leaf Pickle
recipes.sub: Mustard leaf and stalk salted down in a jar for a fortnight
recipes.sub_l: Sorisa pata aru dala ke bela te dui hafta nimok te rakha

method.en: Wilt the leaves a full day in the sun before they go in the jar. A fresh leaf in salt ferments in three days and the jar swells.
method.l: Bela te hala nadi kene pata khan ek din puri rodh te molai dibi. Nimok te notun pata dile tin din te gali jai aru bela to phuli uthe.

method.en: Cut the stalk in and do not throw it. The stalk is a third of the weight and it is the part that keeps its bite for a fortnight.
method.l: Dala to kati kene hala dibi, phelai nadibi. Dala to gathi laga tin bhag ekta aru dui hafta tak tar kotor thaka bhag to eitu he.

method.en: Press it down with a stone so the brine covers it. Any leaf above the brine grows a white skin and the whole jar has to be thrown.
method.l: Nimok pani pora dhakibole karone pathor loi chapi rakhibi. Nimok pani upor te thaka pata te boga chal ulai aru pura bela to phelai dibole lage.

method.en: Eat it within a fortnight. This is not a year achar; the leaf goes soft after two weeks and the jar smells of it.
method.l: Dui hafta bhitorte khai lobi. Eitu ek bochor laga achar nohoi; dui hafta pisote pata to molom hoi jai aru bela to gonda kore.

recipes.why: Ten rupees sixty a kilo, the cheapest jar on this shelf. In thanda din the pata is fifteen rupees a kilo and seven kilos is a fortnight of achar.
recipes.why_l: Ek kilo te dosh taka sathi, eitu thak te sobse sosta bela. Thanda din te sorisa pata to kilo te pandhra taka, aru sat kilo pora dui hafta laga achar hoi.

start.en: A day in the sun, then a fortnight in the jar.
start.l: Ek din rodh te, tar pasote bela te dui hafta.

vessel.en: A drying mat, a clay jar and a flat stone. One cook.
vessel.l: Sukhabole chatai, mati laga bela aru saman pathor. Ekjon randhoni.

season.en: Made in thanda din, eaten in thanda din.
season.l: Thanda din te bonai, thanda din te khai.

recipes.name: Tree Tomato Sour Broth
recipes.sub: Thin sour broth in place of a kadhi
recipes.sub_l: Kadhi laga bodli te pathla tenga jhol

method.en: There is no curd in a Naga kitchen, so there is no kadhi and no raita. What this cuisine has instead is the thin sour broth, and it does the same job on the plate.
method.l: Naga rondhon ghor te dahi nai, etu karone kadhi bhi nai raita bhi nai. Iyar bodli te pathla tenga jhol ase, aru thali te etu eke kaam kore.

method.en: Blanch and peel the tree tomato. Left on, the skin is genuinely bitter.
method.l: Gash bilahi ke gorom pani te dhali chal chulabi. Chal thakise koile bisi tita hoi.

method.en: Peel the colocasia stem with oiled hands and cut it into short lengths. The raw sap makes the palms itch.
method.l: Kacchu dala ke tel lagai hath pora chulai, sotu tukra kori katibi. Kacha rosh pora hath khujli kore.

method.en: Cook the stem twenty minutes before the fruit goes in — it is dense and the fruit collapses in ten.
method.l: Phol halu age dala ke kudi minute rondhibi — etu tan ase aru phol dohh minute te gali jai.

method.en: Add both tomatoes and simmer fifteen minutes until they break down completely.
method.l: Duita bilahi halibi aru pandhero minute pura gali juwa loi rondhibi.

method.en: Stir the roasted ground perilla in off the fire. Keep the broth genuinely thin — this is drunk from the bowl alongside rice, not ladled over it.
method.l: Bhaja pisa nakhup jui bondh kori milabi. Jhol ke asol te pathla rakhibi — etu bhat logote bati pora khai, bhat uporte nadhale.

recipes.why: The sour dish a kitchen without dairy has instead of a kadhi, and it costs a fraction of one.
recipes.why_l: Dahi nathaka rondhon ghor te kadhi laga bodli te thaka tenga saman, aru dam iyar bhag matro ase.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Start forty minutes before serving.
start.l: Eku bhijai nalage. Diya age salish minute suru koribi.

vessel.en: A 30 L vessel. One cook.
vessel.l: 30 L bortan. Ekjon randhoni.

season.en: October to February, while the tree tomato is on.
season.l: October pora February loi, jetia gash bilahi thake.

recipes.name: Bamboo Shoot Sour Soup
recipes.sub: Fermented bamboo shoot broth
recipes.sub_l: Khomir uthi bahor gaj laga jhol

method.en: Rinse the bastenga twice in cold water and squeeze it out. Straight from the jar it is far too sour for a soup.
method.l: Bastenga ke thanda pani te duibar dhui nisuri lobi. Bortan pora sidha halile soup nimite bisi tenga hoi.

method.en: Keep the second rinse water aside. It goes back in at the end, a little at a time, once the soup has been tasted.
method.l: Dusra dhua pani alag rakhibi. Soup chaka pichote etu pora olop olop kori hekh te wapas dibo pare.

method.en: Fry the drained bastenga in the oil for five minutes before anything else goes in. This takes the raw edge off the ferment.
method.l: Aru eku halu age nisura bastenga ke tel te pans minute bhajibi. Etu pora khomir laga kacha swad jai.

method.en: Add the potato and water and cook twenty minutes until the potato is soft enough to mash against the side.
method.l: Alu aru pani halibi aru kudi minute, alu ke bortan laga kinar te ghohibo para loi rondhibi.

method.en: Mash a few pieces of potato into the broth. That is what gives it body — there is no dairy and no flour here.
method.l: Kisu alu tukra jhol te ghohibi. Etu he gadha kore — iyate dahi bhi nai ata bhi nai.

method.en: Add the tomato in the last ten minutes and stir the ground perilla in off the fire. Salt at the very end, because the bastenga brought its own.
method.l: Bilahi hekh laga dohh minute te halibi aru pisa nakhup jui bondh kori milabi. Nimok ekdom hekh te, kelemane bastenga logote nijor nimok ase.

recipes.why: Sour, hot and thin, and made from a jar that has been standing since August. Salt last — the ferment is already salted.
recipes.why_l: Tenga, jhaal aru pathla, aru August pora rakhi thaka bortan pora bona. Nimok hekh te — khomir te nimok pora ase.

start.en: Rinse the bastenga twice. Start forty minutes before serving.
start.l: Bastenga duibar dhubi. Diya age salish minute suru koribi.

vessel.en: A 30 L vessel. One cook.
vessel.l: 30 L bortan. Ekjon randhoni.

season.en: All year — bastenga keeps a year in its jar.
season.l: Pura bosor — bastenga bortan te ek bosor thake.

recipes.name: Curd Raita
recipes.sub: Curd with cucumber and roasted cumin
recipes.sub_l: Kakri aru bhaja jeera diya dahi

method.en: This dish is not Naga and the book should say so. It is here because a temple kitchen serves curd and because there is nothing else in this cuisine that fills the same place on a thali.
method.l: Ei saman Naga nohoi aru kitab te etu koi dibo lage. Etu iyate ase kelemane mandir laga rondhon ghor te dahi dei aru ei khana te thali te etu jaga bhorabole aru eku nai.

method.en: Curd is not made in the hills and has to be brought in or set in the temple kitchen itself.
method.l: Pahar te dahi nabonai aru bahar pora anibo lage nohoile mandir laga rondhon ghor te nijei jomabo lage.

method.en: Grate the cucumber and squeeze the water out in the hand, keeping that water to thin the curd.
method.l: Kakri ghohi hath pora pani nisuri lobi, aru etu pani dahi pathla kori bole rakhibi.

method.en: Whisk the curd smooth with that liquid and both salts.
method.l: Dahi ke etu pani aru duita nimok logote misi kori fetibi.

method.en: Taste it cold — chilled curd needs more salt than it seems to.
method.l: Thanda he chakibi — thanda dahi ke dikha pora bisi nimok lage.

method.en: Fold in the cucumber, green chilli and roasted cumin, and serve cold.
method.l: Kakri, kesa jaluk aru bhaja jeera milai, thanda dibi.

recipes.why: Imported, and marked as such. It fills the place on the thali that a Naga kitchen has never needed to fill.
recipes.why_l: Bahar pora ana, aru eneka koi diya. Naga rondhon ghor te kitia bhi bhorabole nalaga thali laga jaga etu bhorai.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Make it within an hour of serving.
start.l: Eku bhijai nalage. Diya laga ek ghonta bhitorte bonabi.

vessel.en: A 30 L bowl. One cook.
vessel.l: 30 L bati. Ekjon randhoni.

season.en: All year, and doubled in summer.
season.l: Pura bosor, aru gorom mahina te dugun.

recipes.name: Cucumber Raita
recipes.sub: Cucumber grated into thin curd with roasted cumin
recipes.sub_l: Kakri ke polka dahi te kasi kene bhaja jira diya

method.en: Grate the kakri and squeeze it dry before it meets the curd. Five kilos gives up two litres and that water thins twenty litres to nothing.
method.l: Dahi te nadi kene kakri to kasi kene sipi sukhai lobi. Pas kilo pora dui litre ulai aru etu pani pora bis litre ke pura polka kore dibo.

method.en: Taste the stem end before it goes in. One bitter kakri in five kilos is found by four devotees and remembered by all of them.
method.l: Hala nadi kene tar dala mukh to sabi. Pas kilo bhitorte ekta tita kakri thakile sari jon bhokot pora pai aru sob pora monte rakhe.

method.en: Whisk the curd with the water first and get it smooth before the cucumber goes in. Lumps of curd will not break once there is anything solid in the vessel.
method.l: Kakri hala nadi kene poila dahi ke pani logote phetai kene molom koribi. Bela te kiba tan saman thakile dahi laga dola to nabhangibo.

method.en: Roast the cumin dry and crush it coarse, do not use a powder. A raita is a plain thing and the jira is the only interest it has.
method.l: Jira to sukha bhaji kene mota kore thecha dibi, gura nolobi. Raita to sadharon saman aru tar bhitorte moja to jira he.

recipes.why: Eleven rupees sixty a head and no fire under it. In gorom din the kakri is twenty rupees a kilo at Dimapur bazar and a cold bowl on a hot day empties before the bhat does.
recipes.why_l: Ek manu te egaro taka sathi, aru tar tolote jui nai. Gorom din te Dimapur bazar te kakri to kilo te bis taka, aru gorom din te thanda bati to bhat pora bhi age te khali hoi.

start.en: Curd is set the night before. Grate half an hour before the bell.
start.l: Dahi to age din laga raat te jomai. Ghanta baja age te adha ghanta te kasibi.

vessel.en: A grater, a squeezing cloth and a shallow 25 L tray. One cook.
vessel.l: Kasoni, sipibole kapor aru komgobhir pachis litre tray. Ekjon randhoni.

season.en: Gorom din to borokhun, while the kakri is in the market.
season.l: Gorom din pora borokhun tak, kakri bazar te thaka homoi te.

recipes.name: Potato Raita
recipes.sub: Potato boiled, broken by hand and folded into thin curd
recipes.sub_l: Alu ke siddha kori, hath loi bhangi kene polka dahi te mila diya

method.en: Boil the alu in the skin and break it by hand. A knife-cut potato in curd keeps its edges and the raita never takes hold of it.
method.l: Alu to chal logote siddha kori kene hath loi bhangibi. Dahi te churi loi kata alu to tar dhar dhori thake aru raita pora kotina bi dhoribole napare.

method.en: Let it go completely cold before it meets the curd. Warm potato splits ten kilos of curd before the vessel reaches the counter.
method.l: Dahi te nadi kene puri thanda hobole dibi. Gorom alu pora bela to dibole laga jaga tak najuwa age te dosh kilo dahi ke phatai diye.

method.en: Black salt as well as salt. An alu raita without black salt tastes of nothing and twenty litres comes back half eaten.
method.l: Nimok logote kala nimok bi. Kala nimok nathaka alu raita to swad nathake aru bis litre to adha khai kene wapas ahe.

method.en: Keep it shallow and cold. A deep vessel of raita warms from the middle out and sours before the line has passed.
method.l: Komgobhir aru thanda rakhibi. Raita laga gobhir bela to majote pora gorom hoi aru manu laga line puri nohua age te tenga hoi jai.

recipes.why: Eleven rupees ninety a head. Alu is in a Dimapur store room every month of the year and this is the raita for a thanda din when there is nothing fresh to grate.
recipes.why_l: Ek manu te egaro taka nobbei. Bochor laga mah sob te Dimapur bhoral te alu thake, aru kasibole notun saman nathaka thanda din laga raita to eitu he.

start.en: Potatoes boil the night before and go cold. Twenty minutes on the day.
start.l: Alu to age din laga raat te siddha kori thanda kore. Etu din te bis minute.

vessel.en: A boiling pot and a shallow 25 L tray. One cook.
vessel.l: Ukhalibole bela aru komgobhir pachis litre tray. Ekjon randhoni.

season.en: All year, and the thanda din raita when the tunnels have nothing.
season.l: Pura bochor, aru polyhouse te kiba nathaka thanda din laga raita.

recipes.name: Boondi Raita
recipes.sub: Gram flour drops soaked warm and folded into salted curd
recipes.sub_l: Besan laga guti ke gorom pani te bhijai kene nimok diya dahi te mila

method.en: Soak the boondi in warm water two minutes and squeeze it between the palms. Dropped hard into curd it stays hard and drinks the raita dry.
method.l: Boondi to gorom pani te dui minute bhijai kene hath talu majote sipi dibi. Tan thaka homoi te dahi te hala dile tan he thake aru raita ke suki loi.

method.en: The batter for the boondi is thin, about the run of a dosa batter. A thick batter gives tails on every drop and the tails are felt in the mouth.
method.l: Boondi laga gura to polka, dosa laga gura nisina bohi juwa. Gadha gura dile guti sob te nejaruwa hoi aru etu neja to mukh te pai.

method.en: Hold the perforated ladle a hand above the oil. Held close, the drops join before they land and come out as a sheet.
method.l: Chidra thaka chamos to tel pora ek hath upor te dhoribi. Usor te dhorile guti khan pora nadi kene mili jai aru ekta pata nisina ulai.

method.en: Fold it in at the counter. Boondi in curd for half an hour is a bowl of paste and the whole point of it is the give.
method.l: Dibole laga jagate mila dibi. Dahi te adha ghanta thakise boondi to dola laga bati hoi jai aru tar mukhyo kotha to molom thaka he.

recipes.why: Fifteen rupees forty a head. The boondi is fried in a spare hour and kept in a tin, so on a thanda din when nothing fresh can be grated this is the raita a kitchen reaches for.
recipes.why_l: Ek manu te pandhra taka chalis. Boondi to khali ek ghanta te bhaji kene tin te rakhe, karone kasibole notun saman nathaka thanda din te rasoi pora eitu raita he uliai loi.

start.en: Boondi can be fried a fortnight ahead and kept in a tin. Twenty minutes on the day.
start.l: Boondi to dui hafta age te bhaji kene tin te rakhibole pare. Etu din te bis minute.

vessel.en: A deep kadai and a perforated ladle for the boondi; a 25 L tray for the raita. Two cooks.
vessel.l: Boondi karone gobhir kadai aru chidra thaka chamos; raita karone pachis litre tray. Duijon randhoni.

season.en: All year, and the thanda din raita when the store room has nothing to grate.
season.l: Pura bochor, aru bhoral te kasibole kiba nathaka thanda din laga raita.

recipes.name: Fritter Kadhi
recipes.sub: Gram flour fritters dropped into a sour curd kadhi at the counter
recipes.sub_l: Besan laga bhaji ke dibole laga jagate tenga dahi kadhi te hala

method.en: The curd should be a day old and sour. Fresh curd gives a kadhi that tastes of besan and of nothing else, and the sourness is the whole dish.
method.l: Dahi to ek din puran aru tenga hobole lage. Notun dahi pora besan laga swad mattro thaka kadhi hoi, aru tenga he pura khana.

method.en: Whisk the besan into cold curd and get every lump out before any heat. A lump that reaches hot kadhi never breaks up again.
method.l: Besan to thanda dahi te mila kene gorom nadi kene sob dola ulai dibi. Gorom kadhi te puwa dola to aru kotina bi nabhangibo.

method.en: Boil it a full forty minutes before the bhaji go in. A kadhi cooked twenty minutes tastes raw however good the curd was.
method.l: Bhaji hala nadi kene puri chalis minute ukhalibi. Dahi kotona bhal hoilebi bis minute randhise kadhi to kacha lage.

method.en: Drop the bhaji in ten minutes before serving and no earlier. An hour in the kadhi and they are paste and the vessel is a besan soup.
method.l: Dibole laga dosh minute age te bhaji hala dibi, tatu age nohoi. Kadhi te ek ghanta thakile dola hoi jai aru bela to besan laga soup hoi.

recipes.why: Seventeen rupees ninety a head. The plain sour broths on this shelf are the everyday ones; this is the Hornbill version and worth the extra six rupees.
recipes.why_l: Ek manu te sattaro taka nobbei. Eitu thak te thaka sadharon tenga jhol khan to din din laga; eitu to Hornbill laga aru aru sou taka laga daam thake.

start.en: The curd should be a day old. Fritters are fried while the kadhi boils. Two hours in all.
start.l: Dahi to ek din puran hobole lage. Kadhi ukhala homoi te bhaji bhaje. Sob milai dui ghanta.

vessel.en: A 30 L vessel, a deep kadai and a tempering pan. Two cooks.
vessel.l: Tirish litre bela, gobhir kadai aru phoron laga kadai. Duijon randhoni.

season.en: All year, and at Hornbill above all.
season.l: Pura bochor, aru Hornbill te bisi kori.

recipes.name: Tomato Raita
recipes.sub: Tomato roasted, peeled and broken into thin curd
recipes.sub_l: Bilahi ke puri kene chal sarai polka dahi te bhanga

method.en: Roast the bilahi on the flame and peel it before it goes into the curd. A raw tomato in curd sours nine kilos of it within the hour.
method.l: Dahi te nadi kene bilahi to jui upor te puri kene chal sarabi. Dahi te kacha bilahi dile ek ghanta bhitorte no kilo to tenga hoi jai.

method.en: Break it by hand and do not chop it. A knife-cut tomato bleeds and the whole vessel is pink instead of white with red in it.
method.l: Hath loi bhangibi, churi loi nakatibi. Churi loi kata bilahi pora rox ulai aru pura bela to boga te lal thaka bodli gulapi hoi jai.

method.en: A pinch of chini against the chilli and the tomato. It is what a Naga kitchen puts in a curd dish and nobody can name it afterwards.
method.l: Mircha aru bilahi laga birodhe olop chini. Naga rasoi pora dahi laga khana te eitu he diye aru pasote kunbi tar naam kobole napare.

method.en: Fold it in at the counter and keep it shallow. A deep vessel warms from the middle and a warm tomato raita is thrown, not served.
method.l: Dibole laga jagate mila dibi aru komgobhir rakhibi. Gobhir bela to majote pora gorom hoi aru gorom bilahi raita to nadiye, phelai diye.

recipes.why: Ten rupees ninety a head, and it is the raita to make when the kakri season is over. Tomato is at Dimapur bazar every month of the year.
recipes.why_l: Ek manu te dosh taka nobbei, aru kakri laga homoi puri juwa pasote bonabole raita to eitu he. Bochor laga mah sob te Dimapur bazar te bilahi thake.

start.en: Curd is set the night before. Roast and peel half an hour before the bell.
start.l: Dahi to age din laga raat te jomai. Ghanta baja adha ghanta age te puri kene chal sarabi.

vessel.en: An open flame and a shallow 25 L tray. One cook.
vessel.l: Khula jui aru komgobhir pachis litre tray. Ekjon randhoni.

season.en: All year, and cheapest in sarot.
season.l: Pura bochor, aru sarot te sobse sosta.

recipes.name: Galho with Colocasia
recipes.sub: Rice and taro cooked to a porridge
recipes.sub_l: Bhat aru kacchu jaul nisina rondha

method.en: Peel the colocasia with oiled hands or cloth. The raw sap makes the palms itch and it does not wash off easily.
method.l: Kacchu ke tel lagai hath nohoile kapor pora chulabi. Kacha rosh pora hath khujli kore aru sohoje nadhui.

method.en: Cut it into large chunks rather than small. Colocasia breaks down a great deal in a long cook and small pieces disappear entirely.
method.l: Sotu nohoi dangor tukra kori katibi. Kacchu lamba rondhile bisi gale aru sotu tukra pura harai jai.

method.en: Cook the colocasia twenty minutes before the rice goes in.
method.l: Chaul halu age kacchu ke kudi minute rondhibi.

method.en: Cook until the rice grains have burst and about a third of the colocasia has gone into the broth. That thickening is the point of using taro rather than potato.
method.l: Chaul laga dana phata loi aru prai ek tritiya bhag kacchu jhol te gali juwa loi rondhibi. Alu laga bodli te kacchu cholai laga karone he etu gadha hua ase.

method.en: Add the mustard greens only in the last eight minutes so they stay green.
method.l: Lai pata hekh laga ath minute te he halibi, eneka hoile etu kesa thake.

method.en: Stir the roasted ground perilla in off the fire and keep hot water aside — it thickens hard as it stands.
method.l: Bhaja pisa nakhup jui bondh kori milabi aru gorom pani alag rakhibi — rakhile etu bisi gadha hoi.

recipes.why: Taro does the thickening that a dal would do elsewhere, and it grows on the same terrace as the rice.
recipes.why_l: Aru jagate dal jun gadha kora kaam kore, iyate kacchu kore, aru etu bhat laga eke khet te hoi.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Start seventy minutes before serving.
start.l: Eku bhijai nalage. Diya age sattar minute suru koribi.

vessel.en: A heavy 50 L vessel. Two cooks.
vessel.l: Bhari 50 L bortan. Dujon randhoni.

season.en: October to March, when the tubers are out of the ground.
season.l: October pora March loi, jetia mati pora kacchu ulai.

recipes.name: Job's Tears Khichdi
recipes.sub: Hill millet cooked with rice and greens
recipes.sub_l: Bhat aru pata logote pahar laga dhan

method.en: Job's tears is the hard hill grain grown on the poorer terraces, and it is the crop a Naga village falls back on when the rice is short.
method.l: Job's tears pahar laga tan dhan ase jun kharab khet te hoi, aru bhat komti hoile Naga gaon etu te ghurai ahe.

method.en: Soak six hours. This grain is harder than any rice and a short soak leaves it chewy however long it is cooked.
method.l: Choi ghonta bhijabi. Ei dhan hodai bhat pora tan ase aru komti bhijaile kiman rondhile bhi tan thake.

method.en: Cook the Job's tears alone for thirty minutes before the rice goes in. It takes roughly twice as long, and together the rice is paste before the grain is soft.
method.l: Chaul halu age Job's tears ekla tirish minute rondhibi. Etu prai dugun somoi loi, aru eke logote dile dhan norom nohua age chaul lasa hoi jai.

method.en: Use a pressure vessel. In an open pot this grain can take ninety minutes and still be hard.
method.l: Pressure bortan cholabi. Khula bortan te ei dhan nabbe minute loi kori bhi tan thakibo pare.

method.en: Add the rice, ginger and chilli and cook a further twenty minutes.
method.l: Chaul, aduwa aru jaluk halibi aru kudi minute aru rondhibi.

method.en: Add the greens in the last five minutes and stir the ground perilla in off the fire.
method.l: Pata hekh laga pans minute te halibi aru pisa nakhup jui bondh kori milabi.

recipes.why: Cheaper than rice, stores a year, and it is what these hills grew before rice was the only crop.
recipes.why_l: Bhat pora sosta, ek bosor thake, aru bhat he ekmatra kheti hobo age ei pahar te etu he hoise.

start.en: Soak the Job's tears six hours. Start two hours before serving.
start.l: Job's tears choi ghonta bhijabi. Diya age dui ghonta suru koribi.

vessel.en: A 45 L pressure vessel. One cook.
vessel.l: 45 L pressure bortan. Ekjon randhoni.

season.en: All year — it stores dry for a year.
season.l: Pura bosor — etu sukha ek bosor thake.

recipes.name: Millet Khichdi
recipes.sub: Foxtail millet with vegetables
recipes.sub_l: Sabji logote kodo dhan

method.en: Rinse the millet in three changes of water and drain it well. Millet carries more chaff than rice and it floats off in the rinsing.
method.l: Kodo ke tin bar pani bodli kori dhui, bhal kori pani ulabi. Kodo te bhat pora bisi bhusa thake aru dhua somoi te etu bhahi jai.

method.en: Let it stand thirty minutes after draining. Wet millet added to hot oil steams and turns the vessel sticky.
method.l: Pani ulai pichote tirish minute rakhibi. Bhija kodo gorom tel te bhap hoi aru bortan lasa kore.

method.en: Use about four parts water to one of millet — more than for rice. Millet absorbs a great deal and a mean hand with water gives a dry, tight khichdi.
method.l: Kodo laga ek bhag te prai char bhag pani lobi — bhat pora bisi. Kodo bisi pani loi aru komti pani dile sukha, tan khichdi hoi.

method.en: Fry the vegetables in the oil four minutes before the millet goes in, so they hold their shape.
method.l: Kodo halu age sabji ke tel te char minute bhajibi, eneka hoile etu bhangi najai.

method.en: Cook covered on a low flame twenty-five minutes, stirring up from the bottom twice with a flat ladle.
method.l: Dhaki kori dhimai jui te panchis minute rondhibi, samatal hatai pora duibar tol pora ghurabi.

method.en: Stir the roasted ground perilla in off the fire and finish with coriander.
method.l: Bhaja pisa nakhup jui bondh kori milabi aru dhonia pata halibi.

recipes.why: Grows on ground too poor for rice, stores a year, and costs less per head than anything else in this book.
recipes.why_l: Bhat nimite kharab mati te bhi hoi, ek bosor thake, aru ei kitab te sob pora komti dam lage.

start.en: Rinse and drain the millet thirty minutes ahead. Start seventy minutes before serving.
start.l: Kodo tirish minute age dhui pani ulabi. Diya age sattar minute suru koribi.

vessel.en: A heavy 45 L vessel. One cook.
vessel.l: Bhari 45 L bortan. Ekjon randhoni.

season.en: All year, and cheapest after the November harvest.
season.l: Pura bosor, aru November laga kheti pichote sob pora sosta.

recipes.name: Axone Khichdi
recipes.sub: Fermented soybean folded into a rice and dal khichdi off the fire
recipes.sub_l: Axone ke jui pora namai kene bhat aru dal laga khichdi te mila diya

method.en: The axone goes in with the fire off. Boiled twenty minutes it loses the smell it is bought for and becomes an ordinary bean.
method.l: Axone to jui bondh kori kene hala. Bis minute ukhalile taike kina laga gonda to hera jai aru sadharon guti hoi jai.

method.en: Crush half and leave half whole. The crushed half carries through thirty-two litres and the whole half is what a Naga looks for in the plate.
method.l: Adha thecha dibi aru adha pura rakhibi. Thecha diya adha pora 32 litre te jai aru pura adha to Naga manu pora thali te bisara saman.

method.en: Cook the khichdi uncovered from the moment the axone goes in. Under a lid two kilos of it will empty a hall.
method.l: Axone hala loge loge khichdi to dhaki nadi kene randhibi. Dhaki dile dui kilo pora hall to khali kori dibo.

method.en: Taste before the salt goes in. An axone is salted in the jar and a hundred and ninety grams is already more than some jars want.
method.l: Nimok hala nadi kene swad sabi. Axone to bela te nimok di kene rakhe aru ek sou nobbei gram to kunba bela karone age pora bisi hoi.

recipes.why: Thirteen rupees sixty a head. Axone is the protein of a Naga meal and two kilos gives a hundred people what a kilo of paneer would at four times the price.
recipes.why_l: Ek manu te tera taka sathi. Axone he Naga khana laga bol aru dui kilo pora ek sou manu ke sari gun daam laga ek kilo paneer je dibo, etu he diye.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Forty minutes, and the axone in the last five.
start.l: Kunu saman bhijai rakha nalage. Chalis minute, aru axone to hekh laga pas minute te.

vessel.en: A 40 L vessel, uncovered at the end. One cook.
vessel.l: Chalis litre bela, hekh te dhaki nadi kene. Ekjon randhoni.

season.en: All year, out of the jar put down in sarot.
season.l: Pura bochor, sarot te rakhise bela pora.

recipes.name: Masoor Khichdi
recipes.sub: Whole masoor cooked with rice until the skins split
recipes.sub_l: Gutia masoor ke chaul logote chal phata tak randha

method.en: Soak the masoor two hours. The whole lentil has a skin and an unsoaked one is still a bead when the rice has gone to paste.
method.l: Masoor to dui ghanta bhijai rakhibi. Gutia masoor te chal thake aru bhijai nathaka to bhat dola hoi juwa homoi te bi guti nisina thake.
