method.en: Cook the masoor twenty minutes before the rice goes in. Started together, this is a khichdi with hard lentils and broken rice in the same spoon.
method.l: Chaul hala nadi kene masoor to bis minute randhibi. Eke logote suru korile ekta chamos te tan masoor aru bhanga bhat thaka khichdi hoi.

method.en: Tomato in the last ten minutes only. Cooked from the start it goes to a paste and the khichdi has a sour taste nobody can place.
method.l: Bilahi to hekh laga dosh minute te mattro. Suru pora randhile dola hoi jai aru khichdi te kunbi bujhi napara tenga swad ahe.

method.en: Take it off looser than it should be. Masoor drinks for twenty minutes in the vessel and comes to the counter right.
method.l: Jiman lage tatu polka thaki kene namai lobi. Masoor pora bela bhitorte bis minute pani suse aru dibole laga jagate thik hoi ahe.

recipes.why: Eleven rupees sixty a head, and masoor is the cheapest whole pulse at Dimapur bazar eight months of the year. It cooks in half the time a kholar takes.
recipes.why_l: Ek manu te egaro taka sathi, aru bochor laga ath mah Dimapur bazar te masoor he sobse sosta gutia dal. Kholar laga adha homoi te randhi jai.

start.en: Masoor soaks two hours. Three hours before the bell in all.
start.l: Masoor to dui ghanta bhijai. Ghanta baja age te sob milai tin ghanta.

vessel.en: A 40 L vessel with a lid. One cook.
vessel.l: Dhakoni thaka chalis litre bela. Ekjon randhoni.

season.en: All year, and every second day in thanda din.
season.l: Pura bochor, aru thanda din te dui din te ekbar.

recipes.name: Pumpkin Khichdi
recipes.sub: Pumpkin cooked into the khichdi until it thickens it
recipes.sub_l: Kumra ke khichdi bhitorte gadha kore diya tak randha

method.en: Cut the kumra large, an inch to the side. A small dice dissolves and thirty-four litres is orange with nothing to find in it.
method.l: Kumra to dangor kori katibi, ek inch. Sana kata to gali jai aru 34 litre to komla rong hoi aru bhitorte bisari pabole kiba nathake.

method.en: The kumra goes in when the rice is half done. From the start it is gone; at the end it is raw in the middle.
method.l: Bhat adha randha homoi te kumra hala. Suru pora dile hera jai; hekh te dile majote kacha thake.

method.en: The kumra is what thickens this khichdi and no flour is needed. Six kilos in thirty-four is the whole measure.
method.l: Eitu khichdi ke gadha kora to kumra he aru gura nalage. Chowtis litre te sou kilo he pura maap.

method.en: Keep it looser than it should be. Kumra drinks for twenty minutes after the fire is out and one that is right in the kitchen is a solid in the hall.
method.l: Jiman lage tatu polka rakhibi. Jui namuwa pasote kumra pora bis minute pani suse aru rasoi te thik thaka to hall te tan hoi jai.

recipes.why: Ten rupees thirty a head. Six kilos of kumra takes the place of a kilo of dal and in sarot a Peren jhum gives more than the kitchen can use.
recipes.why_l: Ek manu te dosh taka tirish. Sou kilo kumra pora ek kilo dal laga jaga loi aru sarot te Peren laga jhum pora rasoi te labhoi pora bi bisi hoi.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Fifty minutes, and the kumra is cut while the rice comes to the boil.
start.l: Kunu saman bhijai rakha nalage. Pachas minute, aru bhat ukhalibole homoi te kumra katibi.

vessel.en: A 40 L vessel with a lid. One cook.
vessel.l: Dhakoni thaka chalis litre bela. Ekjon randhoni.

season.en: Sarot to thanda din, from the jhum and then the store room.
season.l: Sarot pora thanda din tak, jhum pora aru tar pasote bhoral pora.

recipes.name: Mustard Leaf Khichdi
recipes.sub: Mustard leaf folded in at the end so the khichdi stays green
recipes.sub_l: Khichdi hariyali thaka nimite sorisa pata to hekh te mila diya

method.en: Chop the pata and keep it aside until the khichdi is done. Cooked from the start, five kilos of it turns thirty-two litres the colour of a wet road.
method.l: Pata to kati kene khichdi hobole tak alag rakhibi. Suru pora randhile pas kilo pora 32 litre to bhija rasta rong hoi jai.

method.en: Fold it in with the fire off and put the lid on four minutes. The heat left in the vessel wilts it and nothing more is needed.
method.l: Jui bondh kori kene mila dibi aru sari minute dhaki dibi. Bela te thaka gorom pora eitu molai diye aru aru kiba nalage.

method.en: Cut the stalk in eight minutes before the leaf. The stalk is a third of the weight and it does not wilt in four minutes.
method.l: Dala to pata laga ath minute age te hala dibi. Dala to gathi laga tin bhag ekta aru sari minute te namolai.

method.en: Serve within the half hour. Pata in a warm vessel goes from green to grey faster than any other leaf on this shelf.
method.l: Adha ghanta bhitorte dibi. Gorom bela te pata to eitu thak te thaka dusra pata sob pora bhi joldi hariyali pora dhusor hoi jai.

recipes.why: Ten rupees ninety a head, and in thanda din the pata is the cheapest green at Kohima bazar. Green on a plate in that month is worth putting on the board for its own sake.
recipes.why_l: Ek manu te dosh taka nobbei, aru thanda din te Kohima bazar te sorisa pata he sobse sosta hariyali. Etu mah te thali te hariyali thakile nijorei board te likhi dibole loyak.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Forty minutes, and the pata is chopped while the khichdi cooks.
start.l: Kunu saman bhijai rakha nalage. Chalis minute, aru khichdi randha homoi te pata katibi.

vessel.en: A 40 L vessel with a lid. Two cooks — one for the chopping.
vessel.l: Dhakoni thaka chalis litre bela. Duijon randhoni — ekjon katibole.

season.en: Sarot to gorom din, while the pata is in the market.
season.l: Sarot pora gorom din tak, pata bazar te thaka homoi te.

recipes.name: Soybean Khichdi
recipes.sub: Rice and fresh soybean cooked soft in one vessel
recipes.sub_l: Chaul aru notun soybean ke ekta bela te molom hobole tak randha

method.en: Soak the soybean eight hours and cook it half done before the rice goes in. Started together, the rice is paste while the bean is still a bead.
method.l: Soybean to ath ghanta bhijai kene chaul hala age te adha randhi lobi. Eke logote suru korile guti to guti nisina thaka homoi te bhat to dola hoi jai.

method.en: Rub the skins off after soaking. A soybean skin does not soften and it is felt in every spoon of thirty-two litres.
method.l: Bhijai diya pasote chal khan mosali kene ulai dibi. Soybean laga chal to molom nohoi aru 32 litre laga chamos sob te pai.

method.en: Four parts water to one of grain and let it go soft. This is not a bhat; a khichdi with separate grains has failed at what it was for.
method.l: Ek bhag chaul te sari bhag pani, aru molom hobole dibi. Eitu bhat nohoi; guti alag alag thaka khichdi pora tar kaam nakore.

method.en: Raw mustard oil over each plate at the counter. In a Naga khichdi that spoon of uncooked oil is what a ghee would be elsewhere.
method.l: Dibole laga jagate thali sob upor te kacha sorisa tel. Naga khichdi te etu ek chamos kacha tel to dusra jagate ghee je hoi, etu he.

recipes.why: Twelve rupees sixty a head, one vessel and one cook. Two kilos of soybean gives a hundred people the protein of a meal without a second pot on the fire.
recipes.why_l: Ek manu te bara taka sathi, ekta bela aru ekjon randhoni. Dui kilo soybean pora jui te dusra bela nadi kene ek sou manu ke ek bela khana laga bol diye.

start.en: Soybean soaks eight hours. Start the evening before.
start.l: Soybean to ath ghanta bhijai. Age din laga sanjote suru koribi.

vessel.en: A 40 L vessel with a close lid. One cook.
vessel.l: Bhal kori dhaka chalis litre bela. Ekjon randhoni.

season.en: Borokhun to sarot, while the fresh bean is on the vine.
season.l: Borokhun pora sarot tak, notun guti lota te thaka homoi te.

recipes.name: Perilla Seed Powder
recipes.sub: Roasted ground perilla, the house blend
recipes.sub_l: Bhaja pisa nakhup, ghor laga masala

method.en: There is one ingredient on this page and that is the point. A Naga kitchen has no garam masala; ground perilla is what it reaches for instead.
method.l: Ei pata te ekta saman ase aru etu he asol kotha ase. Naga rondhon ghor te garam masala nai; iyar bodli te pisa nakhup cholai.

method.en: Roast in lots of no more than half a kilo. A full pan roasts unevenly and one scorched patch makes the whole grinding bitter.
method.l: Adha kilo pora bisi ek bar te nabhajibi. Bhorti bortan asaman bhaje aru ek jola bhag pura pisa saman tita kore.

method.en: Keep the flame at its lowest and move the seed constantly with a flat ladle.
method.l: Jui ke sob pora dhimai rakhibi aru samatal hatai pora guti ke hodai ghurai thakibi.

method.en: Take it off the moment it begins to pop and smell nutty. Perilla goes from roasted to burnt in about twenty seconds — this is the shortest window of any spice in these nine books.
method.l: Photka suru aru bhal gundh ulai loge loge namai lobi. Nakhup bhaja pora jola loi prai kudi second te jai — ei nota kitab bhitorte iyar somoi sob pora sotu ase.

method.en: Cool completely on a tray before grinding. Warm seed releases its oil and grinds to a sticky paste that will not keep.
method.l: Pisa age tray te pura thanda koribi. Gorom guti tel ulai aru lasa hoi jai jun nathake.

method.en: Grind coarse and store in glass away from the stove. Perilla is high in oil and turns rancid faster than sesame — make small quantities and finish them within six weeks.
method.l: Dhala kori pisibi aru chulha pora dur kaach te rakhibi. Nakhup te tel bisi ase aru til pora joldi kharab hoi — olop bonai choi hoptah bhitorte hekh koribi.

recipes.why: One ingredient, twenty seconds of judgement, and it is in half the recipes in this book.
recipes.why_l: Ekta saman, kudi second laga bujha, aru etu ei kitab laga adha recipe te ase.

start.en: Roast in small lots and cool completely. Grind the same day.
start.l: Olop olop kori bhajibi aru pura thanda koribi. Etu din te he pisibi.

vessel.en: A heavy pan and a stone grinder. One cook.
vessel.l: Bhari bortan aru pathor laga chakki. Ekjon randhoni.

season.en: Made in November after the harvest, and again in March.
season.l: November laga kheti pichote bonai, aru aru March te.

recipes.name: Roasted Sesame Powder
recipes.sub: Sesame ground with salt and chilli
recipes.sub_l: Nimok aru mircha logote pisa til

method.en: This is the dry dip that goes beside boiled food, and in these hills it does the work that a wet chutney does elsewhere.
method.l: Etu sukha chutney ase jun siddha khana logote thake, aru ei pahar te aru jagate bhija chutney jun kaam kore, etu he kore.

method.en: Roast the sesame on a dry pan on a low flame until it pops steadily and turns a shade darker.
method.l: Til ke sukha bortan te dhimai jui te lagatar photka aru rong olop gadha nohua loi bhajibi.

method.en: Take it off the moment it smells. Sesame goes from roasted to burnt in about thirty seconds and burnt til is bitter right through.
method.l: Gundh ulai loge loge namai lobi. Til bhaja pora jola loi prai tirish second te jai aru jola til bhitorte tita hoi.

method.en: Cool completely before pounding. Warm sesame turns to a paste instead of a powder.
method.l: Kuta age pura thanda koribi. Gorom til gura nohoi lasa hoi jai.

method.en: Pound with the salt rather than grinding in a machine. The salt keeps the seed from oiling up under the pestle.
method.l: Machine te napisi nimok logote kutibi. Nimok pora guti kutna tolote tel nachare.

method.en: Add the dried king chilli last and in a very small quantity — thirty grams in three kilos. This is a dip, not a chilli powder.
method.l: Sukha raja mircha hekh te aru bisi olop dibi — tin kilo te tirish gram. Etu chutney ase, mircha gura nohoi.

recipes.why: The dry dip that turns boiled tubers into a meal, and it keeps two months in a tin.
recipes.why_l: Siddha kacchu ke khana bonai diya sukha chutney, aru etu bortan te dui mahina thake.

start.en: Roast, cool and grind the same day. Keeps two months.
start.l: Etu din te he bhaji, thanda kori pisibi. Dui mahina thake.

vessel.en: A heavy pan and a mortar. One cook.
vessel.l: Bhari bortan aru hamandista. Ekjon randhoni.

season.en: All year.
season.l: Pura bosor.

recipes.name: King Chilli Powder
recipes.sub: Dried and ground raja mircha
recipes.sub_l: Sukhai pisa raja mircha

method.en: Grind this outdoors and never in a closed kitchen. The airborne dust from king chilli will empty a room and it genuinely hurts to breathe.
method.l: Etu bahar te pisibi aru kitia bhi bondh rondhon ghor te nohoi. Raja mircha laga dhuli hawa te ulai kora pura ghor khali kori dei aru asol te dukh diya nisina hoi.

method.en: Wear cloth over the nose and mouth and gloves on the hands, and wash the grinder outside afterwards.
method.l: Nak aru mukhot kapor bandhibi aru hath te glove lagabi, aru pichote chakki bahar te dhubi.

method.en: Dry the chillies whole in full sun for a week until they rattle when shaken.
method.l: Mircha ke pura ek hoptah roud te sukhabi jetia loi lorale khor khor kore.

method.en: Do not dry them over a fire. Smoke-dried king chilli tastes of the fire and not of the chilli, which is fine for a chutney and wrong for a powder.
method.l: Jui uporte nasukhabi. Dhuwa te sukha raja mircha te jui laga swad ase, mircha laga nohoi, jun chutney nimite thik ase kintu gura nimite bhul ase.

method.en: Grind in short bursts, letting the dust settle in the machine between each, and open the lid away from the face.
method.l: Olop olop kori pisibi, hodai bar majote dhuli boi jabo dibi, aru dhakni mukh pora dur kori kholabi.

method.en: One kilo of this powder is more than a temple kitchen will use in a year. Label the jar clearly and keep it separate from the ordinary chilli.
method.l: Ei gura ek kilo mandir laga rondhon ghor te ek bosor te bhi nahekh hobo. Bortan te bhal kori naam likhibi aru sadharon mircha pora alag rakhibi.

recipes.why: A year's supply from four kilos, and the only recipe in these books that needs a mask.
recipes.why_l: Char kilo pora ek bosor laga saman, aru ei kitab bhitorte mukhot kapor lagi bole kowa ekmatra recipe.

start.en: Sun-dry the chillies a full week. Grind outdoors, wearing cloth over the face.
start.l: Mircha pura ek hoptah roud te sukhabi. Bahar te pisibi, mukhot kapor bandhi.

vessel.en: Drying trays and a dry grinder. One cook, gloved and masked.
vessel.l: Sukhai laga tray aru sukha chakki. Ekjon randhoni, glove aru mukhot kapor logote.

season.en: Made in October when the chillies ripen red.
season.l: October te bonai jetia mircha rangoli pake.

recipes.name: Dry Ginger Powder
recipes.sub: Ginger dried three days in the sun and milled fine
recipes.sub_l: Ada ke tin din rodh te sukhai kene misi kori pisa

method.en: Slice it thin before it goes in the sun. A whole ada takes eight days to dry in Dimapur and it goes black on the fourth.
method.l: Rodh te dibole age te misi kori katibi. Pura ada to Dimapur te sukhabole ath din lage aru sari din te kala hoi jai.

method.en: Three days in the sun and one night in a warm kitchen. A ginger that is not bone dry moulds in the tin within a fortnight.
method.l: Tin din rodh te aru ek raat gorom rasoi te. Puri sukha nathaka ada to dui hafta te tin bhitorte phul uthe.

method.en: Eight kilos of fresh ginger gives a kilo and a half of powder. A kitchen that does not know that buys eight and expects eight.
method.l: Ath kilo notun ada pora ek kilo adha gura hoi. Eitu najana rasoi pora ath kine aru ath he pabo koi bhabe.

method.en: Dry ginger is four times the strength of the fresh root. A hundred grams stands where four hundred of fresh would.
method.l: Sukha ada to notun ada pora sari gun tez. Ek sou gram to sari sou gram notun ada laga jagate thiya hoi.

recipes.why: Five hundred and eighty rupees a kilo of powder, and it is what lets a Jain plate be cooked in the same kitchen on the same morning as everything else.
recipes.why_l: Ek kilo gura te pas sou assi taka, aru eitu pora Jain thali ke dusra sob logote eke rasoi te eke bhore te randhibole diye.

start.en: Three days in the sun and one night indoors. Two hours at the mill.
start.l: Tin din rodh te aru ek raat ghor bhitorte. Chakki te dui ghanta.

vessel.en: A drying mat, a mill and a tin with a close lid. One cook.
vessel.l: Sukhabole chatai, chakki aru bhal kori dhaka tin. Ekjon randhoni.

season.en: Milled in sarot when the ginger comes off the jhum.
season.l: Jhum pora ada ulai juwa sarot te pise.

recipes.name: Garam Masala
recipes.sub: The warm powder for the north Indian dishes on the same menu
recipes.sub_l: Eke menu te thaka uttor Bharat laga khana karone gorom gura

method.en: Roast each spice on its own and not together. A clove is done in forty seconds and a coriander seed takes three minutes; roasted together, half the tin is burnt.
method.l: Masala sob alag alag bhajibi, eke logote nohoi. Lawang to chalis second te hoi jai aru dhania guti to tin minute lage; eke logote bhajile tin laga adha juli jai.

method.en: Let every spice go completely cold before it is ground. Warm spice in a mill turns to an oily cake and no sieve takes it apart.
method.l: Pisa nadi kene masala sob puri thanda hobole dibi. Chakki te gorom masala dile tel laga dola hoi jai aru kunu chalni pora bi alag koribole napare.

method.en: Two kilos and no more at a time. Ground garam masala is at its best for six weeks and a bigger tin smells of dust by the third month.
method.l: Ekbar te dui kilo mattro, tatu bisi nai. Pisa garam masala to sou hafta tak sobse bhal thake aru dangor tin hoile tin mah te dhula nisina gonda hoi.

method.en: Add it at the end of the cooking and not the start. A garam masala boiled twenty minutes has given up everything it had.
method.l: Randha laga suru te nohoi, hekh te dibi. Bis minute ukhalise garam masala pora tar sob kiba ulai diye.

recipes.why: Fourteen hundred and forty rupees a kilo and it lasts six weeks. Half the menu of a Dimapur temple is now north Indian and there is no honest way round keeping this tin.
recipes.why_l: Ek kilo te ek hajar sari sou chalis taka, aru sou hafta thake. Dimapur mandir laga menu laga adha to etiya uttor Bharat laga, aru eitu tin norakhi kene thakibole sidha rasta nai.

start.en: Roast, cool completely, grind and sieve. Two hours for two kilos.
start.l: Bhaji, puri thanda kori, pisi kene chani lobi. Dui kilo karone dui ghanta.

vessel.en: A dry pan, a cooling tray, a mill and a tin with a close lid. One cook.
vessel.l: Sukha kadai, thanda koribole tray, chakki aru bhal kori dhaka tin. Ekjon randhoni.

season.en: Ground every six weeks, all year.
season.l: Sou hafta pisote pise, pura bochor.

recipes.name: Coriander Powder
recipes.sub: Coriander seed roasted and milled alone, a tin every fortnight
recipes.sub_l: Dhania guti ke alag kori bhaji pise, dui hafta te ekta tin

method.en: Roast it on the lowest flame you can hold. Coriander burns from the inside and a seed that looks right can already be bitter.
method.l: Tumi dhori pora sobse olop jui te bhajibi. Dhania to bhitorte pora juli jai aru bhal dekha guti bi age pora tita hoi thakibole pare.

method.en: Ground alone and not in a garam masala. Three quarters of the coriander a temple kitchen uses goes into dishes that want no clove in them.
method.l: Garam masala te nohoi, alag kori pisibi. Mandir rasoi pora labhoi dhania laga tin bhag to lawang nalaga khana khan te jai.

method.en: Mill it medium and sieve it once. The husk that comes off in the sieve is what floats on a jhol and looks like dust on the surface.
method.l: Majhiya kori pisi kene ekbar chani dibi. Chalni te ulai juwa chal to jhol upor te bohi thake aru upor te dhula nisina lage.

method.en: Three kilos at a time and no more. A dhania gura is at its best for a fortnight and after a month it is a filler.
method.l: Ekbar te tin kilo mattro, tatu bisi nai. Dhania gura to dui hafta tak sobse bhal thake aru ek mah pisote khali bhorai luwa saman hoi.

recipes.why: Two hundred rupees a kilo. Coriander is the one spice a Naga kitchen uses by the kilo rather than the gram, and milling it in the house is half the price of the packet.
recipes.why_l: Ek kilo te dui sou taka. Naga rasoi pora gram te nohoi, kilo te labhoi masala to dhania he, aru ghor te pisile packet laga adha daam hoi.

start.en: Roast, cool and mill in one hour. Made every fortnight.
start.l: Ek ghanta te bhaji, thanda kori aru pisi lobi. Dui hafta te bonai.

vessel.en: A dry pan, a mill, a sieve and a tin. One cook.
vessel.l: Sukha kadai, chakki, chalni aru tin. Ekjon randhoni.

season.en: All year, every fortnight.
season.l: Pura bochor, dui hafta te.

recipes.name: Roasted Rice Flour
recipes.sub: Rice roasted and milled coarse, the thickener for every jhol
recipes.sub_l: Chaul ke bhaji kene mota pise — jhol sob laga gadha koribole saman

method.en: Roast it until it just takes colour, no further. Rice roasted brown thickens as well but every jhol it goes into tastes of toast.
method.l: Olop rong lowa tak bhajibi, tatu bisi nai. Mati rong tak bhajise chaul pora bi gadha kore kintu tar bhitorte juwa jhol sob te juli juwa swad ahe.

method.en: Mill it coarse. A fine flour goes to lumps the second it touches a hot jhol and the lumps do not break up again.
method.l: Mota kori pisibi. Misi gura to gorom jhol te lagi juwa loge loge dola hoi jai aru etu dola to aru nabhangibo.

method.en: Mix it to a slurry in cold water before it goes into the vessel. Thrown in dry, five kilos of it becomes five hundred lumps.
method.l: Bela te dibole age te thanda pani te gola kori lobi. Sukha thaka homoi te hala dile pas kilo pora pas sou dola hoi.

method.en: Keep it dry and use it in a month. Roasted rice flour picks up the damp of a Dimapur borokhun and goes musty in the tin.
method.l: Sukha rakhibi aru ek mah bhitorte labhoi. Bhaja chaul gura pora Dimapur laga borokhun laga bhija tani loi aru tin te gonda hoi jai.

recipes.why: Fifty-nine rupees a kilo, the cheapest thing on this shelf, and it is what lets a Naga kitchen thicken thirty litres of jhol with no besan and no cream.
recipes.why_l: Ek kilo te unsathi taka, eitu thak te sobse sosta, aru eitu pora Naga rasoi ke besan aru cream nadi kene tirish litre jhol gadha koribole diye.

start.en: Roast and mill in one hour. Made every month.
start.l: Ek ghanta te bhaji kene pisi lobi. Mah te bonai.

vessel.en: A dry pan, a mill and a tin with a close lid. One cook.
vessel.l: Sukha kadai, chakki aru bhal kori dhaka tin. Ekjon randhoni.

season.en: All year, and milled fresh every month.
season.l: Pura bochor, aru mah te notun kori pise.

recipes.name: Dried Mustard Leaf Powder
recipes.sub: Mustard leaf dried and milled, the winter green in a tin
recipes.sub_l: Sorisa pata ke sukhai kene pise — tin bhitorte thaka thanda din laga hariyali

method.en: Twenty kilos of fresh leaf gives two kilos of powder. A kitchen that does not know that dries twenty and expects six.
method.l: Bis kilo notun pata pora dui kilo gura hoi. Eitu najana rasoi pora bis sukhai aru sou pabo koi bhabe.

method.en: Dry it in the shade and not in the sun. Direct sun takes the green out and a grey powder is a colouring and nothing more.
method.l: Rodh te nohoi, chai te sukhabi. Sidha rodh pora hariyali ulai loi jai aru dhusor gura to rong diya saman mattro.

method.en: Strip the stalk out before it dries. A dried stalk will not mill and what comes out of the machine is a fibre that sits on the tongue.
method.l: Sukhi juwa age te dala to ulai dibi. Sukha dala to chakki te napise aru machine pora ulai juwa to jibha te bohi thaka tantu hoi.

method.en: Use it in a jhol and never in a chutney. Two tablespoons in thirty litres is a green vessel in thanda din; a spoon of it raw is a dust.
method.l: Jhol te labhoi, chutney te kotina bi nohoi. Tirish litre te dui dangor chamos dile thanda din te hariyali bela hoi; kacha ek chamos to dhula he.

recipes.why: Two hundred and forty-nine rupees a kilo and it keeps four months. In gorom din the pata is fifteen rupees a kilo and twenty kilos dried then is a green jhol in the middle of thanda din.
recipes.why_l: Ek kilo te dui sou unopochas taka, aru sari mah thake. Gorom din te sorisa pata to kilo te pandhra taka, aru etu homoi te sukhai diya bis kilo pora thanda din laga majote hariyali jhol hoi.

start.en: Three days in the shade, then milled. Made once in gorom din.
start.l: Tin din chai te, tar pasote pise. Gorom din te ekbar bonai.

vessel.en: Drying racks in the shade, a mill and a tin with a close lid. One cook.
vessel.l: Chai te sukhabole rack, chakki aru bhal kori dhaka tin. Ekjon randhoni.

season.en: Made in gorom din, used through thanda din.
season.l: Gorom din te bonai, thanda din bhori labhoi.

recipes.name: Plain Rice
recipes.sub: Naga hill rice, boiled and drained
recipes.sub_l: Naga pahar laga bhat, uthai pani ulai diya

method.en: Naga hill rice is short and slightly sticky and it is nothing like a basmati. Do not buy basmati for this book — it is wrong on the plate and costs three times as much.
method.l: Naga pahar laga chaul sotu aru olop lasa ase aru basmati nisina eku nohoi. Ei kitab nimite basmati nakinibi — thali te etu bhul ase aru tin gun dam ase.

method.en: Rinse until the water runs clear and soak twenty minutes.
method.l: Pani pariskar nohua loi dhubi aru kudi minute bhijabi.

method.en: Boil in an open vessel with plenty of water — far more than the rice will absorb — and drain the excess off.
method.l: Khula bortan te bisi pani logote uthabi — chaul jiman loi etu pora bisi — aru bacha pani ulai dibi.

method.en: This is the drained method and it is what these hills use. An absorption method gives a drier, separate grain that Naga food does not want.
method.l: Etu pani ulai diya tarika ase aru ei pahar te etu he cholai. Pani hukai diya tarika te sukha, alag dana hoi jun Naga khana te nalage.

method.en: Keep the rice water. It is drunk warm with salt, given to anyone unwell, and thrown away only by a wasteful kitchen.
method.l: Bhat laga pani rakhibi. Etu gorom kori nimok logote khai, bemar manu ke dei, aru khali nosto kora rondhon ghor pora he pheliya dei.

method.en: Cover and rest ten minutes after draining, and do not fork it through. The grains are meant to sit together.
method.l: Pani ulai pichote dhaki dohh minute rakhibi, aru kata pora nasarabi. Dana eke logote thakibole he ase.

recipes.why: The base of every meal in this book. Buying the right rice matters more than anything done to it afterwards.
recipes.why_l: Ei kitab laga hodai khana laga bhitti. Thik chaul kina, pichote iyate kora hodai kotha pora bisi dorkari ase.

start.en: Rinse and soak twenty minutes. Start forty minutes before serving.
start.l: Dhui kudi minute bhijabi. Diya age salish minute suru koribi.

vessel.en: A heavy 45 L vessel and a large strainer. One cook.
vessel.l: Bhari 45 L bortan aru dangor chalni. Ekjon randhoni.

season.en: All year, at every meal.
season.l: Pura bosor, hodai khana logote.

recipes.name: Sticky Rice
recipes.sub: Glutinous rice, steamed
recipes.sub_l: Chipchipe chaul, bhap diya

method.en: Sticky rice is never boiled. It is soaked and then steamed, and boiling it gives a solid paste that cannot be served.
method.l: Chipchipe chaul kitia bhi nauthabi. Etu bhijai titia bhap dei, aru uthaile tan lasa hoi jai jun dibo napare.

method.en: Soak at least six hours. The steamer cannot soften this grain the way boiling water would, so all the softening happens in the soak.
method.l: Komti kori choi ghonta bhijabi. Uthi thaka pani nisina bhap pora ei dana norom nohoi, etu karone sob norom hua bhijate he hoi.

method.en: Drain it thoroughly and line the steamer with a wet cloth rather than putting the rice on the tray.
method.l: Bhal kori pani ulai, tray te chaul nadhali bhap bortan te bhija kapor bichabi.

method.en: Steam forty minutes without opening the lid. Every look lets the steam out and the batch cooks unevenly.
method.l: Dhakni nakholi salish minute bhap dibi. Hodai bar sale bhap ulai jai aru khep asaman rondhe.

method.en: Turn the whole mass over once at the halfway point and steam on. The top layer cooks slower than the bottom.
method.l: Adha somoi te pura ekbar ulta koribi aru aru bhap dibi. Uporte laga parat tolote pora dhimai rondhe.

method.en: Serve it warm, in the hand. Sticky rice is eaten by pinching a ball off and dipping it, so no spoon is needed and none is given.
method.l: Gorom, hath te dibi. Chipchipe bhat ke gola bonai, chuboi kori khai, etu karone chamach nalage aru nadei.

recipes.why: Never boiled, always steamed. That one rule is the difference between rice and glue.
recipes.why_l: Kitia bhi nauthabi, hodai bhap dibi. Etu ek niyom he bhat aru lasa laga antor ase.

start.en: Soak the sticky rice six hours — overnight is better. Start ninety minutes before serving.
start.l: Chipchipe chaul choi ghonta bhijabi — rati bhor bhal. Diya age dhur ghonta suru koribi.

vessel.en: Three large steamers lined with cloth. Two cooks.
vessel.l: Tinta dangor bhap bortan, kapor bichai. Dujon randhoni.

season.en: All year. The rice of a feast day.
season.l: Pura bosor. Utsav laga din laga bhat.

recipes.name: Bamboo Steamed Rice
recipes.sub: Rice cooked inside green bamboo
recipes.sub_l: Kesa bahor bhitorte rondha bhat

method.en: Use only fresh green bamboo, cut the same day. Dry bamboo catches fire and burns through before the rice is cooked.
method.l: Khali kesa bahor cholabi, etu din te kata. Sukha bahor te jui lage aru bhat rondha age pura jole.

method.en: Cut each length so that one node closes the bottom, leaving a sealed tube.
method.l: Hodai tukra eneka katibi ki ek gathi tolote bondh thake, ek bondh nali nisina.

method.en: Fill each tube no more than two-thirds and add water to just cover the rice. Sticky rice swells hard and a full tube splits along its length.
method.l: Hodai nali dui bhag pora bisi nabhorabi aru chaul dhaki bole he pani dibi. Chipchipe chaul bisi phule aru bhorti nali lomba loi phati jai.

method.en: Plug the open end with a rolled banana leaf, pressed in firmly.
method.l: Khula mukh ke bandha kol pata pora tan kori bondh koribi.

method.en: Lean the tubes against the fire at an angle rather than laying them in it, and turn each one every ten minutes so they char evenly.
method.l: Nali ke jui te nahalai kinar te heli kori rakhibi, aru hodai dohh minute te ghurai dibi eneka hoile saman kori jole.

method.en: They are done in about an hour, when the outside is charred black all round. Split the tube with a knife at the table — the inner skin of the bamboo comes away with the rice and is eaten with it.
method.l: Prai ek ghonta te tiar hoi, jetia bahar pura kala jole. Mez te churi pora nali phalabi — bahor laga bhitor laga chal bhat logote ulai aru etu logote khai.

recipes.why: The vessel is the fuel and the flavour and it is thrown on the fire afterwards. Nothing to wash.
recipes.why_l: Bortan he jui aru swad ase aru pichote etu jui te pheliya dei. Majibole eku nai.

start.en: Cut fresh green bamboo the same morning. Start two hours before serving.
start.l: Kesa bahor etu puwa he katibi. Diya age dui ghonta suru koribi.

vessel.en: Forty lengths of green bamboo and an open wood fire. Three cooks.
vessel.l: Chalish tukra kesa bahor aru khula khuri laga jui. Tinjon randhoni.

season.en: Feast days, and only where green bamboo can be cut fresh.
season.l: Utsav laga din, aru khali jate kesa bahor notun kati bo pare.

recipes.name: Red Rice
recipes.sub: Red jhum rice cooked plain and drained, nothing added
recipes.sub_l: Jhum laga lal chaul ke sadharon randhi pani jhari diya, aru kiba nai

method.en: Wash it twice and no more. A red rice washed four times is a white rice and the bran is where the whole taste of a jhum chaul is.
method.l: Duibar dhuibi, tatu bisi nai. Saribar dhuwa lal chaul to boga chaul hoi jai aru jhum chaul laga sob swad to tar chal te thake.

method.en: Twice the water of a plain white rice and eight minutes longer. Red rice takes a bran off before the grain will soften.
method.l: Sadharon boga bhat laga pani pora duigun aru ath minute bisi. Lal chaul to guti molom howa age te tar chal ulai.

method.en: Drain it and do not let it absorb. A lal bhat that has drunk its water is a porridge and thirty kilos of it cannot be served on a leaf.
method.l: Pani jhari dibi aru suki jabole nadibi. Tar pani suki juwa lal bhat to jaul hoi jai aru tirish kilo ke pata te dibole napare.

method.en: Keep the drained water for a jhol. Ten kilos of red rice gives eight litres of dark water and it is a vessel of its own.
method.l: Jhari diya pani to jhol karone rakhibi. Dosh kilo lal chaul pora ath litre kala pani hoi aru eitu nijorei ekta bela hoi.

recipes.why: Seven rupees sixty a head. A Mon jhum lal chaul is fifty rupees a kilo against forty for a plains rice, and a temple that buys it keeps a jhum sown.
recipes.why_l: Ek manu te sat taka sathi. Mon laga jhum lal chaul to kilo te pachas taka, samtal laga chaul to chalis; aru eitu kina mandir pora jhum ke ropa thaki dibole diye.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Thirty-five minutes and eight minutes standing.
start.l: Kunu saman bhijai rakha nalage. Paitirish minute aru ath minute rakha.

vessel.en: A 40 L vessel and a draining basket. One cook.
vessel.l: Chalis litre bela aru pani jharibole tukri. Ekjon randhoni.

season.en: Sarot to gorom din, after the jhum harvest.
season.l: Sarot pora gorom din tak, jhum laga dhan kata pasote.

recipes.name: Sesame Rice
recipes.sub: Plain rice turned through with roasted sesame and chilli
recipes.sub_l: Sadharon bhat ke bhaja til aru mircha loi mosala

method.en: Roast the til until the seeds jump and crush it coarse. A powdered til disappears into thirty kilos and nothing is tasted.
method.l: Til to guti khan uphal thaka tak bhajibi aru mota kore thecha dibi. Gura kora til to tirish kilo bhitorte hera jai aru kiba swad nathake.

method.en: Cook the rice drier than usual and let it cool ten minutes before it is turned. Warm rice breaks under a ladle and thirty kilos is a paste.
method.l: Bhat to sadharon pora sukha randhibi aru mosala nadi kene dosh minute thanda hobole dibi. Gorom bhat to chamos niche bhangi jai aru tirish kilo to dola hoi.

method.en: Turn it with two ladles and lift, do not stir. A rice stirred in a round breaks and the whole vessel goes to a single mass.
method.l: Duita chamos loi uthai kene mosalibi, ghurai nadibi. Ghurai diya bhat to bhangi jai aru pura bela to ekta dola hoi jai.

method.en: Raw mustard oil turned through at the counter. Heated oil coats the grain and the sesame slides off it onto the plate.
method.l: Dibole laga jagate kacha sorisa tel mila dibi. Gorom kora tel pora guti ke dhaki diye aru til to tar pora hukhi kene thali te pore.

recipes.why: Nine rupees thirty a head. Til grows on a Mokokchung jhum and a kilo of it gives thirty kilos of rice the fat it needs without a rupee of ghee.
recipes.why_l: Ek manu te no taka tirish. Til to Mokokchung laga jhum te hoi aru ek kilo pora ghee laga ek taka bi nadi kene tirish kilo bhat ke lagi thaka tel diye.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Forty minutes, and the rice cools ten of them.
start.l: Kunu saman bhijai rakha nalage. Chalis minute, aru tar dosh minute to bhat thanda howa.

vessel.en: A 40 L vessel, a dry pan and two long ladles. Two cooks.
vessel.l: Chalis litre bela, sukha kadai aru duita lomba chamos. Duijon randhoni.

season.en: All year, and after the sarot harvest above all.
season.l: Pura bochor, aru sarot laga dhan kata pasote bisi kori.

recipes.name: Curd Rice
recipes.sub: Rice cooled and folded through with salted curd
recipes.sub_l: Bhat ke thanda kori nimok diya dahi loi mila diya

method.en: The rice has to be completely cold. Warm rice in curd splits six kilos of it before the vessel reaches the hall.
method.l: Bhat to puri thanda hobole lage. Dahi te gorom bhat dile bela to hall tak najuwa age te sou kilo dahi phati jai.

method.en: Cook the rice softer than usual and break the grain a little. A separate grain will not hold curd and the vessel goes watery at the bottom.
method.l: Bhat to sadharon pora molom randhibi aru guti ke olop bhangi dibi. Alag thaka guti pora dahi dhori narakhe aru bela laga tolote pani hoi jai.

method.en: Fold it in an hour before the bell and no earlier. Curd in rice for three hours is a sour rice and nobody asked for one.
method.l: Ghanta baja ek ghanta age te mila dibi, tatu age nohoi. Bhat te tin ghanta thaka dahi pora tenga bhat hoi aru kunbi eitu manga nai.

method.en: Keep a litre of curd back and stir it in at the counter. Rice drinks curd for an hour and the vessel that was right in the kitchen is dry in the hall.
method.l: Ek litre dahi rakhi kene dibole laga jagate mila dibi. Bhat pora ek ghanta dahi suse aru rasoi te thik thaka bela to hall te sukha hoi jai.

recipes.why: Thirteen rupees sixty a head and no fire under it at the counter. On a gorom din when the hall is at thirty-two degrees it is the only rice a devotee finishes.
recipes.why_l: Ek manu te tera taka sathi, aru dibole laga jagate tar tolote jui nai. Hall to battis degree thaka gorom din te bhokot pora puri khuwa bhat to eitu mattro.

start.en: Rice is cooked two hours ahead and cooled. Curd folded in an hour before the bell.
start.l: Bhat to dui ghanta age te randhi thanda kore. Ghanta baja ek ghanta age te dahi mila diye.

vessel.en: A 40 L vessel, a cooling tray and a tempering pan. Two cooks.
vessel.l: Chalis litre bela, thanda koribole tray aru phoron laga kadai. Duijon randhoni.

season.en: Gorom din to borokhun, and on any day above thirty degrees.
season.l: Gorom din pora borokhun tak, aru tirish degree upor laga din khan te.

recipes.name: Pumpkin Rice
recipes.sub: Rice cooked with diced pumpkin so the grains take its colour
recipes.sub_l: Guti khan rong lobole karone kumra kati kene bhat randha

method.en: Dice the kumra large, an inch to the side. A small dice dissolves and thirty kilos of rice is orange with nothing in it.
method.l: Kumra to dangor kori katibi, ek inch. Sana kata to gali jai aru tirish kilo bhat to komla rong hoi aru bhitorte kiba nathake.

method.en: Put the kumra in when the rice is half done. From the start it is gone; at the end it is raw in the middle.
method.l: Bhat adha randha homoi te kumra hala dibi. Suru pora dile hera jai; hekh te dile majote kacha thake.

method.en: Cook the rice drier than usual. A kumra gives up water for twenty minutes after the fire is out and a wet vessel is a khichdi.
method.l: Bhat to sadharon pora sukha randhibi. Jui namuwa pasote kumra pora bis minute pani ulai aru bhija bela to khichdi hoi jai.

method.en: No sugar of any kind. A sarot kumra is sweet enough to be mistaken for a sweet rice already.
method.l: Kunu dhoron laga chini nai. Sarot laga kumra to age pora mitha bhat nisina bhabibole para tak mitha hoi.

recipes.why: Eight rupees seventy a head, the cheapest rice in this book. In sarot a Peren jhum gives more kumra than the kitchen can use and four kilos colours thirty.
recipes.why_l: Ek manu te ath taka sathi, eitu boi te sobse sosta bhat. Sarot te Peren laga jhum pora rasoi te labhoi pora bi bisi kumra hoi, aru sari kilo pora tirish kilo ke rong diye.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Forty minutes, and the kumra is diced while the rice comes to the boil.
start.l: Kunu saman bhijai rakha nalage. Chalis minute, aru bhat ukhalibole homoi te kumra katibi.

vessel.en: A 40 L vessel with a lid. One cook.
vessel.l: Dhakoni thaka chalis litre bela. Ekjon randhoni.

season.en: Sarot to thanda din, from the jhum and then the store room.
season.l: Sarot pora thanda din tak, jhum pora aru tar pasote bhoral pora.

recipes.name: Pulao
recipes.sub: Rice cooked in ghee with whole spice and the winter vegetables
recipes.sub_l: Bhat ke ghee te gutia masala aru thanda din laga sabji logote randha

method.en: Soak the basmati twenty minutes and no longer. An hour's soak gives a grain that breaks in the vessel and a pulao of broken rice is a khichdi with a garnish.
method.l: Basmati to bis minute bhijai rakhibi, tatu bisi nai. Ek ghanta bhijaile bela te bhanga guti hoi aru bhanga bhat laga pulao to upor te saji diya khichdi he.

method.en: Fry the whole spice in the ghee until it is smelt across the kitchen, then the rice. Spice added after the rice sits on top and gives nothing.
method.l: Gutia masala to pura rasoi te gonda pua tak ghee te bhajibi, tar pasote chaul. Chaul pasote diya masala to upor te bohi thake aru kiba nadiye.

method.en: One and a half measures of water to one of soaked rice. Two measures is the plain-rice ratio and it gives a pulao that sticks in the ladle.
method.l: Bhijai diya ek maap chaul te ek maap adha pani. Dui maap to sadharon bhat laga hisab aru eitu pora chamos te lagi juwa pulao hoi.

method.en: Off the fire, lid on, twelve minutes, and nobody opens it. Every look costs the vessel two minutes of steam and thirty kilos cannot be recooked.
method.l: Jui pora namai, dhaki dibi, baro minute, aru kunbi nakhulibo. Ekbar sale bela pora dui minute laga bhap hera jai aru tirish kilo ke aru randhibole napare.

recipes.why: Thirty-four rupees ninety a head, most of it the ghee and the basmati. This is the Hornbill rice and the wedding rice, and on any other day the hall gets a lal bhat.
recipes.why_l: Ek manu te chowtis taka nobbei, tar bisi bhag to ghee aru basmati. Eitu Hornbill laga bhat aru biya laga bhat, aru dusra din khan te hall to lal bhat pai.

start.en: Rice soaks twenty minutes. Fifty minutes in all, and twelve of them under the lid.
start.l: Chaul to bis minute bhijai. Sob milai pachas minute, aru tar baro minute to dhaki kene.

vessel.en: A heavy 40 L vessel with a close lid. Two cooks.
vessel.l: Bhal kori dhaka bhari chalis litre bela. Duijon randhoni.

season.en: Sarot to thanda din for the vegetables; at Hornbill with peas alone.
season.l: Sabji karone sarot pora thanda din tak; Hornbill te motor mattro loi.

recipes.name: Rice Flour Roti
recipes.sub: Flatbread from rice flour
recipes.sub_l: Chaul gura laga chapta roti

method.en: There is no wheat tradition in these hills, so the breads in this book are rice-based and there are only three of them. That is honest rather than a gap.
method.l: Ei pahar te gehu laga niyom nai, etu karone ei kitab laga roti chaul laga ase aru khali tinta ase. Etu kotha thik ase, komti nohoi.

method.en: Pour boiling water onto the rice flour, not the flour into the water, and stir it hard with a wooden spoon.
method.l: Uthi thaka pani chaul gura te dhalibi, gura ke pani te nohoi, aru khuri laga chamach pora jor pora ghurabi.

method.en: Boiling water, not warm. Rice flour has no gluten and it is the heat that gelatinises the starch — that gelatinised starch is the only thing holding the roti together.
method.l: Uthi thaka pani, gorom nohoi. Chaul gura te lesa nai aru gorom pora he maar gale — etu gala maar he roti ke dhori rakhe.

method.en: Knead it as soon as it can be handled, while still genuinely hot. A cooled dough will not come together and cannot be rescued.
method.l: Hath te dhoribo para loge loge, gorom thaka somoi te gundhibi. Thanda hoile ata nabandhe aru bachabo napare.

method.en: Pat between two greased sheets rather than rolling on a floured board, and keep the dough covered — it dries within minutes.
method.l: Sukha gura laga taktar te nabeli duita tel laga sheet majote thapibi, aru ata dhaki rakhibi — etu minute te sukhi jai.

method.en: Cook on a medium tawa, and expect a shorter shelf than a wheat roti. These are made to the line and go hard within twenty minutes.
method.l: Majot gorom tawa te sekhibi, aru gehu laga roti pora komti somoi thake bhabibi. Etu pangat logote bonai aru kudi minute te tan hoi jai.

recipes.why: Boiling water and hot hands. Nagaland eats rice, and this is what happens when rice has to become a bread.
recipes.why_l: Uthi thaka pani aru gorom hath. Nagaland bhat khai, aru bhat ke roti bonabo lagile etu he hoi.

start.en: The dough must be made with boiling water and used hot. Start eighty minutes before serving.
start.l: Ata uthi thaka pani pora bonabo lage aru gorom he cholabo lage. Diya age assi minute suru koribi.

vessel.en: Four heavy tawas. Four cooks.
vessel.l: Charta bhari tawa. Sarijon randhoni.

season.en: All year. Nagaland is rice country and this section is thin for that reason.
season.l: Pura bosor. Nagaland bhat laga desh ase aru etu karone ei bhag sotu ase.

recipes.name: Millet Roti
recipes.sub: Foxtail millet flatbread
recipes.sub_l: Kodo dhan laga chapta roti

method.en: Mix the millet flour with a fifth part rice flour. Pure millet has nothing to bind it and the roti falls apart as it is lifted.
method.l: Kodo gura logote pans bhag laga ek chaul gura milabi. Khali kodo te bandhi rakha eku nai aru roti uthaite bhangi jai.

method.en: Knead with hot water. Cold water gives a dough that crumbles under the hand.
method.l: Gorom pani pora gundhibi. Thanda pani laga ata hath tolote bhurbhuri jai.

method.en: Knead only as much as can be used in ten minutes. Millet dough dries and cracks faster than anything else in these books.
method.l: Dohh minute te jiman cholabo pare etu he gundhibi. Kodo laga ata ei kitab laga hodai ata pora joldi suki phate.

method.en: Pat between wet palms rather than rolling, turning the roti as you go, and keep the palms wet — dry hands crack the edge.
method.l: Bela nohoi bhija hath majote thapibi, roti ghurai thakibi, aru hath bhija rakhibi — sukha hath pora kinar phate.

method.en: Keep it thicker than a wheat roti. A thin millet roti tears when it is lifted and cannot be saved.
method.l: Gehu laga roti pora mota rakhibi. Pathla kodo roti uthaite phati jai aru bachabo napare.

method.en: Cook on a hot tawa on both sides until brown spots appear and serve at once.
method.l: Gorom tawa te duita phale rangoli daag ulai nohua loi sekhibi aru loge loge dibi.

recipes.why: Made from grain that grows where rice will not. Hot water and wet hands are the two requirements.
recipes.why_l: Bhat nohua jagate hoi thaka dhan pora bona. Gorom pani aru bhija hath — duita he dorkar.

start.en: Nothing rests. Knead in small lots as you go. Start eighty minutes before serving.
start.l: Eku rakhibole nai. Olop olop kori gundhi thakibi. Diya age assi minute suru koribi.

vessel.en: Five heavy tawas. Five cooks.
vessel.l: Panchta bhari tawa. Panchjon randhoni.

season.en: November to March, after the millet harvest.
season.l: November pora March loi, kodo kheti pichote.

recipes.name: Job's Tears Roti
recipes.sub: Hill grain flatbread
recipes.sub_l: Pahar laga dhan laga chapta roti

method.en: Job's tears flour is coarser and heavier than millet and needs a larger share of rice flour — about a third — to hold together at all.
method.l: Job's tears laga gura kodo pora dhala aru bhari ase aru bandhi bole bisi chaul gura lage — prai ek tritiya bhag.

method.en: Roast the sesame, crush it coarsely, and work it through the flour before the water goes in.
method.l: Til bhaji, dhala kori bhangai, aru pani halu age gura te milai lobi.

method.en: Knead with hot water and work only small lots at a time.
method.l: Gorom pani pora gundhibi aru ek bar te olop he koribi.

method.en: This dough is heavier than any other in this book and will feel wrong under the hand. That is correct — do not add more water to soften it.
method.l: Ei ata ei kitab laga hodai ata pora bhari ase aru hath tolote bhul lagibo. Etu thik ase — norom kori bole aru pani nadibi.

method.en: Pat thick between wet palms and lift it in one movement. Rolled thin it will not survive being picked up.
method.l: Bhija hath majote mota kori thapibi aru ekbarte uthabi. Pathla belaile etu uthate he bhangi jai.

method.en: Cook on a hot tawa on both sides and serve straight from it. Held even ten minutes it goes hard.
method.l: Gorom tawa te duita phale sekhi, tawa pora sidha dibi. Dohh minute rakhile bhi tan hoi jai.

recipes.why: The grain of the poorer terraces, made into a bread. Heavy by nature, and not to be corrected with water.
recipes.why_l: Kharab khet laga dhan pora bona roti. Nijei bhari ase, aru pani pora thik kori bole nalage.

start.en: Nothing rests. Knead in small lots as you go. Start eighty minutes before serving.
start.l: Eku rakhibole nai. Olop olop kori gundhi thakibi. Diya age assi minute suru koribi.

vessel.en: Five heavy tawas. Five cooks.
vessel.l: Panchta bhari tawa. Panchjon randhoni.

season.en: All year — the grain stores dry for a year.
season.l: Pura bosor — dhan sukha ek bosor thake.

recipes.name: Puri
recipes.sub: Wheat rolled small and fried to order in a deep kadai
recipes.sub_l: Gohum gura ke sana kori beli mangise homoi te gobhir kadai te bhaja

method.en: The dough is stiff, stiffer than a roti dough. A soft dough drinks oil and five hundred puri come out heavy.
method.l: Gura to tan, roti laga gura pora bi tan. Molom gura pora tel suse aru pas sou puri bhari hoi ulai.

method.en: A handful of sooji in the flour. It is what keeps a puri crisp for the twenty minutes between the kadai and the plate.
method.l: Gura te ek muthi sooji. Kadai aru thali majote thaka bis minute te puri ke kurkuri rakha to eitu he.

method.en: Rest the dough half an hour and no longer. A dough left an hour goes slack and the puri will not puff.
method.l: Gura to adha ghanta rakhibi, tatu bisi nai. Ek ghanta rakhise gura to molai jai aru puri to naphulibo.

method.en: Fry in lots of twenty and press each one down once with the ladle. That one press is what makes it rise and a puri pressed twice is flat.
method.l: Ekbar te bis kori bhajibi aru ekta ekta kori chamos loi ekbar chapi dibi. Etu ek chapa pora he uthai diye aru duibar chapa puri to chapta hoi.

recipes.why: Sixteen rupees sixty a head. Wheat is not a Nagaland crop and every kilo comes up the road, so this is the roti for a Hornbill and a plain bhat carries an ordinary day.
recipes.why_l: Ek manu te sula taka sathi. Gohum to Nagaland laga kheti nohoi aru kilo sob rasta pora ahe; karone eitu Hornbill laga roti aru sadharon din to sadharon bhat pora he chole.

start.en: The dough rests half an hour. Two hours in all for five hundred.
start.l: Gura to adha ghanta rakhe. Pas sou karone sob milai dui ghanta.

vessel.en: A deep kadai and two rolling boards. Three cooks.
vessel.l: Gobhir kadai aru duita belibole pira. Tinjon randhoni.

season.en: All year, at Hornbill and Janmashtami above all.
season.l: Pura bochor, Hornbill aru Janmashtami te bisi kori.

recipes.name: Paratha
recipes.sub: Wheat folded in layers with ghee and turned on a griddle
recipes.sub_l: Gohum gura ke ghee logote stor stor kori bhaj kene tawa te randha

method.en: The dough is soft here, softer than for a puri. A stiff dough will not take layers and the paratha comes off the tawa as a board.
method.l: Ithote gura to molom, puri karone pora bi molom. Tan gura pora stor nalobo aru paratha to tawa pora pira nisina ulai.

method.en: Ghee between the folds and not in the dough. Ghee kneaded in gives a rich flat bread; ghee folded in gives the layers.
method.l: Ghee to gura bhitorte nohoi, bhaj majote dibi. Gura te milai diya ghee pora dami chapta roti hoi; bhaj majote diya ghee pora stor hoi.

method.en: Three folds and no more. Every fold past three is a layer nobody can taste and a minute more on a tawa for three hundred.
method.l: Tin bhaj mattro, tatu bisi nai. Tin pora bisi bhaj to kunbi swad napua stor hoi aru tin sou karone tawa te ek minute bisi lage.

method.en: Stack them in a cloth-lined basket and never on a plate. A paratha on a metal plate sweats and the bottom of the stack is wet in ten minutes.
method.l: Kapor lagai diya tukri te thupi rakhibi, thali te kotina bi nohoi. Loha laga thali te paratha to ghami jai aru dosh minute te thup laga tolote bhija hoi.

recipes.why: Twenty-two rupees ninety a head, and the ghee is most of it. This is the morning bread of a festival day; on any other morning the hall gets pitha and chah.
recipes.why_l: Ek manu te bais taka nobbei, aru tar bisi khoros to ghee. Eitu utsav din laga bhorer khana; dusra bhore khan te hall to pitha aru chah pai.

start.en: The dough rests forty minutes. Two and a half hours in all for three hundred.
start.l: Gura to chalis minute rakhe. Tin sou karone sob milai dui ghanta adha.

vessel.en: Two large tawa and two rolling boards. Four cooks.
vessel.l: Duita dangor tawa aru duita belibole pira. Sarijon randhoni.

season.en: All year, on festival mornings.
season.l: Pura bochor, utsav laga bhore khan te.

recipes.name: Potato Paratha
recipes.sub: Wheat stuffed with mashed potato and chilli, rolled thick
recipes.sub_l: Gohum gura te micha alu aru mircha bhorai kene gadha kori bela

method.en: The filling must be completely dry and completely cold. A warm filling steams inside the paratha and tears it on the tawa.
method.l: Bhorabole saman to puri sukha aru puri thanda hobole lage. Gorom bhora saman pora paratha bhitorte bhap kore aru tawa te phatai diye.

method.en: Boil the alu in the skin and mash it warm, then let it cool. A potato peeled before boiling drinks water and the filling is wet whatever is done to it.
method.l: Alu to chal logote siddha kori gorom thaka homoi te micha dibi, tar pasote thanda hobole dibi. Siddha nokora age te chilai diya alu pora pani suse aru ki korile bi bhora saman to bhija thake.

method.en: Equal weights of dough and filling in each one. More filling than that and the paratha will not close; less and it is a plain paratha with a rumour in it.
method.l: Ekta ekta te gura aru bhora saman eke gathi. Tatu bisi bhorale paratha to bondh nohobo; kom hoile bhitorte kotha mattro thaka sadharon paratha hoi.

method.en: Roll from the centre out and turn the disc a quarter each time. Rolled in one direction the filling gathers at one edge and that edge splits.
method.l: Majote pora bahar loi belibi aru barbar chakti to sari bhag ekta ghurabi. Ek zonote belile bhora saman to ek dhar te joma hoi aru etu dhar phati jai.

recipes.why: Twenty-four rupees ninety a head and it is a meal on its own. On the morning of a long walk a devotee needs no jhol beside this and the kitchen saves a vessel.
recipes.why_l: Ek manu te chowbis taka nobbei, aru eitu nijorei ek bela khana. Dur jabole din laga bhore te bhokot ke ithor kasote jhol nalage aru rasoi pora ekta bela bachai.

start.en: Potatoes boil and cool the night before. Three hours on the day for three hundred.
start.l: Alu to age din laga raat te siddha kori thanda kore. Tin sou karone etu din te tin ghanta.

vessel.en: Two large tawa, a mashing tray and two rolling boards. Four cooks.
vessel.l: Duita dangor tawa, michibole tray aru duita belibole pira. Sarijon randhoni.

season.en: All year, and on any morning the hall is walking out.
season.l: Pura bochor, aru hall pora bahar jabole thaka bhore khan te.

recipes.name: Missi Roti
recipes.sub: Wheat and gram flour together on a dry griddle, no oil in it
recipes.sub_l: Gohum aru besan eke logote sukha tawa te, tel eku nai

method.en: Two parts wheat to one of besan and no more besan than that. Half and half gives a roti that cracks on the tawa and cannot be turned.
method.l: Ek bhag besan te dui bhag gohum, tatu bisi besan nohoi. Adha adha dile tawa te phata roti hoi aru ghurabole napare.

method.en: Knead with warm water. Besan does not take cold water and a cold-kneaded dough is still crumbling twenty minutes later.
method.l: Gorom pani loi mosalibi. Besan pora thanda pani nolobo aru thanda pani loi mosala gura to bis minute pisote bi bhangi thake.

method.en: Rest it a full hour. Besan needs the time to take up the water and a dough rolled early tears in the middle of every roti.
method.l: Puri ek ghanta rakhibi. Besan ke pani lobole homoi lage aru joldi bela gura pora roti sob laga majote phati jai.

method.en: A dry tawa and no oil on it. A missi roti is fried in nothing and an oiled one goes soft in the basket before the line has passed.
method.l: Sukha tawa, tar upor te tel eku nai. Missi roti to kiba nadi kene randhe aru tel diya to manu laga line puri nohua age te tukri te molom hoi jai.

recipes.why: Twelve rupees sixty a head, no ghee and no kadai. Besan is half the price of wheat at Dimapur bazar and this is the roti a thanda din can afford four of.
recipes.why_l: Ek manu te bara taka sathi, ghee aru kadai eku nai. Dimapur bazar te besan to gohum laga adha daam aru thanda din te sari khan dibole para roti to eitu he.

start.en: The dough rests a full hour. Two hours in all for four hundred.
start.l: Gura to puri ek ghanta rakhe. Sari sou karone sob milai dui ghanta.

vessel.en: Two dry tawa and two rolling boards. Three cooks.
vessel.l: Duita sukha tawa aru duita belibole pira. Tinjon randhoni.

season.en: All year, and every second day in thanda din.
season.l: Pura bochor, aru thanda din te dui din te ekbar.

recipes.name: Sesame Roti
recipes.sub: Rice flour kneaded with roasted sesame and pressed by hand
recipes.sub_l: Chaul gura ke bhaja til logote mosali kene hath loi chapi diya

method.en: Knead the chaul gura with boiling water and never cold. Rice flour in cold water will not bind and three hundred and fifty roti fall apart on the board.
method.l: Chaul gura to ukhala pani loi mosalibi, thanda kotina bi nohoi. Thanda pani te chaul gura to nabandhibo aru tin sou pachas roti to pira te bhangi jai.

method.en: Roast the til and crush it before it goes in. Raw sesame in the dough tastes of nothing and eight hundred grams of it is wasted.
method.l: Hala nadi kene til to bhaji kene thecha dibi. Gura te kacha til dile swad eku nathake aru ath sou gram nasto hoi.

method.en: Press each one out by hand on a wet cloth and do not use a pin. A rice flour dough cracks under a rolling pin however soft it is.
method.l: Ekta ekta kene bhija kapor te hath loi chapi dibi, beloni nolobi. Chaul gura laga gura to kotona molom hoilebi beloni niche phati jai.

method.en: A dry tawa and press the roti down with a cloth. A rice flour roti puffs at one edge and stays raw at the other unless it is held down.
method.l: Sukha tawa, aru roti to kapor loi chapi rakhibi. Chaul gura laga roti to ek dhar te phuli uthe aru chapi norakhile dusra dhar kacha thake.

recipes.why: Ten rupees ninety a head, and there is no wheat in it at all. A Mokokchung kitchen has rice flour by the sack and wheat by the kilo, and this roti is why.
recipes.why_l: Ek manu te dosh taka nobbei, aru tar bhitorte gohum eku nai. Mokokchung laga rasoi te chaul gura to boria te thake aru gohum to kilo te; karone eitu roti he.

start.en: Nothing rests. The dough is kneaded hot and shaped warm. Two hours in all.
start.l: Kiba rakha nalage. Gura to gorom thaka homoi te mosale aru gorom thaka homoi te banai. Sob milai dui ghanta.

vessel.en: Two dry tawa, wet cloths and a boiling kettle. Three cooks.
vessel.l: Duita sukha tawa, bhija kapor khan aru pani ukhalibole bela. Tinjon randhoni.

season.en: All year, and every second day in sarot.
season.l: Pura bochor, aru sarot te dui din te ekbar.

recipes.name: Bastenga Sabji
recipes.sub: Fermented bamboo shoot fried with potato
recipes.sub_l: Alu logote bhaja khomir uthi bahor gaj

method.en: Rinse the bastenga twice in cold water and squeeze it out hard. Straight from the jar it will take over the whole kadhai.
method.l: Bastenga ke thanda pani te duibar dhui, jor pora nisuri lobi. Bortan pora sidha halile etu pura kadhai dhori loi.

method.en: Fry the drained bastenga in the oil on a high flame for eight minutes before anything else goes in.
method.l: Aru eku halu age nisura bastenga ke tel te tez jui te ath minute bhajibi.

method.en: That frying is what turns a raw ferment into a dish. Bastenga added at the end tastes of the jar and nothing else.
method.l: Etu bhaja pora he kacha khomir ek khana hoi. Hekh te halile bastenga te khali bortan laga swad thake aru eku nohoi.

method.en: Add the diced potato and fry a further ten minutes without a lid, turning as little as possible.
method.l: Kata alu halibi aru dhakni nalagai dohh minute aru bhajibi, jiman komti ghurabo pare.

method.en: Salt it only at the end and taste first. Bastenga is salted from the jar and a heavy hand cannot be taken back.
method.l: Nimok khali hekh te aru age chaki lobi. Bastenga te bortan laga nimok ase aru bisi dile wapas nahoi.

method.en: Stir the roasted ground perilla in off the fire and finish with coriander.
method.l: Bhaja pisa nakhup jui bondh kori milabi aru dhonia pata halibi.

recipes.why: One jar and seven kilos of potato feed a hundred. Fry the ferment first or it never becomes a dish.
recipes.why_l: Ek bortan aru sath kilo alu ekso manu khilai. Khomir ke age bhajibi nohoile etu khana nohoi.

start.en: Rinse the bastenga twice. Start fifty minutes before serving.
start.l: Bastenga duibar dhubi. Diya age pochas minute suru koribi.

vessel.en: A wide 30 L kadhai. One cook.
vessel.l: Chaura 30 L kadhai. Ekjon randhoni.

season.en: All year — bastenga keeps a year in its jar.
season.l: Pura bosor — bastenga bortan te ek bosor thake.

recipes.name: Fiddlehead Fern Fry
recipes.sub: Young fern tips, quickly fried
recipes.sub_l: Kesa dhekia agor, joldi bhaja

method.en: Pick only the tightly curled tips. Once the frond has begun to open it is fibrous and bitter and no cooking will fix it.
method.l: Khali tan kori golap thaka agor he lobi. Ek bar agor khuli suru hoile etu naar aru tita hoi aru kunba rondhon pora thik nohoi.

method.en: Rub the brown papery scales off with the hands and wash in three changes of water.
method.l: Rangoli kagaj nisina chal hath pora ghohi ulabi aru tin bar pani bodli kori dhubi.

method.en: Blanch two minutes in boiling water and drain at once. This takes the bitterness out and sets the green.
method.l: Uthi thaka pani te dui minute halikori loge loge pani ulabi. Etu pora tita jai aru kesa rong thake.

method.en: Two minutes only. Longer and the tips go limp and grey and the whole point of the dish is lost.
method.l: Khali dui minute. Bisi hoile agor norom aru kala hoi jai aru pura khana laga mane harai jai.

method.en: Fry on a high flame with the lid off for six minutes. A lid steams them and they collapse.
method.l: Dhakni nalagai tez jui te choi minute bhajibi. Dhakni pora bhap hoi aru etu bhangi jai.

method.en: Add the salt only in the last two minutes and finish with toasted crushed sesame.
method.l: Nimok khali hekh laga dui minute te dibi aru bhaja bhanga til halibi.

recipes.why: Four months a year, free from the forest, and two minutes of blanching decides everything.
recipes.why_l: Bosor te char mahina, jongol pora muft, aru dui minute uthowa pora sob thik hoi.

start.en: Pick over and wash three times. Start forty minutes before serving.
start.l: Basi tin bar dhubi. Diya age salish minute suru koribi.

vessel.en: Two wide 30 L kadhais. Two cooks.
vessel.l: Duita chaura 30 L kadhai. Dujon randhoni.

season.en: May to August only, while the fronds are still curled.
season.l: Khali May pora August loi, jetia agor etiya loi golap thake.

recipes.name: Pumpkin Leaf Stir
recipes.sub: Pumpkin leaves and tendrils, fried
recipes.sub_l: Kumra pata aru lota agor, bhaja

method.en: The leaves, the tendrils and the young stems are all used. In these hills the pumpkin is grown as much for its leaves as for the fruit.
method.l: Pata, lota agor aru kesa dala sob cholai. Ei pahar te kumra ke phol nimite jiman, pata nimite bhi iman he lagai.

method.en: Strip the fibrous string from the stems and the tendrils. Left on, it catches between the teeth and there is no way to eat around it.
method.l: Dala aru lota pora naar ulabi. Thakise koile etu dant majote lage aru khabole tan hoi.

method.en: Wash in three changes of water. Vine leaves carry more grit than anything grown on a bed.
method.l: Tin bar pani bodli kori dhubi. Lota laga pata bagan laga pora bisi mati loi ahe.

method.en: Fry on the highest flame with the lid off. Pumpkin leaf holds a great deal of water and a lid turns the kadhai into a pot of soup.
method.l: Sob pora tez jui te dhakni nalagai bhajibi. Kumra pata te bisi pani thake aru dhakni pora kadhai ek soup laga bortan hoi jai.

method.en: Add the salt only in the last two minutes. Salted early the leaves collapse and release everything they hold.
method.l: Nimok khali hekh laga dui minute te dibi. Age nimok dile pata bhangi jai aru sob pani ulai.

method.en: Six minutes on the fire, no more. Stir the roasted ground perilla in off the flame.
method.l: Choi minute jui te, bisi nohoi. Bhaja pisa nakhup jui bondh kori milabi.

recipes.why: The part of the plant that most kitchens throw away, and here it feeds a hundred for the price of nothing.
recipes.why_l: Gach laga jun bhag bisi rondhon ghor pora pheliya dei, iyate etu eku dam nai kori ekso manu khilai.

start.en: String the tendrils and wash three times. Start forty minutes before serving.
start.l: Lota laga naar ulai tin bar dhubi. Diya age salish minute suru koribi.

vessel.en: Two wide 30 L kadhais. Two cooks.
vessel.l: Duita chaura 30 L kadhai. Dujon randhoni.

season.en: June to October, while the vines are running.
season.l: June pora October loi, jetia lota bare.

recipes.name: Colocasia Stem Fry
recipes.sub: Taro stems with sesame
recipes.sub_l: Til logote kacchu dala

method.en: Peel the stems with oiled hands or cloth. The raw sap makes the palms itch badly and does not wash off with water alone.
method.l: Dala ke tel lagai hath nohoile kapor pora chulabi. Kacha rosh pora hath bisi khujli kore aru khali pani pora nadhui.

method.en: Use only young stems. An older colocasia stem stays fibrous however long it is cooked and makes the throat itch as well.
method.l: Khali kesa dala lobi. Purana kacchu dala kiman rondhile bhi naar thake aru gola bhi khujli kore.

method.en: Cut into short lengths and salt them for twenty minutes, then squeeze out the liquid and throw it away.
method.l: Sotu tukra kori kati kudi minute nimok lagabi, titia pani nisuri pheliya dibi.

method.en: That salting and squeezing is what takes the itch out. Skip it and the whole hall complains.
method.l: Etu nimok lagai nisura pora he khujli jai. Etu charile pura hall te kotha hobo.

method.en: Fry on a high flame with the lemon juice added early rather than at the end. The acid is what finishes the job the salt started.
method.l: Tez jui te bhajibi, kaji nemu laga rosh hekh te nohoi age dibi. Nimok jun kaam suru korise, etu tenga pora hekh kore.

method.en: Add the tomato in the last five minutes and finish with toasted crushed sesame.
method.l: Bilahi hekh laga pans minute te halibi aru bhaja bhanga til dibi.

recipes.why: Salt, squeeze and lemon. Three steps against the itch, and none of them can be left out.
recipes.why_l: Nimok, nisura aru kaji nemu. Khujli logote tinta kaam, aru ekta bhi charibo napare.

start.en: Peel with oiled hands an hour ahead. Start fifty minutes before serving.
start.l: Ek ghonta age tel lagai hath pora chulabi. Diya age pochas minute suru koribi.

vessel.en: A wide 30 L kadhai. One cook.
vessel.l: Chaura 30 L kadhai. Ekjon randhoni.

season.en: June to October, while the stems are young.
season.l: June pora October loi, jetia dala kesa thake.

recipes.name: Potato Fry
recipes.sub: Potato cut small and cooked dry until every face has caught
recipes.sub_l: Alu ke sana kori kati kene tar mukh sob juli juwa tak sukha randha

method.en: Cut small, a half inch to the side, and keep the pieces even. A mixed cut gives some pieces raw and some to paste in the same ladle.
method.l: Sana kori katibi, adha inch, aru tukra khan eke maap rakhibi. Beleg beleg katile ekta chamos te kunba tukra kacha aru kunba dola hoi jai.

method.en: No water and no lid. A lid on sixteen kilos of potato steams it and a steamed potato is a boiled potato in oil.
method.l: Pani aru dhakoni eku nai. Solo kilo alu ke dhakile bhap hoi jai aru bhap howa alu to tel te thaka siddha alu he.

method.en: Turn it four times in forty minutes and no more. Every extra turn breaks a face and sixteen kilos turned constantly is a mash.
method.l: Chalis minute te saribar ghurabi, tatu bisi nai. Ekbar bisi ghurale ekta mukh bhangi jai aru barbar ghura solo kilo to dola hoi.

method.en: Asafoetida in the tempering. In a kitchen with no onion it is the only thing standing where the onion would.
method.l: Phoron te hing. Pyaj nathaka rasoi te pyaj laga jagate thiya thaka saman to eitu mattro.

recipes.why: Ten rupees thirty a head. Alu is in a Dimapur store room every month of the year, and this is the dry dish that goes beside a puri when nothing else has come in.
recipes.why_l: Ek manu te dosh taka tirish. Bochor laga mah sob te Dimapur bhoral te alu thake, aru dusra kiba nathaka homoi te puri laga kasote juwa sukha sabji to eitu he.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Forty minutes on the fire, in two batches.
start.l: Kunu saman bhijai rakha nalage. Jui te chalis minute, duibar kori.

vessel.en: A wide 30 L kadai and a flat ladle. One cook.
vessel.l: Chaura tirish litre kadai aru chapta chamos. Ekjon randhoni.

season.en: All year, and every third day in thanda din.
season.l: Pura bochor, aru thanda din te tin din te ekbar.

recipes.name: Pumpkin Fry
recipes.sub: Pumpkin cooked dry until the edges catch and go sweet
recipes.sub_l: Kumra ke tar dhar juli kene mitha howa tak sukha randha

method.en: No water at any point. Sixteen kilos of kumra gives up all the water it needs in the first ten minutes.
method.l: Kotina bi pani nai. Solo kilo kumra pora poila dosh minute te lagi thaka pani sob ulai diye.

method.en: Cook it in two batches in a wide kadai. Sixteen kilos at once steams in its own water and a steamed kumra is a wet jhol without a name.
method.l: Chaura kadai te duibar kori randhibi. Ekbar te solo kilo dile nijor pani te bhap hoi jai aru bhap howa kumra to naam nathaka jhol he.

method.en: Let the edges catch before it is turned. That caught edge is where the sweetness comes from and one turned every minute has none.
method.l: Ghurai nadi kene tar dhar juli jabole dibi. Etu juli juwa dhar pora mitha ahe aru minute minute ghurale eitu nathake.

method.en: No sugar. A sarot kumra is already sweet and one that has caught at the edges is sweeter still.
method.l: Chini nai. Sarot laga kumra to age pora mitha aru dhar juli juwa to aru bisi mitha hoi.

recipes.why: Seven rupees sixty a head, the cheapest dry dish in this book. In sarot a Peren jhum gives more kumra than the kitchen can use and sixteen kilos costs the carrying.
recipes.why_l: Ek manu te sat taka sathi, eitu boi te sobse sosta sukha sabji. Sarot te Peren laga jhum pora rasoi te labhoi pora bi bisi kumra hoi, aru solo kilo laga khoros to bhuka mattro.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Fifty minutes, in two batches.
start.l: Kunu saman bhijai rakha nalage. Pachas minute, duibar kori.

vessel.en: A wide 30 L kadai and a flat ladle. One cook.
vessel.l: Chaura tirish litre kadai aru chapta chamos. Ekjon randhoni.

season.en: Sarot to thanda din, from the jhum and then the store room.
season.l: Sarot pora thanda din tak, jhum pora aru tar pasote bhoral pora.

recipes.name: Cabbage Fry
recipes.sub: Cabbage shredded and cooked dry until the edges catch
recipes.sub_l: Bandha kobi ke kati kene tar dhar juli juwa tak sukha randha

method.en: No water at any point. Fourteen kilos of bandha kobi gives up three litres in the first ten minutes and that is all it needs.
method.l: Kotina bi pani nai. Choudda kilo bandha kobi pora poila dosh minute te tin litre ulai aru titan he lage.

method.en: Cook it uncovered. Under a lid the kobi steams and the smell reaches the far end of the hall before the vessel does.
method.l: Dhaki nadi kene randhibi. Dhaki dile kobi to bhap hoi aru bela puwa age te gonda pora hall laga hekh tak pai.

method.en: Two batches in a wide kadai. Fourteen kilos at once steams in its own water however hard the fire is pushed.
method.l: Chaura kadai te duibar kori. Ekbar te choudda kilo dile jui kotona joror dile bi nijor pani te bhap hoi jai.

method.en: Take it off while a shred still snaps. A kobi cooked through is grey and eighteen kilos of grey cabbage comes back.
method.l: Ekta tukra phata thaka homoi te namai lobi. Puri randhise kobi to dhusor hoi aru dhusor bandha kobi atharo kilo wapas ahe.

recipes.why: Ten rupees ninety a head. Bandha kobi keeps ten days in a Kohima store room where a green leaf keeps two, and fourteen kilos is a dry dish for a hundred.
recipes.why_l: Ek manu te dosh taka nobbei. Hariyali pata dui din he thaka Kohima bhoral te bandha kobi to dosh din thake, aru choudda kilo pora ek sou manu laga sukha sabji hoi.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Fifty minutes, in two batches, uncovered.
start.l: Kunu saman bhijai rakha nalage. Pachas minute, duibar kori, dhaki nadi kene.

vessel.en: A wide 30 L kadai, uncovered. One cook.
vessel.l: Chaura tirish litre kadai, dhaki nadi kene. Ekjon randhoni.

season.en: Sarot to gorom din, while the kobi is in the market.
season.l: Sarot pora gorom din tak, kobi bazar te thaka homoi te.

recipes.name: Soybean Fry
recipes.sub: Soybean boiled soft and fried dry with chilli and sesame
recipes.sub_l: Soybean ke molom hobole siddha kori mircha aru til loi sukha bhaja

method.en: Soak the soybean eight hours and rub the skins off. A soybean skin does not soften and it is felt in every spoon of eighteen kilos.
method.l: Soybean to ath ghanta bhijai kene chal khan mosali ulai dibi. Soybean laga chal to molom nohoi aru atharo kilo laga chamos sob te pai.

method.en: Boil it soft and drain it completely before it goes in the kadai. A wet soybean in oil throws the oil the moment it goes in.
method.l: Molom hobole siddha kori kadai te hala nadi kene pani puri jhari dibi. Tel te bhija soybean hala loge loge tel to uphali jai.

method.en: Let the edges catch before it is turned. A boiled bean fried without catching is a boiled bean and eighteen kilos of it comes back.
method.l: Ghurai nadi kene tar dhar juli jabole dibi. Nojuli kene bhajise siddha guti to siddha guti he thake aru atharo kilo wapas ahe.

method.en: Roast the til and crush it in at the end. It is what makes eighteen kilos of bean taste like something a cook decided on.
method.l: Til to bhaji kene hekh te thecha dibi. Eitu pora atharo kilo guti ke randhoni pora bhabi kene bonai diya nisina swad ahe.

recipes.why: Eleven rupees ninety a head. Five kilos of soybean gives a hundred people the protein of a meal and a dry tray keeps four hours on a counter without souring.
recipes.why_l: Ek manu te egaro taka nobbei. Pas kilo soybean pora ek sou manu ke ek bela khana laga bol diye aru sukha tray to dibole laga jagate sari ghanta tenga nohoi kene thake.

start.en: Soybean soaks eight hours and boils an hour. Start the evening before.
start.l: Soybean to ath ghanta bhijai aru ek ghanta siddha hoi. Age din laga sanjote suru koribi.

vessel.en: A boiling pot, a draining basket and a wide 30 L kadai. Two cooks.
vessel.l: Ukhalibole bela, pani jharibole tukri aru chaura tirish litre kadai. Duijon randhoni.

season.en: Sarot to gorom din, out of the granary.
season.l: Sarot pora gorom din tak, bhoral pora.

recipes.name: Axone Aloo
recipes.sub: Fermented soybean with potato
recipes.sub_l: Alu logote khomir uthi soybean

method.en: Axone is used in small quantity. A kilo and a half serves a hundred, and a heavier hand makes the dish unpleasant rather than stronger.
method.l: Axone olop he cholai. Dhur kilo ekso manu nimite ase, aru bisi dile khana jor nohoi kharab hoi.

method.en: Crumble the smoked cake and fry it in the oil for five full minutes before anything else goes in.
method.l: Dhuwa diya roti bhangai aru aru eku halu age tel te pura pans minute bhajibi.

method.en: That frying is the whole dish. Fried, axone smells nutty and deep; added raw at the end it smells only of the ferment and the hall will notice.
method.l: Etu bhaja he pura khana ase. Bhajile axone bhal aru gadha gundh dei; kacha hekh te halile khali khomir laga gundh ase aru hall te sob jani jabo.

method.en: Add the ginger and chilli, then the potato, and fry a further eight minutes.
method.l: Aduwa aru jaluk halibi, titia alu, aru ath minute aru bhajibi.

method.en: Add the tomato and water and simmer twenty minutes until the potato is soft enough to mash against the side.
method.l: Bilahi aru pani halibi aru alu ke bortan kinar te ghohibo para loi kudi minute rondhibi.

method.en: Mash a few pieces of potato into the gravy to thicken it, stir the ground perilla in off the fire, and salt last — axone is salted already.
method.l: Kisu alu tukra jhol te ghohi gadha koribi, pisa nakhup jui bondh kori milabi, aru nimok hekh te — axone te nimok pora ase.

recipes.why: The dish that makes the case for this whole book: entirely vegetarian, and it needs no onion, no garlic and no fish.
recipes.why_l: Ei pura kitab laga kotha koi diya khana: pura niramish, aru iyate piyaj, rosun nohoile mach eku nalage.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Start sixty minutes before serving.
start.l: Eku bhijai nalage. Diya age saathh minute suru koribi.

vessel.en: A wide 30 L kadhai. One cook.
vessel.l: Chaura 30 L kadhai. Ekjon randhoni.

season.en: All year. The dish this book is built on.
season.l: Pura bosor. Ei kitab jun uporte bonai ase etu khana.

recipes.name: Anishi with Yam
recipes.sub: Fermented colocasia leaf cake with yam
recipes.sub_l: Yam logote khomir uthi kacchu pata laga roti

method.en: Anishi is dried hard and must be soaked. Thirty minutes in warm water is enough to break it up; it will not soften completely and is not meant to.
method.l: Anishi tan kori sukhai ase aru bhijabo lage. Gorom pani te tirish minute pora etu bhangi jai; etu pura norom nohoi aru hobole bhi nalage.

method.en: Eight hundred grams serves a hundred. This is a strong ferment used in a small quantity, like a spice rather than a vegetable.
method.l: Ath sou gram ekso manu nimite ase. Etu jor khomir ase jun olop cholai, sabji nisina nohoi masala nisina.

method.en: Peel the yam with oiled hands and cut into large chunks. The raw sap makes the palms itch.
method.l: Yam ke tel lagai hath pora chulai dangor tukra kori katibi. Kacha rosh pora hath khujli kore.

method.en: Fry the soaked anishi in the oil for five minutes with the ginger before the yam goes in.
method.l: Yam halu age bhija anishi ke aduwa logote tel te pans minute bhajibi.

method.en: Add the yam and water and cook twenty-five minutes until it is soft. Yam is denser than potato and takes noticeably longer.
method.l: Yam aru pani halibi aru panchis minute norom nohua loi rondhibi. Yam alu pora tan ase aru bisi somoi loi.

method.en: Stir the ground perilla in off the fire. Keep it thick — anishi is smoky and a thin gravy loses it entirely.
method.l: Pisa nakhup jui bondh kori milabi. Gadha rakhibi — anishi te dhuwa laga swad ase aru pathla jhol te etu pura harai jai.

recipes.why: A leaf that was free in October, a year later doing the work of a spice. The most distinctive dish in this book.
recipes.why_l: October te muft pua pata, ek bosor pichote masala laga kaam kori ase. Ei kitab laga sob pora alag khana.

start.en: Soak the anishi cake thirty minutes. Start seventy minutes before serving.
start.l: Anishi roti tirish minute bhijabi. Diya age sattar minute suru koribi.

vessel.en: A wide 30 L kadhai. One cook.
vessel.l: Chaura 30 L kadhai. Ekjon randhoni.

season.en: All year — the cakes keep a year.
season.l: Pura bosor — roti ek bosor thake.

recipes.name: Bamboo Shoot with Pumpkin
recipes.sub: Fresh bamboo shoot boiled with pumpkin
recipes.sub_l: Kumra logote uthai diya notun bahor gaj

method.en: Boil the fresh shoot twice in fresh water, twenty minutes each, discarding the water both times. Raw bamboo shoot is genuinely toxic and this is not a step to shorten.
method.l: Notun gaj ke notun pani te duibar, hodai bar kudi minute uthai, duiyo bar pani pheliya dibi. Kacha bahor gaj asol te bikh ase aru etu kaam komti kori bole napare.

method.en: Peel down to the pale tender core and slice thin.
method.l: Bhitor laga norom sada bhag loi chal chulai pathla kori katibi.

method.en: Cut the pumpkin into large chunks with the skin on if it is a tender one. The skin holds the pieces together.
method.l: Kumra ke dangor tukra kori katibi, norom hoile chal logote. Chal pora tukra dhori rakhe.
