method.en: Cook the bamboo shoot fifteen minutes before the pumpkin goes in. Pumpkin collapses in twelve and the shoot needs longer.
method.l: Kumra halu age bahor gaj ke pandhero minute rondhibi. Kumra bara minute te gali jai aru gaj ke bisi somoi lage.

method.en: Add no water beyond what is listed. Pumpkin releases a great deal of its own and a heavy hand gives a soup.
method.l: Likha pora bisi pani nadibi. Kumra nijei bisi pani ulai aru bisi dile soup hoi jai.

method.en: Mash about a third of the pumpkin into the broth and stir the ground perilla in off the fire.
method.l: Prai ek tritiya bhag kumra jhol te ghohibi aru pisa nakhup jui bondh kori milabi.

recipes.why: The sweetness of the pumpkin against the sourness of the shoot, and both come off the same hillside in July.
recipes.why_l: Gaj laga tenga logote kumra laga mitha, aru duiyo July te eke pahar pora ahe.

start.en: Boil the fresh shoot twice, an hour ahead. Start seventy minutes before serving.
start.l: Notun gaj duibar uthabi, ek ghonta age. Diya age sattar minute suru koribi.

vessel.en: A 30 L vessel. One cook.
vessel.l: 30 L bortan. Ekjon randhoni.

season.en: June to September, while the fresh shoots are up.
season.l: June pora September loi, jetia notun gaj ulai.

recipes.name: Boiled Greens
recipes.sub: Mixed greens boiled with ginger and chilli
recipes.sub_l: Aduwa aru jaluk logote siddha mila pata

method.en: This is the dish on every Naga plate at every meal, and it has almost nothing in it. Doing less to it is doing it properly.
method.l: Etu hodai Naga thali te hodai khana logote thaka saman ase, aru iyate prai eku nai. Iyate komti kora he thik kora ase.

method.en: Mustard leaf, pumpkin leaf, colocasia leaf, roselle and fern tips all work. Wash in three changes of water.
method.l: Lai pata, kumra pata, kacchu pata, tenga pata aru dhekia sob cholai. Tin bar pani bodli kori dhubi.

method.en: Boil hard on a high flame with the lid off from start to finish. A lid traps the sulphur and the greens go dull olive within minutes.
method.l: Suru pora hekh loi dhakni nalagai tez jui te jor kori uthabi. Dhakni pora gondh bondh hoi aru pata minute te kala-kesa hoi jai.

method.en: Use very little oil — three hundred millilitres in twenty-two litres. This is a boiled dish, not a fried one, and that is true of most of this book.
method.l: Bisi olop tel — baish litre te tin sou millilitre. Etu siddha khana ase, bhaja nohoi, aru ei kitab laga bisi bhag te etu he ase.

method.en: Salt only in the last three minutes. Greens salted early collapse and release all their water.
method.l: Nimok khali hekh laga tin minute te dibi. Age nimok dile pata bhangi jai aru sob pani ulai.

method.en: Serve it wet, with its liquid. That broth is poured over the rice and is the best part of the dish.
method.l: Etu pani logote bhija kori dibi. Etu jhol bhat uporte dhale aru etu he khana laga sob pora bhal bhag ase.

recipes.why: Six ingredients, thirty minutes, and it is what these hills actually eat twice a day. No lid, ever.
recipes.why_l: Choi saman, tirish minute, aru ei pahar te din te duibar etu he khai. Dhakni kitia bhi nohoi.

start.en: Wash three times. Start thirty minutes before serving.
start.l: Tin bar dhubi. Diya age tirish minute suru koribi.

vessel.en: A wide 30 L vessel, uncovered. One cook.
vessel.l: Chaura 30 L bortan, dhaki nalagai. Ekjon randhoni.

season.en: All year with whatever the terrace and the forest gave.
season.l: Pura bosor, khet aru jongol pora jun paise etu logote.

recipes.name: Tomato Jhol
recipes.sub: Tomato cooked down thin with roasted rice flour
recipes.sub_l: Bilahi ke bhaja chaul gura logote polka randha

method.en: Roast the bilahi on the flame and peel it. The skin in a jhol rolls up into strings and every devotee finds one.
method.l: Bilahi to jui upor te puri kene chal sarabi. Jhol te chal to sutli nisina gutai jai aru bhokot sob pora ekta pai.

method.en: Mix the rice flour to a slurry in cold water before it goes in. Thrown in dry, four hundred grams of it becomes forty lumps.
method.l: Hala nadi kene chaul gura to thanda pani te gola kori lobi. Sukha thaka homoi te hala dile sari sou gram pora chalis dola hoi.

method.en: Cook the bilahi twenty minutes before the flour goes in. Flour in early stops the tomato breaking and the jhol tastes of raw fruit.
method.l: Gura hala nadi kene bilahi to bis minute randhibi. Age te gura dile bilahi bhanga to rukhai aru jhol te kacha phol laga swad ahe.

method.en: Keep it thin. A bilahi jhol is drunk off the plate and a thick one is a chutney that came to the wrong vessel.
method.l: Polka rakhibi. Bilahi jhol to thali pora khai aru gadha hoile bhul bela te aha chutney he.

recipes.why: Nine rupees thirty a head. Tomato is at Dimapur bazar every month of the year and the roasted rice flour does the work a cream would do in a plains gravy.
recipes.why_l: Ek manu te no taka tirish. Bochor laga mah sob te Dimapur bazar te bilahi thake aru samtal laga jhol te cream pora kora kaam to bhaja chaul gura pora kore.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Fifty minutes, most of it roasting and peeling.
start.l: Kunu saman bhijai rakha nalage. Pachas minute, tar bisi bhag to puri kene chal sarai.

vessel.en: An open flame for the roasting and a 35 L vessel. Two cooks.
vessel.l: Puribole khula jui aru paitirish litre bela. Duijon randhoni.

season.en: All year, and cheapest in sarot.
season.l: Pura bochor, aru sarot te sobse sosta.

recipes.name: Cabbage Jhol
recipes.sub: Cabbage and peas in a thin gravy with perilla
recipes.sub_l: Bandha kobi aru motor ke nakhup logote polka jhol te

method.en: Cut the kobi in wide pieces and not shreds. A shredded cabbage in a jhol disappears and twenty-six litres is a green water.
method.l: Kobi to chaura kori katibi, misi kori nohoi. Jhol te misi kata kobi to hera jai aru chabbis litre to hariyali pani hoi.

method.en: The peas go in with the fire off. Cooked twenty minutes they are grey and two kilos of grey peas is seen from the door.
method.l: Motor to jui bondh kori kene hala. Bis minute randhile dhusor hoi jai aru dui kilo dhusor motor to duar pora dekha pai.

method.en: Cook it uncovered. Under a lid ten kilos of cabbage steams and the smell reaches the far end of the hall.
method.l: Dhaki nadi kene randhibi. Dhaki dile dosh kilo kobi bhap hoi aru gonda to hall laga hekh tak pai.

method.en: Take it off while a piece still holds. Cabbage cooks for ten minutes after the fire is out and one that is right in the kitchen is a mash in the hall.
method.l: Ekta tukra tan thaka homoi te namai lobi. Jui namuwa pasote kobi to dosh minute randhi thake aru rasoi te thik thaka to hall te dola hoi jai.

recipes.why: Ten rupees ninety a head. Bandha kobi keeps ten days in a Kohima store room where a green leaf keeps two, and two kilos of peas make it a dish and not a filler.
recipes.why_l: Ek manu te dosh taka nobbei. Hariyali pata dui din he thaka Kohima bhoral te bandha kobi to dosh din thake, aru dui kilo motor pora eitu ke khali bhorai luwa saman nohoi, ekta khana bonai diye.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Forty minutes, uncovered throughout.
start.l: Kunu saman bhijai rakha nalage. Chalis minute, hekh tak dhaki nadi kene.

vessel.en: A 35 L vessel, uncovered. One cook.
vessel.l: Paitirish litre bela, dhaki nadi kene. Ekjon randhoni.

season.en: Sarot to gorom din, while the kobi is in the market.
season.l: Sarot pora gorom din tak, kobi bazar te thaka homoi te.

recipes.name: Paneer Jhol
recipes.sub: Paneer in a tomato and perilla gravy, no onion and no garlic
recipes.sub_l: Paneer ke bilahi aru nakhup laga jhol te, pyaj aru naharu eku nai

method.en: Roast the nakhup and grind it with the tomato and the cashew. Between them they do the whole job an onion base would do and the perilla costs a fifth of the cashew.
method.l: Nakhup to bhaji kene bilahi aru kaju logote pisi lobi. Duita milai kene pyaj laga bhetti pora kora kaam sob kore aru nakhup laga daam to kaju laga pas bhag ekta.

method.en: Cook the tomato paste twenty-five minutes before the ghee goes in. Under-cooked tomato is sour and a spoon of sugar hides it for a minute only.
method.l: Ghee hala nadi kene bilahi laga dola to pochish minute randhibi. Kom randhise bilahi to tenga hoi aru ek chamos chini pora ek minute mattro dhake.

method.en: Hold the cut paneer in warm salted water until the gravy is ready. Left dry on a tray five kilos hardens at the edges within the hour.
method.l: Jhol taiyar nohua tak kata paneer to nimok diya gorom pani te rakhibi. Tray te sukha rakhile ek ghanta te pas kilo laga dhar tan hoi jai.

method.en: The paneer goes in four minutes before serving and no earlier. Five kilos boiled in gravy is five kilos of rubber at the counter.
method.l: Dibole laga sari minute age te paneer hala, tatu age nohoi. Jhol te ukhalise pas kilo to dibole laga jagate pas kilo rubber hoi.

recipes.why: Thirty-four rupees ninety a head, the dearest wet dish in this book. Paneer comes up the road and it shows in the price, so this is for Hornbill and a wedding.
recipes.why_l: Ek manu te chowtis taka nobbei, eitu boi te sobse dami jhol laga khana. Paneer to rasta pora ahe aru tar daam te eitu dekha pai; karone eitu Hornbill aru biya karone.

start.en: Cashew soaks an hour. Two hours in all.
start.l: Kaju to ek ghanta bhijai. Sob milai dui ghanta.

vessel.en: A 35 L vessel, a grinder and a holding pot for the paneer. Two cooks.
vessel.l: Paitirish litre bela, pisibole chakki aru paneer rakhibole bela. Duijon randhoni.

season.en: At Hornbill, Janmashtami and a wedding.
season.l: Hornbill, Janmashtami aru biya te.

recipes.name: Pumpkin with Axone
recipes.sub: Pumpkin cooked down thin and finished with fermented soybean
recipes.sub_l: Kumra ke polka randhi kene hekh te axone diya

method.en: The axone goes in with the fire off. Boiled twenty minutes it loses the smell it is bought for and becomes an ordinary bean.
method.l: Axone to jui bondh kori kene hala. Bis minute ukhalile taike kina laga gonda to hera jai aru sadharon guti hoi jai.

method.en: Cook the kumra until it falls apart and do not mash it. The pumpkin is the body of this vessel and the axone is only the smell.
method.l: Kumra ke nijorei bhangi juwa tak randhibi, micha nadibi. Eitu bela laga gaw to kumra he aru axone to gonda mattro.

method.en: Cook it uncovered from the moment the axone goes in. Under a lid a kilo and a half of it will empty a hall.
method.l: Axone hala loge loge dhaki nadi kene randhibi. Dhaki dile ek kilo adha pora hall to khali kori dibo.

method.en: Taste before the salt goes in. An axone is salted in the jar and a hundred and sixty grams is already more than some jars want.
method.l: Nimok hala nadi kene swad sabi. Axone to bela te nimok di kene rakhe aru ek sou sathi gram to kunba bela karone age pora bisi hoi.

recipes.why: Nine rupees ninety a head. A kilo and a half of axone carries ten kilos of kumra, and in sarot the kumra costs the carrying.
recipes.why_l: Ek manu te no taka nobbei. Ek kilo adha axone pora dosh kilo kumra ke jai diye, aru sarot te kumra laga khoros to bhuka mattro.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Forty minutes, and the axone in the last five.
start.l: Kunu saman bhijai rakha nalage. Chalis minute, aru axone to hekh laga pas minute te.

vessel.en: A 35 L vessel, uncovered at the end. One cook.
vessel.l: Paitirish litre bela, hekh te dhaki nadi kene. Ekjon randhoni.

season.en: Sarot to thanda din, out of the jar put down in sarot.
season.l: Sarot pora thanda din tak, sarot te rakhise bela pora.

recipes.name: Naga Cucumber Salad
recipes.sub: Hill cucumber with chilli and sesame
recipes.sub_l: Jaluk aru til logote pahar laga kakri

method.en: The Naga cucumber is large, thick-skinned and pale yellow when ripe, and it is nothing like a salad cucumber from the plains.
method.l: Naga kakri dangor, mota chal aru paka hoile halodi rong hoi, aru plains laga salad laga kakri nisina eku nohoi.

method.en: Peel it thickly and cut the seeded core out. Both the skin and the core are tough and neither belongs in the bowl.
method.l: Mota kori chal chulabi aru guti thaka majot bhag ulai dibi. Chal aru majot duiyo tan ase aru duiyo bati te nalage.

method.en: Cut into thick pieces rather than thin. This is a substantial salad eaten as part of the meal, not a garnish.
method.l: Pathla nohoi mota tukra kori katibi. Etu khana laga bhag hoi kori khai diya bhorti salad ase, sajai diya saman nohoi.

method.en: Roast the sesame, cool it and crush it coarsely.
method.l: Til bhaji, thanda kori dhala kori bhangabi.

method.en: Use one king chilli to about four kilos of cucumber, chopped very fine. Any more and nobody finishes the bowl.
method.l: Prai char kilo kakri te ek raja mircha, bisi misi kori kata. Iyar pora bisi hoile kunei bati hekh nakore.

method.en: Add the salt and lemon at the counter, not in the kitchen. Salted early the cucumber weeps and the tray sits in liquid.
method.l: Nimok aru kaji nemu mez te dibi, rondhon ghor te nohoi. Age nimok dile kakri pani ulai aru tray pani te thake.

recipes.why: Salt at the counter, and one chilli to four kilos. Those two rules are the whole salad.
recipes.why_l: Nimok mez te, aru char kilo te ek mircha. Etu duita niyom he pura salad ase.

start.en: Cut within the hour of serving. Nothing is made ahead.
start.l: Diya laga ek ghonta bhitorte katibi. Eku age bonai narakhe.

vessel.en: Two large trays and sharp knives. Two cooks.
vessel.l: Duita dangor tray aru dhar churi. Dujon randhoni.

season.en: May to September, when the hill cucumber is in.
season.l: May pora September loi, jetia pahar laga kakri hoi.

recipes.name: Boiled Vegetable Broth
recipes.sub: Clear broth of whatever came in
recipes.sub_l: Jun saman paise etu laga pariskar jhol

method.en: There is almost no oil in this and no thickening at all. It is the plainest thing on a Naga table and it is drunk from the bowl.
method.l: Iyate prai tel nai aru gadha kora eku nai. Etu Naga mez laga sob pora sadharon saman ase aru bati pora khai.

method.en: Add the colocasia first and cook it fifteen minutes. It breaks down slightly and gives the broth what little body it has.
method.l: Kacchu prothom halibi aru pandhero minute rondhibi. Etu olop gali jai aru jhol ke jiman gadha ase etu dei.

method.en: Bruise the ginger with the back of a knife rather than grating it, so it can be lifted out at the end.
method.l: Aduwa ke ghohi nohoi churi laga pichote diya joreke bhangabi, eneka hoile hekh te ulai lobo pare.

method.en: Add the hard vegetables next and the soft ones ten minutes later.
method.l: Tan sabji pichote halibi aru norom sabji dohh minute pichote.

method.en: Keep the broth clear. Do not mash anything into it and do not stir it hard — a cloudy broth is a failed one here.
method.l: Jhol pariskar rakhibi. Iyate eku naghohibi aru jor pora naghurabi — ghula jhol iyate bhul ase.

method.en: Salt it late and lightly. This is served alongside a chutney and a ferment, both of which are already salted.
method.l: Nimok deri aru olop dibi. Etu chutney aru khomir logote dei, aru duiyo te nimok pora ase.

recipes.why: No oil, no thickening, and it uses the trimmings from everything else on the menu.
recipes.why_l: Tel nai, gadha kora nai, aru menu laga baki sob laga kata tukra cholai.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Start forty-five minutes before serving.
start.l: Eku bhijai nalage. Diya age paitalish minute suru koribi.

vessel.en: A 30 L vessel. One cook.
vessel.l: 30 L bortan. Ekjon randhoni.

season.en: All year.
season.l: Pura bosor.

recipes.name: Banana Flower Salad
recipes.sub: Shredded banana flower with sesame
recipes.sub_l: Til logote kata kol phul

method.en: Rub the hands with oil before starting. Banana flower stains the fingers black and the stain does not wash off for two days.
method.l: Suru kora age hath te tel lagabi. Kol phul pora angul kala hoi aru etu daag dui din loi najai.

method.en: Peel off the dark outer bracts one at a time. Inside each is a row of small florets, and from each floret the hard stamen and the clear plastic-like sheath must be pulled out.
method.l: Bahar laga kala pata ek ek kori chulabi. Hodai bhitorte sotu phul laga sari thake, aru hodai phul pora tan bhitor bhag aru pariskar plastic nisina chal ulabo lage.

method.en: This cleaning is slow and there is no way round it. Ten kilos takes three people an hour, and a flower cleaned carelessly is bitter and inedible.
method.l: Etu saf kora dhimai ase aru aru rasta nai. Dohh kilo nimite tinjon manu laga ek ghonta lage, aru sundor kori saf nokora phul tita aru khabo napara hoi.

method.en: Drop each cleaned piece straight into salted water as it is done, or it blackens within a minute.
method.l: Hodai saf kora tukra loge loge nimok pani te halibi, nohoile ek minute te kala hoi jai.

method.en: Boil the drained flower fifteen minutes and squeeze it out well. This takes the last of the bitterness.
method.l: Nisura phul ke pandhero minute uthai bhal kori nisuri lobi. Etu pora hekh laga tita bhi jai.

method.en: Toss with roasted crushed sesame, ginger, chilli and lemon, and salt at the counter.
method.l: Bhaja bhanga til, aduwa, jaluk aru kaji nemu logote milabi, aru nimok mez te dibi.

recipes.why: An hour of cleaning for three people, and worth it. Nothing else in this book has to be worked at like this.
recipes.why_l: Tinjon manu laga ek ghonta laga saf kora, aru etu thik ase. Ei kitab te aru eku eneka mehnat nalage.

start.en: Clean and soak the flower in salted water an hour ahead. Start ninety minutes before serving.
start.l: Phul saf kori ek ghonta age nimok pani te bhijabi. Diya age dhur ghonta suru koribi.

vessel.en: Two large trays and a bowl of salted water. Three cooks — cleaning is the bottleneck.
vessel.l: Duita dangor tray aru nimok pani laga bati. Tinjon randhoni — saf kora he deri hoi.

season.en: All year, and cheapest from July to October.
season.l: Pura bosor, aru July pora October loi sob pora sosta.

recipes.name: Pumpkin Soup
recipes.sub: Pumpkin boiled soft and pressed through a sieve, no cream
recipes.sub_l: Kumra ke molom hobole siddha kori chalni te chapi diya, cream eku nai

method.en: Peel it for a soup even though a jhol keeps the skin. The skin will not go through a sieve and it is the one thing a devotee finds in a bowl.
method.l: Jhol te chal rakhe hoilebi soup karone chilabi. Chal to chalni pora najabo aru bati te bhokot pora puwa saman to eitu he.

method.en: Roasted rice flour in place of a cream. Three hundred grams thickens twenty-two litres and a Naga kitchen has it on the shelf anyway.
method.l: Cream laga bodli bhaja chaul gura. Tin sou gram pora bais litre gadha kore aru Naga rasoi te eitu age pora thak te thake.

method.en: Press it through a sieve and do not use a blender. A blended pumpkin holds air and twenty-two litres of it froths over in the vessel.
method.l: Chalni te chapi dibi, blender nolobi. Blender te kora kumra pora hawa dhore aru bais litre to bela te phen hoi ulai jai.

method.en: Black pepper and no chilli. This is the one dish in the book that goes to the sick room and a mircha in it defeats the purpose.
method.l: Gul mircha, jhaal mircha nohoi. Eitu boi te bemar manu laga kamra te juwa khana ekta he aru tar bhitorte mircha dile tar kaam nasto hoi.

recipes.why: Seven rupees sixty a head, no cream and no dairy at all. In sarot a Peren jhum gives twelve kilos for the carrying, and this is the bowl that goes to whoever cannot take a full plate.
recipes.why_l: Ek manu te sat taka sathi, cream aru gakhir eku nai. Sarot te Peren laga jhum pora bhuka mattro laga daam te baro kilo hoi, aru pura thali khabole napara manu karone eitu bati he jai.

start.en: Nothing soaks. An hour, most of it boiling and sieving.
start.l: Kunu saman bhijai rakha nalage. Ek ghanta, tar bisi bhag to siddha aru chalni.

vessel.en: A 30 L vessel and a wide sieve. Two cooks.
vessel.l: Tirish litre bela aru chaura chalni. Duijon randhoni.

season.en: Sarot to thanda din, from the jhum and then the store room.
season.l: Sarot pora thanda din tak, jhum pora aru tar pasote bhoral pora.

recipes.name: Clear Greens Soup
recipes.sub: Mustard leaves boiled in plain water and drunk clear
recipes.sub_l: Sorisa pata ke sadharon pani te siddha kori sap thaka homoi te khuwa

method.en: No oil at any point and nothing else in the vessel. This is leaves and water and the whole art of it is not adding anything.
method.l: Kotina bi tel nai aru bela te aru kiba nai. Eitu pata aru pani he, aru tar pura kala to kiba nadiya he.

method.en: Twelve minutes and no more. Pata boiled twenty minutes gives a broth the colour of a wet road and the bitterness of a medicine.
method.l: Baro minute mattro, tatu bisi nai. Bis minute siddha kora pata pora bhija rasta rong aru dawai laga tita thaka jhol hoi.

method.en: Bruise the ada and drop it in whole, then take it out. Grated ginger clouds the broth and a clear soup should be looked through.
method.l: Ada to thecha kene pura hi hala dibi, tar pasote ulai anibi. Kasi diya ada pora jhol ke ghula kore aru sap soup to par dekha jabole lage.

method.en: Serve it hot and never reheated. A pata soup boiled a second time is bitter and twenty-two litres go back to the kitchen.
method.l: Gorom kori kene dibi, duibar gorom kotina bi nokoribi. Duibar ukhalise pata soup to tita hoi aru bais litre to rasoi te wapas jai.

recipes.why: Three rupees ninety a head, the cheapest wet thing in this book. In thanda din the pata is fifteen rupees a kilo and a bowl of it is what a Naga house drinks instead of a chah.
recipes.why_l: Ek manu te tin taka nobbei, eitu boi te sobse sosta jhol laga saman. Thanda din te sorisa pata to kilo te pandhra taka, aru Naga ghor te chah laga bodli eitu bati he khai.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Twenty-five minutes from a cold stove.
start.l: Kunu saman bhijai rakha nalage. Thanda chula pora pochish minute.

vessel.en: A 30 L vessel, uncovered. One cook.
vessel.l: Tirish litre bela, dhaki nadi kene. Ekjon randhoni.

season.en: Sarot to gorom din, while the pata is in the market.
season.l: Sarot pora gorom din tak, pata bazar te thaka homoi te.

recipes.name: Cabbage Salad
recipes.sub: Cabbage shredded raw and tossed with sesame and black salt
recipes.sub_l: Bandha kobi ke kacha kati kene til aru kala nimok loi mosala

method.en: Shred the kobi fine and do not chop it. A salad is eaten with the fingers and a chunk of cabbage cannot be picked up with anything else on it.
method.l: Kobi to misi kori katibi, dangor kori nakatibi. Salad to angoli loi khai aru kobi laga dangor tukra to tar upor te kiba lagai kene lobole napare.

method.en: Roast the til and crush it coarse. It is the whole dressing and no oil goes into a salad at all.
method.l: Til to bhaji kene mota kore thecha dibi. Eitu he pura mosala aru salad te tel eku nai.

method.en: Salt and lemon at the counter and not in the kitchen. Ten kilos of salted cabbage gives up two litres in half an hour and the tray is a soup.
method.l: Nimok aru nemu to rasoi te nohoi, dibole laga jagate. Nimok diya dosh kilo kobi pora adha ghanta te dui litre ulai aru tray to soup hoi jai.

method.en: Toss with the hands and not a ladle. A salad turned with a ladle bruises and the whole tray weeps within twenty minutes.
method.l: Chamos loi nohoi, hath loi mosalibi. Chamos loi mosala salad to chapi jai aru bis minute te pura tray pora pani ulai.

recipes.why: Six rupees ninety a head, no fire and no oil. Bandha kobi keeps ten days in a Kohima store room where a green leaf keeps two.
recipes.why_l: Ek manu te sou taka nobbei, jui aru tel eku nai. Hariyali pata dui din he thaka Kohima bhoral te bandha kobi to dosh din thake.

start.en: Nothing cooks. Shred half an hour before the bell; dress at the counter.
start.l: Kiba randha nalage. Ghanta baja adha ghanta age te katibi; dibole laga jagate mosalibi.

vessel.en: A shredding board and two wide trays. Two cooks.
vessel.l: Katibole pira aru duita chaura tray. Duijon randhoni.

season.en: Sarot to gorom din, out of the store room.
season.l: Sarot pora gorom din tak, bhoral pora.

recipes.name: Bamboo Shoot Salad
recipes.sub: Bamboo shoot boiled once, cut fine and tossed with sesame
recipes.sub_l: Bahor gaj ke ekbar siddha kori misi kati kene til loi mosala

method.en: Boil the gaj once in plain water and throw that water. The first water carries the sharpness that would otherwise take the tongue off.
method.l: Bahor gaj to ekbar sadharon pani te siddha kori kene etu pani to phelai dibi. Poila pani te jibha ke kati diya tak laga tez thake.

method.en: Squeeze it dry between the palms after boiling. A wet gaj will not take the sesame and the tray is a grey water by the time the line starts.
method.l: Siddha kora pasote hath talu majote sipi sukhai lobi. Bhija bahor gaj pora til nolobo aru manu laga line suru howa homoi te tray to dhusor pani hoi jai.

method.en: Cut it in strips along the grain and never across. Cut across, the shoot falls into short pieces and there is nothing to pick up.
method.l: Tar sira zonote lomba kori katibi, kotina bi tirasa nohoi. Tirasa katile bahor gaj to sana tukra hoi jai aru lobole kiba nathake.

method.en: No oil and no lemon. The gaj is sharp enough on its own and a lemon over it is a tray nobody can eat past two mouthfuls.
method.l: Tel aru nemu eku nai. Bahor gaj to nijorei tez aru tar upor te nemu dile kunbi dui muthi pora bisi khabole napara tray hoi.

recipes.why: Eight rupees seventy a head. In borokhun the shoot comes off the Tuensang hill for the cutting and eight kilos of it is a tray for a hundred with no oil bought at all.
recipes.why_l: Ek manu te ath taka sathi. Borokhun din te bahor gaj to Tuensang laga pahar pora kata mattro laga daam te ahe, aru tel eku nakina kene ath kilo pora ek sou manu laga tray hoi.

start.en: Boil and squeeze two hours ahead. Dress at the counter.
start.l: Dui ghanta age te siddha kori sipi lobi. Dibole laga jagate mosalibi.

vessel.en: A boiling pot, a squeezing cloth and two wide trays. Two cooks.
vessel.l: Ukhalibole bela, sipibole kapor aru duita chaura tray. Duijon randhoni.

season.en: Borokhun to sarot, while the fresh shoot is on the hill.
season.l: Borokhun pora sarot tak, notun bahor gaj pahar te thaka homoi te.

recipes.name: Chayote Soup
recipes.sub: Chayote and its leaf boiled to a clear broth with black pepper
recipes.sub_l: Iskus aru tar pata ke sap jhol howa tak siddha kori gul mircha diya

method.en: Cut the iskus in large pieces and leave the skin on. The skin is what keeps eight kilos from dissolving into a cloudy broth.
method.l: Iskus to dangor kori katibi aru chal to rakhibi. Ath kilo ke ghula jhol te gali jabole nadiye to chal he.

method.en: The leaf goes in the last four minutes. Boiled from the start, two kilos of iskus pata turns twenty-two litres the colour of a wet road.
method.l: Pata to hekh laga sari minute te hala. Suru pora siddha korile dui kilo iskus pata pora bais litre to bhija rasta rong hoi jai.

method.en: No oil and no rice flour. This is the one broth on the shelf that is meant to be looked through and a thickener spoils it.
method.l: Tel aru chaul gura eku nai. Eitu thak te par dekha jabole laga jhol ekta he aru gadha kora saman pora eitu nasto kore.

method.en: Black pepper and no chilli. An iskus soup is what goes to whoever cannot take a full plate and a mircha in it defeats the purpose.
method.l: Gul mircha, jhaal mircha nohoi. Iskus soup to pura thali khabole napara manu karone jai aru tar bhitorte mircha dile tar kaam nasto hoi.

recipes.why: Four rupees ninety a head, no oil and no dairy. An iskus vine on a Kohima fence gives fruit and leaf for eight months and both of them go into this vessel.
recipes.why_l: Ek manu te sari taka nobbei, tel aru gakhir eku nai. Kohima laga bera te thaka iskus laga lota pora ath mah dhori phol aru pata diye aru duita bi eitu bela te jai.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Thirty minutes from a cold stove.
start.l: Kunu saman bhijai rakha nalage. Thanda chula pora tirish minute.

vessel.en: A 30 L vessel, uncovered. One cook.
vessel.l: Tirish litre bela, dhaki nadi kene. Ekjon randhoni.

season.en: Borokhun to thanda din, off the fence behind the kitchen.
season.l: Borokhun pora thanda din tak, rasoi pisote thaka bera pora.

recipes.name: Sticky Rice with Jaggery
recipes.sub: Steamed sticky rice with jaggery and sesame
recipes.sub_l: Gur aru til logote bhap diya chipchipe bhat

method.en: This is close to the only sweet these hills make, and the book should say so rather than pad the section with dishes from elsewhere.
method.l: Ei pahar te prai etu he ekmatra mitha bonai, aru kitab te etu koi dibo lage, aru jagate pora saman dikori bhag bhoraile nohobo.

method.en: Soak the sticky rice six hours and steam it forty minutes, exactly as for plain sticky rice.
method.l: Chipchipe chaul choi ghonta bhijai, sadharon chipchipe bhat nisina he salish minute bhap dibi.

method.en: Melt the jaggery in a little water and strain it. Jaggery always carries grit and unstrained it goes into the rice.
method.l: Gur ke olop pani te galai chalibi. Gur te hodai kisu mati thake aru nachalile etu bhat te jai.

method.en: Cook the strained jaggery down to a thick syrup before the rice goes in. A thin syrup makes the rice wet and it will not hold.
method.l: Bhat halu age chala gur ke gadha syrup loi rondhibi. Pathla syrup pora bhat bhija hoi aru etu bandhi nathake.

method.en: Fold the hot steamed rice into the hot syrup. Both must be hot — cold rice will not take the syrup up and cold syrup will not coat.
method.l: Gorom bhap diya bhat ke gorom syrup te milabi. Duiyo gorom hobo lage — thanda bhat syrup nalobo aru thanda syrup chipke nai.

method.en: Add roasted crushed sesame and a little grated ginger at the end, and press into trays while warm.
method.l: Hekh te bhaja bhanga til aru olop ghosa aduwa dibi, aru gorom thaka somoi te tray te dabai dibi.

recipes.why: The one sweet these hills make, and it is rice and jaggery. No dairy, which is true of everything here.
recipes.why_l: Ei pahar laga ekmatra mitha, aru etu bhat aru gur ase. Dahi nai, jun iyate hodai saman te thik ase.

start.en: Soak the sticky rice six hours. Start two hours before serving.
start.l: Chipchipe chaul choi ghonta bhijabi. Diya age dui ghonta suru koribi.

vessel.en: Three steamers and a wide pan. Two cooks.
vessel.l: Tinta bhap bortan aru chaura kadhai. Dujon randhoni.

season.en: All year. The sweet of a feast day.
season.l: Pura bosor. Utsav laga din laga mitha.

recipes.name: Black Sesame Laddu
recipes.sub: Black sesame and jaggery balls
recipes.sub_l: Kala til aru gur laga gola

method.en: Black sesame is grown across these hills and is cheaper here than white. It is also more bitter, which is why the jaggery is not reduced.
method.l: Kala til ei pahar te hoi aru iyate sada til pora sosta ase. Etu olop bisi tita bhi ase, etu karone gur komti nakore.

method.en: Roast the sesame on a dry pan on a low flame until it pops steadily.
method.l: Til ke sukha bortan te dhimai jui te lagatar photka nohua loi bhajibi.

method.en: Take it off the moment it smells. Black sesame is hard to judge by colour because it is already dark, so go entirely by smell and sound.
method.l: Gundh ulai loge loge namai lobi. Kala til rong pora bujha tan ase kelemane etu age pora he kala ase, etu karone khali gundh aru awaj pora bujhibi.

method.en: Cool completely on a tray. Warm sesame added to syrup will not bind.
method.l: Tray te pura thanda koribi. Gorom til syrup te milai dile bandhi nathake.

method.en: Melt the jaggery with the water and oil and cook to the hard-ball stage — a drop in cold water should set firm and crack between the teeth.
method.l: Gur ke pani aru tel logote galai tan gola loi rondhibi — thanda pani te ek bindu tan jomibo lage aru dant pora bhangibo lage.

method.en: Mix in the sesame and grated ginger and roll at once with oiled palms. The mixture sets hard within minutes and cannot be reheated.
method.l: Til aru ghosa aduwa milai, tel lagai hath pora loge loge gola bonabi. Mishrun minute te tan jome aru aru gorom kori bole napare.

recipes.why: Two weeks in a tin, no dairy at all, and made from a seed these hills grow themselves.
recipes.why_l: Bortan te dui hoptah, dahi eku nai, aru ei pahar te nijei hoi thaka guti pora bona.

start.en: Roast and cool the sesame ahead. Keeps two weeks. Start two hours before needed.
start.l: Til age bhaji thanda koribi. Dui hoptah thake. Dorkar hoi age dui ghonta suru koribi.

vessel.en: A heavy pan and a wide kadhai. Two cooks.
vessel.l: Bhari bortan aru chaura kadhai. Dujon randhoni.

season.en: November to February, after the sesame harvest.
season.l: November pora February loi, til kheti pichote.

recipes.name: Job's Tears Kheer
recipes.sub: Hill grain cooked with jaggery and coconut
recipes.sub_l: Gur aru narikol logote pahar laga dhan

method.en: There is no dairy in these hills, so this kheer is made with coconut milk. That is not a substitution made for this book — it is how a sweet porridge is made here.
method.l: Ei pahar te dahi nai, etu karone ei kheer narikol laga gakhir pora bonai. Etu ei kitab nimite kora bodli nohoi — iyate mitha jaul eneka he bonai.

method.en: Soak the Job's tears six hours and boil it in plain water forty minutes before anything else goes in. This grain is hard and nothing sweet will soften it.
method.l: Job's tears choi ghonta bhijai, aru eku halu age sadharon pani te salish minute uthabi. Ei dhan tan ase aru mitha saman pora etu norom nohoi.

method.en: Add the coconut milk only when the grain is completely soft. Coconut milk added early splits over a long cook.
method.l: Narikol laga gakhir khali dhan pura norom hoile he halibi. Age halile lamba rondhon te etu phati jai.

method.en: Melt the jaggery separately, strain it, and add it off the fire.
method.l: Gur alag galai, chalibi, aru jui bondh kori halibi.

method.en: Jaggery added to hot coconut milk on the flame will curdle it, and there is no recovering it. Take the vessel off first.
method.l: Jui uporte gorom narikol laga gakhir te gur dile etu phati jai, aru wapas nahoi. Prothom bortan namai lobi.

method.en: Finish with grated coconut and a little ginger. It thickens hard as it cools, so pull it off looser than it should be.
method.l: Ghosa narikol aru olop aduwa halibi. Thanda hoile etu bisi gadha hoi, etu karone lage pora pathla namabi.

recipes.why: Coconut milk instead of dairy, because there is no dairy. The jaggery goes in off the fire or the pot splits.
recipes.why_l: Dahi nathaka karone narikol laga gakhir. Gur jui bondh kori halibi nohoile bortan phati jai.

start.en: Soak the Job's tears six hours. Start two hours before serving.
start.l: Job's tears choi ghonta bhijabi. Diya age dui ghonta suru koribi.

vessel.en: A heavy 30 L vessel. One cook who stays with it.
vessel.l: Bhari 30 L bortan. Ekjon randhoni jun logote thake.

season.en: All year — the grain stores dry for a year.
season.l: Pura bosor — dhan sukha ek bosor thake.

recipes.name: Rice Kheer
recipes.sub: Rice cooked down slowly in milk with cardamom
recipes.sub_l: Chaul ke gakhir te dhire dhire randhi elaichi diya

method.en: Wash the chaul and break it a little in the hand before it goes in. A broken grain gives up its starch and eighteen litres thickens without a spoon of flour.
method.l: Chaul to dhui kene hala nadi kene hath loi olop bhangi dibi. Bhanga guti pora tar mar ulai aru ek chamos gura nadi kene athara litre gadha hoi.

method.en: Two kilos in eighteen litres and no more. Three kilos gives a pudding and a kheer is a thing that is drunk.
method.l: Athara litre te dui kilo mattro, tatu bisi nai. Tin kilo dile pudding hoi aru kheer to khai luwa saman.

method.en: Stir the bottom every three minutes for the whole hour. Rice sinks and eighteen litres of milk burns under it with no smell reaching the cook.
method.l: Pura ek ghanta bhori tin minute pisote tolote ghurai dibi. Chaul to tolote bohi jai aru athara litre gakhir tar tolote juli jai, randhoni tak gonda bi napai.

method.en: Sugar in the last ten minutes. Added early it stops the rice softening and the grain stays hard through the vessel.
method.l: Chini to hekh laga dosh minute te. Age te dile chaul molom hobole nadiye aru pura bela te guti tan thake.

recipes.why: Twenty-four rupees ninety a head. Two kilos of chaul and eighteen litres of milk is the whole sweet; there is no khoya bought and no cream anywhere in it.
recipes.why_l: Ek manu te chowbis taka nobbei. Dui kilo chaul aru athara litre gakhir he pura mitha; khoya kina nai aru kotina bi cream nai.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Ninety minutes from a cold stove.
start.l: Kunu saman bhijai rakha nalage. Thanda chula pora nobboi minute.

vessel.en: A heavy 30 L vessel. One cook who does not leave it.
vessel.l: Bhari tirish litre bela. Ekjon randhoni, tai eitu chari najabo.

season.en: All year, at Hornbill and Moatsu above all.
season.l: Pura bochor, Hornbill aru Moatsu te bisi kori.

recipes.name: Vermicelli Kheer
recipes.sub: Vermicelli roasted in ghee and cooked in reduced milk
recipes.sub_l: Semiya ke ghee te bhaji kene homai diya gakhir te randha

method.en: Roast the semiya in ghee until it is the colour of a bay leaf. Unroasted, a kilo and a half turns twenty-two litres to glue.
method.l: Semiya to tezpat laga rong howa tak ghee te bhajibi. Bhaja nathakile ek kilo adha pora bais litre to lagi juwa dola hoi jai.

method.en: A kilo and a half in sixteen litres and no more. Semiya swells to four times its weight and two kilos is a vessel that cannot be poured.
method.l: Solo litre te ek kilo adha mattro, tatu bisi nai. Semiya to tar gathi laga sari gun phuli jai aru dui kilo dile bela to hala nadibole para hoi.

method.en: The semiya goes in only after the milk has reduced by a fifth. Added to full milk it swells before the milk has thickened.
method.l: Gakhir to pas bhag ekta homai juwa pasote he semiya hala. Puri gakhir te dile gakhir gadha nohua age te phuli jai.

method.en: Take it off looser than it should be. Semiya drinks for twenty minutes in the vessel and a kheer that is right in the kitchen is a pudding in the hall.
method.l: Jiman lage tatu polka thaki kene namai lobi. Semiya pora bela bhitorte bis minute suse aru rasoi te thik thaka kheer to hall te pudding hoi jai.

recipes.why: Twenty-six rupees fifty a head. A kilo and a half of semiya does what four kilos of chaul would, and it is ready in half the time a chaul kheer takes.
recipes.why_l: Ek manu te chabbis taka pachas. Ek kilo adha semiya pora sari kilo chaul je koribo, etu kore, aru chaul kheer laga adha homoi te taiyar hoi.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Ninety minutes from a cold stove.
start.l: Kunu saman bhijai rakha nalage. Thanda chula pora nobboi minute.

vessel.en: A heavy 30 L vessel and a roasting pan. One cook who does not leave it.
vessel.l: Bhari tirish litre bela aru bhajibole kadai. Ekjon randhoni, tai eitu chari najabo.

season.en: All year, on any festival day.
season.l: Pura bochor, utsav laga din khan te.

recipes.name: Semolina Halwa
recipes.sub: Semolina roasted long in ghee and cooked in a hot syrup
recipes.sub_l: Sooji ke ghee te bahut homoi bhaji kene gorom chini pani te randha

method.en: Roast the sooji in the ghee twenty-five minutes on a low flame. This is the whole dish; a fifteen-minute halwa tastes of raw semolina whatever is added after.
method.l: Sooji to olop jui te ghee logote pochish minute bhajibi. Eitu he pura khana; pandhra minute laga halwa to pasote ki dile bi kacha sooji laga swad thake.

method.en: The syrup goes in boiling and never cold. Cold syrup on hot sooji seizes and twenty kilos is lumps that no ladle will break.
method.l: Chini pani to ukhala homoi te hala, thanda kotina bi nohoi. Gorom sooji upor te thanda chini pani dile jam hoi jai aru bis kilo to dola hoi, kunu chamos pora bi bhangibole napare.

method.en: Two parts syrup to one of sooji by weight. Less and the halwa is dry by the time the vessel crosses the yard.
method.l: Gathi te ek bhag sooji te dui bhag chini pani. Kom dile bela to bari par howa homoi te halwa sukha hoi jai.

method.en: Off the fire, lid on, ten minutes. A halwa that has not stood is gritty at the centre and twenty kilos cannot be recooked.
method.l: Jui pora namai, dhaki dibi, dosh minute. Rakha nathaka halwa to majote balu nisina thake aru bis kilo ke aru randhibole napare.

recipes.why: Twenty-three rupees ninety a head, and the ghee is most of it. It is the sweet for a Hornbill; on an ordinary day sticky rice with jaggery carries the hall for eleven.
recipes.why_l: Ek manu te teis taka nobbei, aru tar bisi khoros to ghee. Eitu Hornbill laga mitha; sadharon din te gur logote chipchipe bhat pora egaro taka te hall ke chole.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Ninety minutes, and ten of them under the lid.
start.l: Kunu saman bhijai rakha nalage. Nobboi minute, aru tar dosh minute dhaki kene.

vessel.en: A heavy wide 30 L kadai with a lid. Two cooks.
vessel.l: Dhakoni thaka bhari chaura tirish litre kadai. Duijon randhoni.

season.en: All year, at Hornbill and a wedding above all.
season.l: Pura bochor, Hornbill aru biya te bisi kori.

recipes.name: Gulab Jamun
recipes.sub: Milk powder balls fried slow and soaked in a thin syrup
recipes.sub_l: Gakhir gura laga gola ke dhire bhaji kene polka chini pani te bhijai

method.en: Bind the dough and fry it inside twenty minutes. A milk powder dough left standing goes slack and the balls flatten in the ghee.
method.l: Gura to bandhi kene bis minute bhitorte bhajibi. Rakhi diya gakhir gura laga dola to molai jai aru gola khan ghee te chapta hoi.

method.en: Fry on the lowest flame that will keep them moving. A hot ghee browns the outside in a minute and the centre is raw milk powder at the counter.
method.l: Taikhan ghurai thaka tak sobse olop jui te bhajibi. Gorom ghee pora ek minute te bahar to mati rong kore aru dibole laga jagate majote kacha gakhir gura thake.

method.en: The syrup is one thread and no more. A thick syrup will not go into the jamun and six hundred of them sit in it dry.
method.l: Chini pani to ek sutli mattro, tatu bisi nai. Gadha chini pani to jamun bhitorte najabo aru sou sou gola to tate sukha bohi thake.

method.en: The syrup must be warm and the jamun hot when they meet. Cold syrup on a hot jamun and the skin closes; nothing goes in after that.
method.l: Duita mila homoi te chini pani gorom aru jamun gorom hobole lage. Gorom jamun upor te thanda chini pani dile tar chal bondh hoi jai; tar pasote kiba nabhitorte najai.

recipes.why: Forty-two rupees ninety a head. Every ingredient comes up the road and it shows in the price, so this is for Hornbill and a wedding and nothing else.
recipes.why_l: Ek manu te bayalis taka nobbei. Saman sob rasta pora ahe aru tar daam te eitu dekha pai; karone eitu Hornbill aru biya karone mattro.

start.en: The syrup is made first and kept warm. Three hours in all for six hundred.
start.l: Chini pani to poila bonai gorom rakhe. Sou sou karone sob milai tin ghanta.

vessel.en: A deep kadai, a 30 L syrup vessel and a rolling tray. Three cooks.
vessel.l: Gobhir kadai, chini pani karone tirish litre bela aru gola bonabole tray. Tinjon randhoni.

season.en: At Hornbill and a wedding.
season.l: Hornbill aru biya te.

recipes.name: Banana in Jaggery
recipes.sub: Ripe banana cooked down in jaggery until it holds a spoon
recipes.sub_l: Pakise kol ke chamos te thaki juwa tak gur te randha

method.en: Use the ripest kol on the cart and not the firm one. A firm banana holds its shape and this dish is meant to be a paste on a leaf.
method.l: Gari te thaka sobse pakise kol lobi, tan thaka to nohoi. Tan kol pora tar akar dhori thake aru eitu khana to pata te dola hobole lage.

method.en: Melt the gur separately and strain it. Field jaggery carries sand and grit in a sweet is what is remembered of it.
method.l: Gur to alag kori gola kene chani dibi. Kheti laga gur te balu thake aru mitha te balu thakile manu pora eitu he monte rakhe.

method.en: Cook it in a wide pan and not a deep vessel. Fourteen kilos in a deep pot steams instead of reducing and it will not hold a spoon.
method.l: Gobhir bela te nohoi, chaura kadai te randhibi. Gobhir bela te choudda kilo dile homai juwa bodli bhap hoi aru chamos te nathakibo.

method.en: Ghee at the end and only four hundred grams. More than that and the sweet separates on the leaf and the oil runs to the edge.
method.l: Hekh te ghee, aru sari sou gram mattro. Tatu bisi dile pata te mitha to alag hoi jai aru tel to dhar loi bohi jai.

recipes.why: Nine rupees ninety a head, the cheapest sweet in this book. In Peren the over-ripe kol is fifteen rupees a kilo because nobody wants it, and this is what a kitchen does with it.
recipes.why_l: Ek manu te no taka nobbei, eitu boi te sobse sosta mitha. Peren te bisi pakise kol to kunbi nolobo karone kilo te pandhra taka, aru rasoi pora etu loi eitu he bonai.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Fifty minutes in a wide pan.
start.l: Kunu saman bhijai rakha nalage. Chaura kadai te pachas minute.

vessel.en: A wide 30 L pan and a jaggery pan with a strainer. One cook.
vessel.l: Chaura tirish litre kadai aru chani thaka gur laga kadai. Ekjon randhoni.

season.en: All year, and cheapest in borokhun.
season.l: Pura bochor, aru borokhun din te sobse sosta.

recipes.name: Sesame Jaggery Chikki
recipes.sub: Hard sesame brittle
recipes.sub_l: Tan til laga chikki

method.en: Grease the trays and lay them out before beginning. Once the mixture is ready it sets in two minutes and there is no time to look for a tray.
method.l: Suru kora age tray te tel lagai tiar rakhibi. Mishrun tiar hoile dui minute te jome aru tray bisari bole somoi nai.

method.en: Roast the sesame on a dry pan on a low flame until it pops steadily and turns a shade darker.
method.l: Til ke sukha bortan te dhimai jui te lagatar photka aru rong olop gadha nohua loi bhajibi.

method.en: Cool it completely on a tray. Warm sesame added to syrup will not set hard.
method.l: Tray te pura thanda koribi. Gorom til syrup te milai dile tan nahoi.

method.en: Melt the jaggery with the water and oil and cook to the hard-crack stage — a drop in cold water should set glassy and shatter, not bend.
method.l: Gur ke pani aru tel logote galai, tan phata loi rondhibi — thanda pani te ek bindu kaach nisina jomibo aru bhangibo, bakibo nalage.

method.en: This is a harder stage than for a laddu. Under-cooked syrup gives a chikki that goes sticky in the tin within a week.
method.l: Etu laddu pora tan avastha ase. Komti rondha syrup laga chikki ek hoptah te bortan te lasa hoi jai.

method.en: Mix in the sesame and grated ginger, pour into the trays at once, level fast, and score into squares while still warm.
method.l: Til aru ghosa aduwa milai, loge loge tray te dhalibi, joldi saman koribi, aru gorom thaka somoi te chukona kori katibi.

recipes.why: A month in a tin and no dairy at all. The hard-crack stage is the only decision in it.
recipes.why_l: Bortan te ek mahina aru dahi eku nai. Tan phata avastha he iyate ekmatra faisla ase.

start.en: Grease the trays before starting — it sets in two minutes. Keeps a month.
start.l: Suru kora age tray te tel lagabi — etu dui minute te jome. Ek mahina thake.

vessel.en: A wide kadhai and four greased trays. Two cooks.
vessel.l: Chaura kadhai aru charta tel laga tray. Dujon randhoni.

season.en: November to February, in the dry months.
season.l: November pora February loi, sukha mahina te.

recipes.name: Perilla Jaggery Balls
recipes.sub: Roasted perilla bound with jaggery
recipes.sub_l: Gur pora bandha bhaja nakhup

method.en: Roast the perilla on the lowest flame until it just begins to pop, then take it off at once. Twenty seconds separates roasted from ruined.
method.l: Nakhup ke bisi dhimai jui te photka suru nohua loi bhaji, titia loge loge namai lobi. Bhaja aru kharab hua majote kudi second he ase.

method.en: Cool it completely and leave it whole rather than grinding. In a sweet the whole seed is wanted for the bite.
method.l: Pura thanda kori, napisi pura rakhibi. Mitha te chabole pura guti he lage.

method.en: Roast the rice flour separately on a dry pan until it smells nutty and turns pale gold.
method.l: Chaul gura alag sukha bortan te bhal gundh ulai aru halka soneli nohua loi bhajibi.

method.en: The rice flour is what stops these going sticky. Perilla is oilier than sesame and without the flour the balls sweat within a week.
method.l: Chaul gura he etu ke lasa hobole nadei. Nakhup til pora bisi tel ase aru ata nohoile gola ek hoptah te pisi jai.

method.en: Melt the jaggery with the water and oil and cook to the soft-ball stage — a drop in cold water should form a ball that flattens between the fingers.
method.l: Gur ke pani aru tel logote galai norom gola loi rondhibi — thanda pani te ek bindu gola hobo lage jun angul majote chapta hoi.

method.en: Mix in the perilla, rice flour and ginger and roll at once with oiled palms.
method.l: Nakhup, chaul gura aru aduwa milai, tel lagai hath pora loge loge gola bonabi.

recipes.why: The rice flour is what makes it keep three weeks. Without it, the perilla oil wins by the eighth day.
recipes.why_l: Chaul gura he etu ke tin hoptah rakhe. Etu nohoile aath din te nakhup laga tel jiti jai.

start.en: Roast and cool the perilla ahead. Keeps three weeks. Start two hours before needed.
start.l: Nakhup age bhaji thanda koribi. Tin hoptah thake. Dorkar hoi age dui ghonta suru koribi.

vessel.en: A heavy pan and a wide kadhai. Two cooks.
vessel.l: Bhari bortan aru chaura kadhai. Dujon randhoni.

season.en: November to February, after the perilla harvest.
season.l: November pora February loi, nakhup kheti pichote.

recipes.name: Roasted Job's Tears Laddu
recipes.sub: Ground hill grain with jaggery
recipes.sub_l: Gur logote pisa pahar laga dhan

method.en: Roast the whole grain on a dry pan until it darkens and smells like biscuit, then cool it completely and grind it coarse.
method.l: Pura dhan ke sukha bortan te rong gadha aru biscuit nisina gundh nohua loi bhaji, titia pura thanda kori dhala kori pisibi.

method.en: Roast it properly. Job's tears is hard and starchy and under-roasted flour tastes raw right through the laddu.
method.l: Bhal kori bhajibi. Job's tears tan aru maar ase aru komti bhaja ata laddu bhitorte kacha lage.

method.en: Grind coarse rather than fine. A fine flour gives a laddu that is pasty; coarse gives it the grain this sweet should have.
method.l: Misi nohoi dhala kori pisibi. Misi ata laga laddu lasa hoi; dhala pora etu mitha te thakibo laga dana ase.

method.en: Roast and crush the sesame separately and add it at the end so it stays crisp.
method.l: Til alag bhaji bhangai aru hekh te dibi eneka hoile etu kurkuri thake.

method.en: Melt the jaggery with the water and oil to a soft-ball stage and take it off the fire before the flour goes in.
method.l: Gur ke pani aru tel logote norom gola loi galai, ata halu age jui pora namai lobi.

method.en: Mix and roll at once with oiled palms. The mixture stiffens fast and cannot be reheated.
method.l: Milai tel lagai hath pora loge loge gola bonabi. Mishrun joldi tan hoi aru aru gorom kori bole napare.

recipes.why: Grain from the poorest terraces made into a sweet that keeps three weeks. Nothing here has to be bought in.
recipes.why_l: Sob pora kharab khet laga dhan pora tin hoptah thaka mitha. Iyate eku kinibole nalage.

start.en: Roast and grind the grain the day before. Keeps three weeks. Start two hours before needed.
start.l: Dhan ek din age bhaji pisibi. Tin hoptah thake. Dorkar hoi age dui ghonta suru koribi.

vessel.en: A heavy pan, a grinder and a wide kadhai. Two cooks.
vessel.l: Bhari bortan, chakki aru chaura kadhai. Dujon randhoni.

season.en: All year — the grain stores dry for a year.
season.l: Pura bosor — dhan sukha ek bosor thake.

recipes.name: Millet Laddu
recipes.sub: Millet flour roasted long in ghee and rolled with jaggery
recipes.sub_l: Kodo gura ke ghee te bahut homoi bhaji kene gur logote gola bonai

method.en: Roast the kodo gura thirty minutes and not fifteen. This is the whole dish; under-roasted millet tastes raw and no jaggery covers it.
method.l: Kodo gura to tirish minute bhajibi, pandhra nohoi. Eitu he pura khana; kom bhaja kodo to kacha lage aru gur pora dhakibole napare.

method.en: The flame stays low the whole thirty minutes. A brown flour at fifteen minutes is a burnt flour and five kilos is thrown.
method.l: Pura tirish minute jui olop thaki thakibole lage. Pandhra minute te mati rong howa gura to juli juwa gura aru pas kilo phelai dibole lage.

method.en: Melt the gur separately and strain it before it goes in. Field jaggery carries sand and grit in a laddu is what is remembered.
method.l: Hala nadi kene gur to alag kori gola kene chani dibi. Kheti laga gur te balu thake aru laddu te balu thakile eitu he monte thake.

method.en: Roll them while the mix is still too hot for a bare hand. Cooled, millet and jaggery set into a slab that has to be broken with a ladle.
method.l: Mila diya saman to khali hath karone bisi gorom thaka homoi te gola bonabi. Thanda hoile kodo aru gur to chamos loi bhangibole laga tan dola hoi jai.

recipes.why: Eleven rupees sixty a head and it keeps a fortnight in a tin. Kodo grows on a Phek jhum where rice will not, and gur is the only thing bought for it.
recipes.why_l: Ek manu te egaro taka sathi, aru tin te dui hafta thake. Bhat nahua Phek laga jhum te kodo hoi, aru tar karone gur mattro kine.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Two hours, and the rolling must be done warm.
start.l: Kunu saman bhijai rakha nalage. Dui ghanta, aru gola bonai to gorom thaka homoi te koribole lage.

vessel.en: A wide kadai, a jaggery pan and a strainer. Three cooks for the rolling.
vessel.l: Chaura kadai, gur laga kadai aru chani. Gola bonabole tinjon randhoni.

season.en: Made in sarot after the jhum harvest, kept three weeks.
season.l: Jhum laga dhan kata pasote sarot te bonai, tin hafta rakhe.

recipes.name: Sweetcorn Chikki
recipes.sub: Popped maize set in a hard jaggery syrup and cut in a tray
recipes.sub_l: Phuta makai ke tan gur pani te milai tray te kate

method.en: Take the syrup to the hard crack and test it in cold water. A soft syrup gives a chikki that bends and seven kilos of it sticks together in the tin.
method.l: Gur pani to tan kori phata tak ukhalibi aru thanda pani te sabi. Molom pani pora nomi juwa chikki hoi aru sat kilo to tin te lagi jai.

method.en: Warm the makai before it goes in the syrup. Cold maize drops the temperature of the syrup and it sets before it can be spread.
method.l: Gur pani te dibole age te makai to gorom kori lobi. Thanda makai pora gur pani laga gorom komai diye aru belibole age te jam hoi jai.

method.en: Spread it on a greased stone and roll it thin at once. It sets in ninety seconds and a thick chikki cannot be bitten by anyone.
method.l: Ghee lagai diya pathor te sarai kene loge loge misi kori belibi. Nobboi second te jam hoi aru gadha chikki to kunbi kati napare.

method.en: Score the squares while it is warm and break them when it is cold. Cut cold, seven kilos becomes a tray of shards.
method.l: Gorom thaka homoi te chouka khan dagi dibi aru thanda howa homoi te bhangibi. Thanda kati dile sat kilo to tukra laga tray hoi jai.

recipes.why: Seven rupees sixty a head and it keeps a month in a tin. Makai and gur are the two cheapest things a Naga kitchen buys by the sack, and this is what they make together.
recipes.why_l: Ek manu te sat taka sathi, aru tin te ek mah thake. Naga rasoi pora boria te kina duita sobse sosta saman to makai aru gur, aru eitu duita milai kene eitu he bonai.

start.en: Nothing soaks. An hour, and the spreading is a race.
start.l: Kunu saman bhijai rakha nalage. Ek ghanta, aru sarai luwa to joldi koribole lage.

vessel.en: A syrup pan, a greased stone and a bowl of cold water. Three cooks.
vessel.l: Gur pani laga kadai, ghee lagai diya pathor aru thanda pani laga bati. Tinjon randhoni.

season.en: Made in sarot, kept a month.
season.l: Sarot te bonai, ek mah rakhe.

recipes.name: Dried Banana
recipes.sub: Ripe banana split and dried three days over a low fire
recipes.sub_l: Pakise kol ke phali kori tin din olop jui upor te sukhai

method.en: Twenty kilos of ripe kol gives four kilos of dried. A kitchen that does not know that dries twenty and expects eight.
method.l: Bis kilo pakise kol pora sari kilo sukha kol hoi. Eitu najana rasoi pora bis sukhai aru ath pabo koi bhabe.

method.en: Split them along the length and never across. A cross-cut banana dries at the ends and stays wet at the middle for a week.
method.l: Lomba zonote phali koribi, tirasa kotina bi nohoi. Tirasa kata kol to duita mukh te sukhai aru ek hafta majote bhija thake.

method.en: Over a low fire and not in the sun. In borokhun a Dimapur sun cannot dry a banana and three days of it in the open grows mould instead.
method.l: Rodh te nohoi, olop jui upor te. Borokhun din te Dimapur laga rodh pora kol sukhabole napare aru bahar te tin din rakhile phul uthe.

method.en: Brush them with gur water on the second day only. On the first day the fruit is too wet and on the third the coat will not dry.
method.l: Dui din laga din te mattro gur pani lagai dibi. Poila din te phol to bisi bhija aru tin din laga din te tar chal sukhi najabo.

recipes.why: Twelve rupees twenty a kilo and it keeps four months. In Peren the over-ripe kol is fifteen rupees a kilo because nobody wants it, and drying it is how a thanda din counter has a sweet at all.
recipes.why_l: Ek kilo te bara taka bis, aru sari mah thake. Peren te bisi pakise kol to kunbi nolobo karone kilo te pandhra taka, aru eitu sukhai diya pora thanda din te dibole laga jagate mitha thake.

start.en: Three days over a low fire, brushed once on the second day.
start.l: Olop jui upor te tin din, dui din laga din te ekbar lagai diya.

vessel.en: Drying racks over a low fire and a tin with a close lid. One cook, three days running.
vessel.l: Olop jui upor te sukhabole rack aru bhal kori dhaka tin. Ekjon randhoni, tin din dhori.

season.en: Made in borokhun when the kol is cheapest.
season.l: Kol sobse sosta thaka borokhun din te bonai.

recipes.name: Passion Fruit Titaura
recipes.sub: Passion pulp spread thin on a tray and dried to a sheet
recipes.sub_l: Passion phol laga sansh ke tray te misi sarai kene pata nisina sukhai

method.en: Strain every seed out for a titaura. A seed in a dried sheet is a stone in the mouth and three kilos comes back to the counter.
method.l: Titaura karone guti sob chani ulai dibi. Sukha pata te guti thakile mukh te pathor nisina lage aru tin kilo to dibole laga jagate wapas ahe.

method.en: Cook the pulp down to half before it is spread. Spread wet, it takes five days to dry and in borokhun it will not dry at all.
method.l: Sarai nadi kene sansh to adha tak homai lobi. Bhija sarai dile sukhabole pas din lage aru borokhun din te kotina bi nasukhabo.

method.en: Spread it two millimetres thick and no more. A thick titaura is soft at the centre after three days and it moulds in the tin.
method.l: Dui millimetre gadha sarai dibi, tatu bisi nai. Gadha titaura to tin din pisote majote molom thake aru tin te phul uthe.

method.en: Turn the sheet on the second day. A titaura dried on one side curls up and cracks along every curl.
method.l: Dui din laga din te pata to ulta dibi. Ek phal mattro sukhai diya titaura to gutai jai aru gutai juwa zonote sob phati jai.

recipes.why: Nineteen rupees ninety a kilo and it keeps six months. Passion grows over every Mokokchung fence and ten kilos of it costs the picking.
recipes.why_l: Ek kilo te unnis taka nobbei, aru sou mah thake. Mokokchung laga bera sob te passion lota uthe aru dosh kilo laga khoros to tula mattro.

start.en: Cook the pulp down, spread and dry three days. Turn on the second.
start.l: Sansh to homai, sarai kene tin din sukhabi. Dui din laga din te ulta dibi.

vessel.en: A heavy pan, a fine strainer and flat drying trays. One cook, three days running.
vessel.l: Bhari kadai, misi chani aru chapta sukhabole tray. Ekjon randhoni, tin din dhori.

season.en: Made in sarot when the nights are dry.
season.l: Raat sukha thaka sarot te bonai.

recipes.name: Groundnut Chikki
recipes.sub: Groundnut roasted, skinned and set in a hard jaggery syrup
recipes.sub_l: Badam ke bhaji, chal sarai kene tan gur pani te milai

method.en: Roast the badam and rub the skins off before it goes in. A skin left on floats to the top of the syrup and burns black there.
method.l: Hala nadi kene badam to bhaji kene chal khan mosali ulai dibi. Rakhi diya chal to gur pani laga upor te uthi kene tate kala hoi jule.

method.en: Break half of it and leave half whole. The broken half fills the gaps and the whole half is what a groundnut chikki is asked for.
method.l: Tar adha bhangibi aru adha pura rakhibi. Bhanga adha pora khali jaga bhorai aru pura adha karone he manu pora badam chikki mange.

method.en: Take the syrup to the hard crack and test it in cold water. A soft syrup gives a chikki that bends and the whole tin sticks together.
method.l: Gur pani to tan kori phata tak ukhalibi aru thanda pani te sabi. Molom pani pora nomi juwa chikki hoi aru pura tin to lagi jai.

method.en: Spread it on a greased stone and roll it thin at once. It sets in ninety seconds and a thick chikki cannot be bitten by anyone.
method.l: Ghee lagai diya pathor te sarai kene loge loge misi kori belibi. Nobboi second te jam hoi aru gadha chikki to kunbi kati napare.

recipes.why: Ten rupees thirty a head and it keeps a month in a tin. Badam and gur keep in a store room where a laddu with coconut in it does not.
recipes.why_l: Ek manu te dosh taka tirish, aru tin te ek mah thake. Narikol thaka laddu bhoral te nathake, kintu badam aru gur to thake.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Ninety minutes, and the rolling is a race.
start.l: Kunu saman bhijai rakha nalage. Nobboi minute, aru belibole to joldi koribole lage.

vessel.en: A dry pan, a syrup pan and a greased stone. Three cooks.
vessel.l: Sukha kadai, gur pani laga kadai aru ghee lagai diya pathor. Tinjon randhoni.

season.en: Made in sarot after the harvest, kept a month.
season.l: Dhan kata pasote sarot te bonai, ek mah rakhe.

recipes.name: Kholar Masala
recipes.sub: Naga beans in thick gravy for catering
recipes.sub_l: Bahar loi juwa nimite gadha jhol te Naga guti

method.en: Soak the kholar ten hours and throw the soaking water away.
method.l: Kholar dohh ghonta bhijai, bhija pani pheliya dibi.

method.en: Cook until a bean crushes to nothing between finger and thumb. Merely soft is not cooked, and undercooked beans are what make people uncomfortable afterwards.
method.l: Guti ke angul majote pura gali juwa loi rondhibi. Khali norom hua siddha nohoi, aru komti siddha guti pora he pichote manu ke dukh hoi.

method.en: Cook the tomato right down before the beans go back in — a full twenty-five minutes on a low flame.
method.l: Guti wapas halu age bilahi pura galibo dibi — dhimai jui te pura panchis minute.

method.en: Mash a third of the beans against the side and stir them back. A catering gravy must be thick enough not to separate on a long drive over bad road.
method.l: Ek tritiya bhag guti bortan laga kinar te ghohi wapas milabi. Bahar loi juwa jhol iman gadha hobo lage ki kharab rasta te lamba safar te alag nohoi.

method.en: Stir the roasted ground perilla in only at the end, off the fire. It thickens the pot further and does the work cream would do elsewhere.
method.l: Bhaja pisa nakhup khali hekh te, jui bondh kori milabi. Etu bortan aru gadha kore aru aru jagate cream laga kaam kore.

method.en: Transport it thicker than it should be and thin it with hot water at the other end. It is better the next day.
method.l: Lage pora gadha kori loi jabi aru ta te ponchi gorom pani pora pathla koribi. Etu dusra din te bisi bhal hoi.

recipes.why: Better the next day, holds four hours, and travels without breaking — which on these roads matters more than most places.
recipes.why_l: Dusra din bhal, char ghonta thake, aru bhangi najai — ei rasta te etu aru jagate pora bisi dorkari ase.

start.en: Soak the kholar ten hours. Start three and a half hours before serving.
start.l: Kholar dohh ghonta bhijabi. Diya age dhai ghonta suru koribi.

vessel.en: A 40 L pressure vessel and a wide kadhai. Two cooks.
vessel.l: 40 L pressure bortan aru chaura kadhai. Dujon randhoni.

season.en: All year. The catering dish that travels best.
season.l: Pura bosor. Bahar loi jabole sob pora bhal khana.

recipes.name: Axone Potato Travel Dish
recipes.sub: Dry-style axone and potato for carrying
recipes.sub_l: Loi juwa nimite sukha axone aru alu

method.en: This is the dry version of axone aloo, made deliberately without gravy so that it survives a journey.
method.l: Etu axone alu laga sukha rup ase, jhol nadi bonai eneka hoile safar te thik thake.

method.en: Boil the potatoes the day before and chill them. Cold potato holds its shape in a carrier; warm potato arrives as mash.
method.l: Alu ek din age siddha kori thanda koribi. Thanda alu bortan te nijor rup rakhe; gorom alu ponchile ghosa hoi jai.

method.en: Break them by hand into large pieces rather than cutting them small. Small pieces break down further on the road.
method.l: Sotu kori nakati hath pora dangor tukra bhangabi. Sotu tukra rasta te aru bhangi jai.

method.en: Crumble the axone and fry it in the oil a full five minutes before anything else goes in.
method.l: Axone bhangai aru aru eku halu age tel te pura pans minute bhajibi.

method.en: Use more oil than in the wet version. Oil is what protects a dry dish on a four-hour journey, and there is no gravy here to do it.
method.l: Bhija rup pora bisi tel cholabi. Char ghonta laga safar te sukha khana ke tel he bachai, aru iyate jhol nai.

method.en: Add no water at all and stir the ground perilla in off the fire. Carry it dry and add a little hot water at the other end if it needs loosening.
method.l: Eku pani nadibi aru pisa nakhup jui bondh kori milabi. Sukha loi jabi aru ta te ponchi lagile olop gorom pani dibo pare.

recipes.why: No gravy to split and no dairy to turn. Four hours on a bad road and it arrives as it left.
recipes.why_l: Phati jabole jhol nai aru kharab hobole dahi nai. Kharab rasta te char ghonta aru jineka gaise, eneka he ponche.

start.en: Boil the potatoes the evening before. Start seventy minutes before serving.
start.l: Alu ek din age siddha koribi. Diya age sattar minute suru koribi.

vessel.en: A wide 40 L kadhai. Two cooks.
vessel.l: Chaura 40 L kadhai. Dujon randhoni.

season.en: All year.
season.l: Pura bosor.

recipes.name: Mixed Vegetables, Naga Style
recipes.sub: Whatever came in, boiled with perilla
recipes.sub_l: Jun paise etu, nakhup logote siddha

method.en: Sort the vegetables into hard and soft before anything else, and cut everything to the same size.
method.l: Aru eku kora age sabji ke tan aru norom kori bhag koribi, aru sob eke saiz kori katibi.

method.en: Include colocasia in every batch. It breaks down and thickens the pot, and without it a Naga mixed vegetable is a bowl of water.
method.l: Hodai khep te kacchu halibi. Etu gali kori bortan gadha kore, aru etu nohoile Naga mila sabji ek bati pani he hoi.

method.en: There is no cashew and no cream in this book, so the thickening has to come from a vegetable and from the perilla.
method.l: Ei kitab te kaju bhi nai cream bhi nai, etu karone gadha kora sabji pora aru nakhup pora he ahibo lage.

method.en: Cook the colocasia and the hard vegetables together for fifteen minutes.
method.l: Kacchu aru tan sabji eke logote pandhero minute rondhibi.

method.en: Add the soft vegetables and the tomato for the last eight minutes only.
method.l: Norom sabji aru bilahi khali hekh laga ath minute te halibi.

method.en: Mash a few pieces of colocasia into the broth to thicken it, and stir the roasted ground perilla in off the fire.
method.l: Kisu kacchu tukra jhol te ghohi gadha koribi, aru bhaja pisa nakhup jui bondh kori milabi.

recipes.why: Taro and perilla do the thickening that cashew and cream do elsewhere, and both grow on the same hillside.
recipes.why_l: Aru jagate kaju aru cream jun gadha kora kaam kore, iyate kacchu aru nakhup kore, aru duiyo eke pahar te hoi.

start.en: Cut the vegetables an hour ahead, hard and soft kept apart. Start sixty minutes before serving.
start.l: Sabji ek ghonta age katibi, tan aru norom alag rakhibi. Diya age saathh minute suru koribi.

vessel.en: A wide 40 L vessel. Two cooks.
vessel.l: Chaura 40 L bortan. Dujon randhoni.

season.en: All year with whatever the market gave.
season.l: Pura bosor, bazar pora jun paise etu logote.

recipes.name: Paneer Butter Masala
recipes.sub: Paneer in a tomato and cashew gravy, no onion and no garlic
recipes.sub_l: Paneer ke bilahi aru kaju laga jhol te, pyaj aru naharu eku nai

method.en: Soak the kaju an hour and grind it with the tomato. The cashew does the whole job an onion base would do and there is no honest substitute cheaper than this.
method.l: Kaju to ek ghanta bhijai kene bilahi logote pisi lobi. Pyaj laga bhetti pora kora kaam sob kaju pora kore aru eitu pora sosta thaka dusra sidha rasta nai.

method.en: Cook the tomato paste twenty-five minutes before the butter goes in. Under-cooked tomato is sour and a spoon of chini only hides it for a minute.
method.l: Butter hala nadi kene bilahi laga dola to pochish minute randhibi. Kom randhise bilahi to tenga hoi aru ek chamos chini pora ek minute mattro dhake.

method.en: The paneer goes in four minutes before serving and no earlier. Six kilos boiled in gravy is six kilos of rubber at the counter.
method.l: Dibole laga sari minute age te paneer hala, tatu age nohoi. Jhol te ukhalise sou kilo to dibole laga jagate sou kilo rubber hoi.

method.en: Cream off the fire and stirred in from the side. Cream into a boiling gravy splits and twenty-eight litres cannot be brought back.
method.l: Cream to jui pora namai kene kasote pora mila dibi. Ukhala jhol te cream dile phati jai aru athais litre ke wapas anibole napare.

recipes.why: Forty-two rupees ninety a head, the dearest dish in this book. Paneer, cashew, butter and cream all come up the road, so this is for a wedding and for Hornbill and nothing else.
recipes.why_l: Ek manu te bayalis taka nobbei, eitu boi te sobse dami khana. Paneer, kaju, butter aru cream sob rasta pora ahe; karone eitu biya aru Hornbill karone mattro.

start.en: Cashew soaks an hour. Two hours in all.
start.l: Kaju to ek ghanta bhijai. Sob milai dui ghanta.

vessel.en: A 35 L vessel, a grinder and a holding pot of warm salted water for the paneer. Two cooks.
vessel.l: Paitirish litre bela, pisibole chakki aru paneer karone nimok diya gorom pani laga bela. Duijon randhoni.

season.en: At Hornbill, Janmashtami and a wedding.
season.l: Hornbill, Janmashtami aru biya te.

recipes.name: Peas and Paneer
recipes.sub: Paneer and green peas in a light tomato gravy
recipes.sub_l: Paneer aru kacha motor ke polka bilahi laga jhol te

method.en: Peas in the last four minutes and never at the start. A pea cooked twenty minutes is grey and four kilos of grey peas is seen from the door.
method.l: Motor to hekh laga sari minute te, suru te kotina bi nohoi. Bis minute randhise motor to dhusor hoi aru sari kilo dhusor motor to duar pora dekha pai.

method.en: Only six hundred grams of kaju here, not the kilo a butter masala takes. This should be thin enough to see the peas through.
method.l: Ithote sou sou gram kaju mattro, butter masala te laga ek kilo nohoi. Motor ke par dekha pua tak polka hobole lage.

method.en: Hold the cut paneer in warm salted water until the gravy is ready. Left dry on a tray four kilos hardens at the edges within the hour.
method.l: Jhol taiyar nohua tak kata paneer to nimok diya gorom pani te rakhibi. Tray te sukha rakhile ek ghanta te sari kilo laga dhar tan hoi jai.

method.en: Take the vessel off before the paneer has been in five minutes. It goes on cooking in the gravy all the way to the hall.
method.l: Paneer hala pas minute nohua age te bela to namai lobi. Hall tak juwa rasta te bi jhol te randhi thake.

recipes.why: Thirty-six rupees fifty a head. It is the guest dish a kitchen makes when a butter masala is beyond the day's money, and four kilos of peas does the work of two of paneer.
recipes.why_l: Ek manu te chattis taka pachas. Etu din laga poisa te butter masala nohua homoi te rasoi pora ahibole manu karone bonai diya khana to eitu he, aru sari kilo motor pora dui kilo paneer laga kaam kore.

start.en: Cashew soaks half an hour. Ninety minutes in all.
start.l: Kaju to adha ghanta bhijai. Sob milai nobboi minute.

vessel.en: A 35 L vessel, a grinder and a holding pot for the paneer. Two cooks.
vessel.l: Paitirish litre bela, pisibole chakki aru paneer rakhibole bela. Duijon randhoni.

season.en: Sarot to thanda din for the fresh pea; frozen the rest of the year.
season.l: Notun motor karone sarot pora thanda din tak; bochor laga baki homoi te thanda kori rakha.

recipes.name: Chana Masala
recipes.sub: White chana cooked soft with tea leaf for colour and amchur for sour
recipes.sub_l: Boga chana ke rong karone chah pata aru tenga karone amchur logote randha

method.en: Tie forty grams of chah pata in a cloth and boil it with the chana. It is the whole colour of a chana masala and it costs four rupees.
method.l: Chalis gram chah pata to kapor te bandhi kene chana logote ukhalibi. Chana masala laga pura rong to eitu he aru tar daam sari taka.

method.en: Soak them twelve hours and cook them in the soaking water with the cloth in it. Fresh water gives a pale vessel however much tea is used.
method.l: Baro ghanta bhijai kene kapor logote bhijai diya pani te he randhibi. Notun pani dile kotona chah dile bi bela to phika thake.

method.en: Amchur and not nemu. Lemon in a chana masala goes flat within the hour; amchur holds the sourness until the vessel is empty.
method.l: Amchur, nemu nohoi. Chana masala te nemu dile ek ghanta te tar swad hera jai; amchur pora bela khali howa tak tenga dhori rakhe.

method.en: Salt only after the chana is soft. Salted early it hardens and no amount of time on the fire brings it back.
method.l: Chana molom howa pasote mattro nimok dibi. Age te nimok dile tan hoi jai aru jui te kotona homoi dile bi wapas nahe.

recipes.why: Twenty-one rupees sixty a head. Chana is the cheapest thing on this shelf that a north Indian guest recognises, and five kilos holds a hall to the evening.
recipes.why_l: Ek manu te ekhis taka sathi. Uttor Bharat laga manu pora chini pua eitu thak laga sobse sosta saman to chana he, aru pas kilo pora sanja tak hall ke dhori rakhe.

start.en: Chana soaks twelve hours and cooks two. Start the evening before.
start.l: Chana to baro ghanta bhijai aru dui ghanta randhe. Age din laga sanjote suru koribi.

vessel.en: A 40 L vessel with a lid and a muslin cloth for the tea. One cook.
vessel.l: Dhakoni thaka chalis litre bela aru chah karone misi kapor. Ekjon randhoni.

season.en: All year, on a guest day.
season.l: Pura bochor, ahibole manu thaka din te.

recipes.name: Potato and Cauliflower
recipes.sub: Potato and cauliflower in a light gravy with cumin
recipes.sub_l: Alu aru phulkobi ke jira logote polka jhol te

method.en: The alu goes in twelve minutes before the phulkobi. Started together, the cauliflower is pulp while the potato is still raw in the middle.
method.l: Phulkobi laga baro minute age te alu hala. Eke logote suru korile alu to majote kacha thaka homoi te phulkobi to dola hoi jai.

method.en: Soak the florets ten minutes in salted water first. There is more in a thanda din cauliflower than cauliflower.
method.l: Poila phul khan ke nimok diya pani te dosh minute bhijai rakhibi. Thanda din laga phulkobi te phulkobi pora bi bisi kiba thake.

method.en: Keep it just wet and no more. This is not a jhol; the gravy should cling to the pieces and not stand around them.
method.l: Olop bhija mattro rakhibi, tatu bisi nai. Eitu jhol nohoi; jhol to tukra khan te lagi thakibole lage, tar sarito thakibole nohoi.

method.en: Take it off while a floret still holds. Both cook for ten minutes after the fire is out and one that is right in the kitchen is a mash in the hall.
method.l: Ekta phul tan thaka homoi te namai lobi. Jui namuwa pasote duita bi dosh minute randhi thake aru rasoi te thik thaka to hall te dola hoi jai.

recipes.why: Fourteen rupees ninety a head, and it is the guest dish for a thanda din when no paneer has come up the road. Seven kilos each fills twenty-eight litres.
recipes.why_l: Ek manu te souda taka nobbei, aru rasta pora paneer nahua thanda din te ahibole manu karone khana to eitu he. Sat sat kilo pora athais litre bhorai.

start.en: Florets soak ten minutes. An hour in all.
start.l: Phul khan dosh minute bhijai. Sob milai ek ghanta.

vessel.en: A 35 L vessel and a soaking tray. One cook.
vessel.l: Paitirish litre bela aru bhijai rakhibole tray. Ekjon randhoni.

season.en: Sarot to thanda din, while the phulkobi is in the market.
season.l: Sarot pora thanda din tak, phulkobi bazar te thaka homoi te.

recipes.name: Malai Kofta
recipes.sub: Paneer and gram flour balls dropped into a cashew gravy
recipes.sub_l: Paneer aru besan laga gola ke kaju laga jhol te hala

method.en: Grate the paneer and knead it with the besan until it takes a ball without a crack. A cracked kofta opens in the ghee and five kilos of paneer is in the kadai.
method.l: Paneer to kasi kene besan logote phata nohua gola hobole tak mosalibi. Phata kofta to ghee te khuli jai aru pas kilo paneer to kadai te thake.

method.en: Fry the kofta on a medium flame and never hot. A hot ghee browns the outside while the besan inside is still raw.
method.l: Kofta to majhiya jui te bhajibi, gorom te kotina bi nohoi. Gorom ghee pora bhitorte besan kacha thaka homoi te bahar to mati rong kore.

method.en: The kofta go into the gravy at the counter and not in the kitchen. Five minutes in the vessel and they are gone; there is nothing left to serve.
method.l: Kofta to rasoi te nohoi, dibole laga jagate jhol te hala. Bela te pas minute thakile hera jai; dibole kiba nathake.

method.en: Cream off the fire. Cream into a boiling gravy splits and twenty-six litres of it cannot be brought back.
method.l: Cream to jui pora namai kene dibi. Ukhala jhol te cream dile phati jai aru chabbis litre ke wapas anibole napare.

recipes.why: Forty-one rupees fifty a head. It is the one dish in this book that needs a cook standing at a kadai for an hour, and a Naga wedding is the only day that hour is available.
recipes.why_l: Ek manu te ekchallis taka pachas. Eitu boi te ekjon randhoni ke ek ghanta kadai kasote thiya thakibole laga khana to eitu ekta he, aru etu ek ghanta pua din to Naga biya mattro.

start.en: Cashew soaks an hour. Two and a half hours in all.
start.l: Kaju to ek ghanta bhijai. Sob milai dui ghanta adha.

vessel.en: A deep kadai, a 35 L gravy vessel and a grinder. Three cooks.
vessel.l: Gobhir kadai, jhol karone paitirish litre bela aru pisibole chakki. Tinjon randhoni.

season.en: At a wedding and at Hornbill.
season.l: Biya aru Hornbill te.

recipes.name: Rice Bean and Perilla Boil
recipes.name_l: Rice bean aru perilla laga siddha
recipes.sub: Beans boiled and finished with ground perilla, no dairy
recipes.sub_l: Perilla guri diya rice bean, gakhir nai

method.en: Boil the beans in plenty of water and throw the first water away. The second water is what the pot is built on.
method.l: Rice bean ke bisi pani te siddha koribi aru prothom pani phelai dibi. Dusra pani he kaam laga ase.

method.en: Roast the perilla until the seeds jump and grind it warm with a little of the hot liquid.
method.l: Perilla guti ke phutibo loi bhajibi aru gorom thakote olop pani logote pisibi.

method.en: Add the pumpkin and cook until it falls apart and thickens the pot on its own.
method.l: Kumra halibi aru etu bhangi kene bhat ke ghono kora loi randhibi.

method.en: Stir the perilla in with the greens and the whole raja mircha, boil five minutes, and take the chilli out before serving. Perilla is the fat here — no oil is needed beyond the spoon at the end.
