method.l: Perilla, sorso pata aru pura raja mircha halibi, pans minute siddha koribi, aru diya age mircha ulai lobi.

recipes.why: Perilla does in a Naga pot what ghee does in a plains one, and it grows on the edge of every jhum field. Seven kilos of a dry store bean feeds a hundred, and nothing in the vessel comes from an animal.
recipes.why_l: Naga bhat te perilla he ghee laga kaam kore, aru etu hoduwai kheti kinar te hoi. Sat kilo bean pora sou manu khai loi.

start.en: Soak the beans twelve hours. Start ninety minutes before serving.
start.l: Bean ke barah ghonta bhijai lobi. Diya age nabbe minute suru koribi.

vessel.en: A 50 L vessel and a stone grinder for the perilla. One cook.
vessel.l: 50 L laga bortan aru perilla pisibole pathor. Ekjon randhoni.

season.en: All year. The beans and the perilla both store dry.
season.l: Pura bosor. Bean aru perilla duiyo sukha thake.

recipes.name: Colocasia Leaf with Perilla
recipes.sub: Young taro leaves boiled soft in perilla, no dairy
recipes.sub_l: Perilla te siddha kora kosu pata

method.en: Take only young leaves and cut the thick vein out of each. An old leaf itches in the throat however long it is boiled.
method.l: Komal pata he lobi aru sob pata laga mota hri katibi. Purana pata kiman siddha korile bhi gola te khuji kore.

method.en: Boil the leaves in salted water forty minutes with the vessel uncovered. Covered, the itch does not go.
method.l: Nimok pani te chalis minute, dhaki nadi, siddha koribi. Dhakile khuji nayai.

method.en: Add the tree tomato and the whole raja mircha and cook until the leaves are a soft mass.
method.l: Gash bilahi aru pura raja mircha halibi, pata norom hoi kene milibo loi randhibi.

method.en: Grind the perilla and stir it in at the end with the oil. This is the whole richness of the dish.
method.l: Perilla pisi kene tel logote hekh te milabi. Etu he pura swad.

recipes.why: Colocasia grows in every wet corner of a Naga village and the leaf costs nothing at all. Boiled long and dressed with perilla it is a full dish, and there is not a drop of dairy anywhere near it.
recipes.why_l: Naga gaon laga sob bhija kona te kosu hoi, aru pata laga dam eku nai. Deri loi siddha kori perilla dile pura kha hoi jai.

start.en: Nothing soaks, but the leaves need forty minutes on the fire. Start eighty minutes ahead.
start.l: Eku bhijai nalage, hoilebi pata ke chalis minute jui lage. Assi minute age suru koribi.

vessel.en: A 40 L vessel, uncovered throughout. One cook.
vessel.l: 40 L laga bortan, pura somoi dhaki nadibi. Ekjon randhoni.

season.en: May to October, while the leaves are young.
season.l: May pora October loi, pata komal thaka somoi.

recipes.name: Job's Tears and Pumpkin Porridge
recipes.name_l: Job's tears aru kumra laga jaul
recipes.sub: Hill grain boiled with pumpkin and jaggery, no milk
recipes.sub_l: Gakhir nai — kumra aru gur diya Job's tears

method.en: Soak the grain overnight. Job's tears is harder than any rice and will not soften in a morning.
method.l: Dhan ke rati bhorke bhijabi. Job's tears chaul pora bisi tan ase, ek bhorte norom nohoi.

method.en: Boil it in five times its water for an hour until the grain splits open.
method.l: Pans guna pani te ek ghonta, dhan phati bole loi siddha koribi.

method.en: Add the pumpkin and cook until it dissolves into the grain.
method.l: Kumra halibi aru dhan logote gali bole loi randhibi.

method.en: Stir the jaggery in at the end. Added early it stops the grain cooking altogether. Finish with roasted sesame and oil — no milk goes in, which is why it holds a day.
method.l: Hekh te gur milabi. Age dile dhan siddha nohoi. Bhaja til aru tel diya pichote ek din thake, kelemane gakhir nai.

recipes.why: Job's tears is the grain of the poorer terraces and this is how a Phek household eats it — with the pumpkin from the same field and jaggery from the market. Nothing in it spoils, so it goes up the road with a work party.
recipes.why_l: Job's tears kharab khet laga dhan ase aru Phek gharte etu kumra aru gur logote khai. Eku bhi nosto nohoi, etu karone kaam te loi jabo pare.

start.en: Soak the grain twelve hours. It needs an hour on the fire — start two and a half hours ahead.
start.l: Dhan ke barah ghonta bhijabi. Ek ghonta jui lage — duita adha ghonta age suru koribi.

vessel.en: A heavy 50 L vessel. One cook, stirring at the end.
vessel.l: 50 L laga bhari bortan. Ekjon randhoni, hekh te ghurai thakibi.

season.en: All year. The grain stores dry for a year.
season.l: Pura bosor. Dhan sukha ek bosor thake.

recipes.name: Mustard Leaf with Perilla
recipes.sub: Mustard leaves cooked dry and turned through with crushed perilla
recipes.sub_l: Sorisa pata ke sukha randhi thecha nakhup loi mosala

method.en: No water at all. Twelve kilos of pata gives up two litres in the first four minutes and that is all the kadai needs.
method.l: Pani eku nai. Baro kilo pata pora poila sari minute te dui litre ulai aru kadai ke titan he lage.

method.en: Cut the stalk in and do not throw it. The stalk is a third of the weight and it goes in eight minutes before the leaf.
method.l: Dala to kati kene hala dibi, phelai nadibi. Dala to gathi laga tin bhag ekta aru pata laga ath minute age te hala.

method.en: Eight minutes on the leaf and no more. Pata cooked twenty minutes is the colour of a wet road and sixteen kilos of it comes back.
method.l: Pata upor te ath minute mattro, tatu bisi nai. Bis minute randhise pata to bhija rasta rong hoi aru solo kilo wapas ahe.

method.en: Roast the nakhup and crush it in at the end. It is the fat of this dish and there is no ghee and no curd anywhere in it.
method.l: Nakhup to bhaji kene hekh te thecha dibi. Eitu khana laga tel to eitu he aru tar bhitorte ghee aru dahi kotina bi nai.

recipes.why: Eleven rupees sixty a head, no dairy and no ghee. In thanda din the pata is fifteen rupees a kilo at Kohima bazar and the perilla is the only other thing bought.
recipes.why_l: Ek manu te egaro taka sathi, gakhir aru ghee eku nai. Thanda din te Kohima bazar te sorisa pata to kilo te pandhra taka, aru nakhup mattro he dusra kina saman.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Forty minutes, in two batches.
start.l: Kunu saman bhijai rakha nalage. Chalis minute, duibar kori.

vessel.en: A wide 30 L kadai, uncovered. One cook.
vessel.l: Chaura tirish litre kadai, dhaki nadi kene. Ekjon randhoni.

season.en: Sarot to gorom din, while the pata is in the market.
season.l: Sarot pora gorom din tak, pata bazar te thaka homoi te.

recipes.name: Chayote with Perilla
recipes.sub: Chayote and its leaf cooked dry with perilla and no dairy
recipes.sub_l: Iskus aru tar pata ke nakhup logote sukha randha, gakhir eku nai

method.en: The leaf goes in and it is not a garnish. Two kilos of iskus pata is half the taste of this kadai and a kitchen that throws it is throwing the dish.
method.l: Pata to hala hi, eitu sajai luwa nohoi. Dui kilo iskus pata to eitu kadai laga swad laga adha, aru etu phelai diya rasoi pora khana he phelai.

method.en: Peel it only if the skin is rough. A young iskus skin is thinner than a kumra and peeling twelve kilos of it wastes an hour and a kilo.
method.l: Chal khosa hoile mattro chilabi. Suku iskus laga chal to kumra pora bi misi hoi aru baro kilo chilaile ek ghanta aru ek kilo nasto hoi.

method.en: No water and no lid. Twelve kilos under a lid steams and a steamed iskus is a bowl of water with skins in it.
method.l: Pani aru dhakoni eku nai. Baro kilo ke dhakile bhap hoi jai aru bhap howa iskus to chal thaka pani laga bati he.

method.en: Roast the nakhup and crush it in at the end. It is the fat of this vessel and there is no dairy anywhere in it.
method.l: Nakhup to bhaji kene hekh te thecha dibi. Eitu bela laga tel to eitu he aru tar bhitorte gakhir kotina bi nai.

recipes.why: Nine rupees ninety a head, no dairy at all. An iskus vine on a Kohima fence gives fruit and leaf for eight months and nobody plants it twice.
recipes.why_l: Ek manu te no taka nobbei, gakhir eku nai. Kohima laga bera te thaka iskus laga lota pora ath mah dhori phol aru pata diye aru kunbi duibar naropai.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Fifty minutes, and the leaf is chopped while the iskus cooks.
start.l: Kunu saman bhijai rakha nalage. Pachas minute, aru iskus randha homoi te pata katibi.

vessel.en: A wide 30 L kadai, uncovered. One cook.
vessel.l: Chaura tirish litre kadai, dhaki nadi kene. Ekjon randhoni.

season.en: Borokhun to thanda din, off the fence behind the kitchen.
season.l: Borokhun pora thanda din tak, rasoi pisote thaka bera pora.

recipes.name: Bamboo Shoot with Axone
recipes.sub: Fresh bamboo shoot cooked dry and finished with fermented soybean
recipes.sub_l: Notun bahor gaj ke sukha randhi hekh te axone diya

method.en: Boil the gaj once in plain water and throw that water. The first water carries the sharpness that would otherwise take the tongue off.
method.l: Bahor gaj to ekbar sadharon pani te siddha kori kene etu pani to phelai dibi. Poila pani te jibha ke kati diya tak laga tez thake.

method.en: The axone goes in with the fire off. Boiled twenty minutes it loses the smell it is bought for and becomes an ordinary bean.
method.l: Axone to jui bondh kori kene hala. Bis minute ukhalile taike kina laga gonda to hera jai aru sadharon guti hoi jai.

method.en: Cook it uncovered from the moment the axone goes in. Under a lid a kilo and a half of it will empty a hall.
method.l: Axone hala loge loge dhaki nadi kene randhibi. Dhaki dile ek kilo adha pora hall to khali kori dibo.

method.en: Taste before the salt goes in. An axone is salted in the jar and a hundred and sixty grams is already more than some jars want.
method.l: Nimok hala nadi kene swad sabi. Axone to bela te nimok di kene rakhe aru ek sou sathi gram to kunba bela karone age pora bisi hoi.

recipes.why: Thirteen rupees sixty a head, no dairy at all. In borokhun the shoot comes off the Tuensang hill for the cutting and a kilo and a half of axone carries ten kilos of it.
recipes.why_l: Ek manu te tera taka sathi, gakhir eku nai. Borokhun din te bahor gaj to Tuensang laga pahar pora kata mattro laga daam te ahe, aru ek kilo adha axone pora dosh kilo ke jai diye.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Ninety minutes, most of it boiling the shoot.
start.l: Kunu saman bhijai rakha nalage. Nobboi minute, tar bisi bhag to bahor gaj siddha kora.

vessel.en: A boiling pot and a wide 30 L kadai, uncovered. Two cooks.
vessel.l: Ukhalibole bela aru chaura tirish litre kadai, dhaki nadi kene. Duijon randhoni.

season.en: Borokhun to sarot, while the fresh shoot is on the hill.
season.l: Borokhun pora sarot tak, notun bahor gaj pahar te thaka homoi te.

recipes.name: Bastenga with Potato
recipes.sub: Fermented bamboo squeezed dry and cooked with potato, no dairy
recipes.sub_l: Bastenga ke sipi sukhai kene alu logote randha, gakhir eku nai

method.en: Squeeze the bastenga dry and keep two cups of the liquor back. The liquor is the whole sourness and the squeezing is what stops it being too much.
method.l: Bastenga to sipi kene sukhai lobi aru tar pani laga dui cup rakhibi. Etu pani te sob tenga thake aru sipa pora eitu bisi nohobole rukhai.

method.en: The bastenga goes in first and the alu after ten minutes. A potato in bastenga liquor from the start hardens and stays hard however long the kadai is on the fire.
method.l: Bastenga to poila hala aru alu to dosh minute pisote. Suru pora bastenga pani te thaka alu to tan hoi jai aru kadai to jui te kotona homoi thakile bi tan thake.

method.en: Cook it uncovered the first ten minutes. Under a lid the smell of four kilos of bastenga stays in it and comes out at the counter all at once.
method.l: Poila dosh minute dhaki nadi kene randhibi. Dhaki dile sari kilo bastenga laga gonda to tate thaki jai aru dibole laga jagate ekbar te ulai.

method.en: Taste before the salt goes in. A bastenga is salted in the jar and a hundred and seventy grams is already more than some jars want.
method.l: Nimok hala nadi kene swad sabi. Bastenga to bela te nimok di kene rakhe aru ek sou sattor gram to kunba bela karone age pora bisi hoi.

recipes.why: Ten rupees ninety a head, no dairy at all. Four kilos of bastenga out of a jar put down in borokhun is what gives a Naga kitchen a dish in thanda din when there is nothing green in the market.
recipes.why_l: Ek manu te dosh taka nobbei, gakhir eku nai. Borokhun din te rakhise bela pora sari kilo bastenga pora bazar te hariyali eku nathaka thanda din te Naga rasoi ke ekta khana diye.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Fifty minutes, and the bastenga is squeezed first.
start.l: Kunu saman bhijai rakha nalage. Pachas minute, aru poila bastenga to sipi lobi.

vessel.en: A squeezing cloth and a wide 30 L kadai, uncovered at the start. One cook.
vessel.l: Sipibole kapor aru chaura tirish litre kadai, suru te dhaki nadi kene. Ekjon randhoni.

season.en: Sarot to gorom din, out of the jar put down in borokhun.
season.l: Sarot pora gorom din tak, borokhun din te rakhise bela pora.

recipes.name: Pumpkin with Perilla
recipes.sub: Pumpkin cooked down thin and finished with crushed perilla
recipes.sub_l: Kumra ke polka randhi hekh te thecha nakhup diya

method.en: Roast the nakhup until the seeds jump and crush it coarse. It is the whole fat of this vessel and there is no dairy anywhere in it.
method.l: Nakhup to guti khan uphal thaka tak bhajibi aru mota kore thecha dibi. Eitu bela laga pura tel to eitu he aru tar bhitorte gakhir kotina bi nai.

method.en: Half the perilla goes in at the start and half at the end. The first half thickens the vessel and the second is the smell that reaches the hall.
method.l: Nakhup laga adha to suru te hala aru adha to hekh te. Poila adha pora bela ke gadha kore aru dusra to hall tak puwa gonda.

method.en: Keep the skin on if it is a jhum kumra. The skin is what stops twelve kilos collapsing into a single orange mass.
method.l: Jhum laga kumra hoile chal to rakhibi. Baro kilo ke ekta komla rong laga dola hobole nadiye to chal he.

method.en: Keep it thin. This is a vessel that is drunk off the plate at the end of the meal and a thick one is a mash.
method.l: Polka rakhibi. Eitu khana laga hekh te thali pora khai luwa bela aru gadha hoile dola he hoi.

recipes.why: Eight rupees seventy a head, the cheapest vegan dish on this shelf. In sarot a Peren jhum gives twelve kilos for the carrying and the perilla is the only thing bought.
recipes.why_l: Ek manu te ath taka sathi, eitu thak te sobse sosta gakhir nathaka khana. Sarot te Peren laga jhum pora bhuka mattro laga daam te baro kilo hoi, aru nakhup mattro he kina saman.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Forty minutes from a cold stove.
start.l: Kunu saman bhijai rakha nalage. Thanda chula pora chalis minute.

vessel.en: A 35 L vessel with a lid and a dry pan for the perilla. One cook.
vessel.l: Dhakoni thaka paitirish litre bela aru nakhup karone sukha kadai. Ekjon randhoni.

season.en: Sarot to thanda din, from the jhum and then the store room.
season.l: Sarot pora thanda din tak, jhum pora aru tar pasote bhoral pora.

recipes.name: Jain Kholar
recipes.sub: Naga kidney beans without axone, bamboo shoot or ginger
recipes.sub_l: Axone, bah gaj aru aduwa nathaka kholar

method.en: Soak the kholar twelve hours and boil it in the same water until a bean crushes to nothing.
method.l: Kholar ke barah ghonta bhijai, etu pani te he bean gali bole loi siddha koribi.

method.en: Kholar is normally cooked with axone. Nothing fermented goes in here; asafoetida fried in the oil stands in its place.
method.l: Kholar to axone logote randhe. Iyate kuno tenekua saman nai, tel te bhaja hing he ase.

method.en: Add the tree tomato and pumpkin and boil until both fall and thicken the pot.
method.l: Gash bilahi aru kumra halibi, duita gali kene bhat ghono kora loi siddha koribi.

method.en: Put the whole raja mircha in for the last ten minutes and take it out before serving.
method.l: Hekh dos minute te pura raja mircha halibi aru diya age ulai lobi.

recipes.why: Kholar is the bean Nagaland is known for and the standard pot is seasoned with axone. Asafoetida gives the same savour, and with tree tomato and pumpkin doing the thickening there is nothing in the vessel a Jain guest has to ask about.
recipes.why_l: Kholar to Nagaland laga naam ase aru sadharan bhat te axone hale. Hing pora bhi eneka swad ahe, aru gash bilahi logot kumra pora ghono hoi.

start.en: Soak the beans twelve hours. Start two and a half hours before serving.
start.l: Bean ke barah ghonta bhijabi. Diya age duita adha ghonta suru koribi.

vessel.en: A 60 L pressure vessel. One cook.
vessel.l: 60 L laga bortan. Ekjon randhoni.

season.en: All year. Kholar stores dry from the October harvest.
season.l: Pura bosor. October kheti pora kholar sukha thake.

recipes.name: Jain Pumpkin and Rice Bean
recipes.sub: Boiled together with nothing from under the ground
recipes.sub_l: Mati nichete laga eku nadi siddha kora

method.en: Boil the soaked beans until soft before the pumpkin goes in — the pumpkin takes a quarter of the time.
method.l: Kumra halibole age bean ke norom hobo loi siddha koribi — kumra to olop somoi he lage.

method.en: Add the pumpkin and let half of it dissolve. That is what thickens the pot, in place of the yam a Naga cook would add.
method.l: Kumra halibi aru adha gali bole dibi. Naga randhoni pora kosu diya jagate etu he ghono kore.

method.en: Put the leaves in for the last three minutes.
method.l: Hekh tin minute te pata halibi.

method.en: Fry the asafoetida and dry ginger in the oil and pour it in off the fire, with the crushed sesame.
method.l: Tel te hing aru sukha aduwa bhaji, jui bondh kori kene bhaja til logote halibi.

recipes.why: Half of what a Naga kitchen boils is yam, colocasia or bamboo shoot, and a Jain guest can take none of it. Pumpkin and rice bean both grow above the ground, both keep in a store room, and together they make a vessel that needs nothing else.
recipes.why_l: Naga randhoni pora siddha kora laga adha to kosu, bah gaj ase, aru Jain manu etu eku khabo napare. Kumra aru rice bean duita mati uporte hoi aru bhoral te thake.

start.en: Soak the beans twelve hours. Start ninety minutes before serving.
start.l: Bean ke barah ghonta bhijabi. Diya age nabbe minute suru koribi.

vessel.en: A 50 L vessel. One cook.
vessel.l: 50 L laga bortan. Ekjon randhoni.

season.en: All year. Pumpkin keeps two months whole.
season.l: Pura bosor. Kumra pura duita mahina thake.

recipes.name: Jain Tree Tomato Broth
recipes.sub: A sour clear broth with no bamboo shoot and no ferment
recipes.sub_l: Bah gaj aru tenga saman nathaka jhol

method.en: Blanch the tree tomatoes a minute and slip the skins off. The skin is bitter and does not soften.
method.l: Gash bilahi ke ek minute gorom pani te halibi aru chamra ulai dibi. Chamra tita ase aru norom nohoi.

method.en: Boil the flesh with the pumpkin in salted water until both fall apart.
method.l: Etu laga guda aru kumra ke nimok pani te duita gali bole loi siddha koribi.

method.en: A Naga sour broth is normally made on bamboo shoot or bastenga. The tree tomato alone gives all the sourness this needs.
method.l: Naga tenga jhol to bah gaj nohoile bastenga pora bonai. Iyate gash bilahi he tenga diye.

method.en: Add the greens, fry the asafoetida and dry ginger in oil and pour it in off the fire.
method.l: Sorso pata halibi, tel te hing aru sukha aduwa bhaji, jui bondh kori halibi.

recipes.why: Every sour dish in this book is soured with something fermented or with bamboo shoot, and a Jain plate can take neither. The tree tomato grows on a tree in every Dimapur back garden and does the same job on its own.
recipes.why_l: Ei kitab laga sob tenga saman bah gaj nohoile tenga kora saman pora ahe, aru Jain thali te duita bhi nalage. Gash bilahi Dimapur laga pichete gash te hoi.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Start fifty minutes before serving.
start.l: Eku bhijai nalage. Diya age pachas minute suru koribi.

vessel.en: A 40 L vessel. One cook.
vessel.l: 40 L laga bortan. Ekjon randhoni.

season.en: September to February, while the tree tomato is fruiting.
season.l: September pora February loi, gash bilahi dhora somoi.

recipes.name: Jain Bamboo Shoot Fry
recipes.sub: Bamboo shoot cooked dry with dry ginger and asafoetida, no root
recipes.sub_l: Bahor gaj ke sukha ada aru hing logote sukha randha, mati laga saman eku nai

method.en: Boil the gaj once in plain water and throw that water. The first water carries the sharpness that would otherwise take the tongue off.
method.l: Bahor gaj to ekbar sadharon pani te siddha kori kene etu pani to phelai dibi. Poila pani te jibha ke kati diya tak laga tez thake.

method.en: Dry ginger and not fresh, and it is a hundred grams and not three hundred. Dry ginger is four times the strength and a Jain plate is ruined by a heavy hand.
method.l: Sukha ada, notun nohoi; aru eitu ek sou gram, tin sou nohoi. Sukha ada to sari gun tez aru bisi dile Jain thali to nasto hoi.

method.en: Asafoetida in the tempering and a pinch is enough. In a Jain kadai it is the only thing standing where an onion would.
method.l: Phoron te hing, aru olop he tho. Jain kadai te pyaj laga jagate thiya thaka saman to eitu mattro.

method.en: No water and no lid after the boiling. Under a lid ten kilos steams and a steamed gaj is a wet thing nobody will eat.
method.l: Siddha kora pasote pani aru dhakoni eku nai. Dhaki dile dosh kilo bhap hoi jai aru bhap howa bahor gaj to kunbi nakhuwa bhija saman he.

recipes.why: Eleven rupees ninety a head. In borokhun the shoot comes off the Tuensang hill for the cutting, and there is no root anywhere in it, so a Jain guest eats the same tray as the hall.
recipes.why_l: Ek manu te egaro taka nobbei. Borokhun din te bahor gaj to Tuensang laga pahar pora kata mattro laga daam te ahe, aru tar bhitorte mati laga saman kotina bi nai; karone Jain manu bi hall logote eke tray khai.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Ninety minutes, most of it boiling the shoot.
start.l: Kunu saman bhijai rakha nalage. Nobboi minute, tar bisi bhag to bahor gaj siddha kora.

vessel.en: A boiling pot and a wide 30 L kadai. One cook.
vessel.l: Ukhalibole bela aru chaura tirish litre kadai. Ekjon randhoni.

season.en: Borokhun to sarot, while the fresh shoot is on the hill.
season.l: Borokhun pora sarot tak, notun bahor gaj pahar te thaka homoi te.

recipes.name: Jain Mustard Leaf Fry
recipes.sub: Mustard leaves cooked dry with asafoetida and dry ginger
recipes.sub_l: Sorisa pata ke hing aru sukha ada logote sukha randha

method.en: No water at all. Twelve kilos of pata gives up two litres in the first four minutes and that is all the kadai needs.
method.l: Pani eku nai. Baro kilo pata pora poila sari minute te dui litre ulai aru kadai ke titan he lage.

method.en: Dry ginger and not fresh, and ninety grams is the measure. Any more and a Jain plate tastes of medicine.
method.l: Sukha ada, notun nohoi; aru nobbei gram he maap. Tatu bisi dile Jain thali to dawai nisina lage.

method.en: Cut the stalk in and do not throw it. The stalk is a third of the weight and it goes in eight minutes before the leaf.
method.l: Dala to kati kene hala dibi, phelai nadibi. Dala to gathi laga tin bhag ekta aru pata laga ath minute age te hala.

method.en: Eight minutes on the leaf and no more. Pata cooked twenty minutes is the colour of a wet road and sixteen kilos of it comes back.
method.l: Pata upor te ath minute mattro, tatu bisi nai. Bis minute randhise pata to bhija rasta rong hoi aru solo kilo wapas ahe.

recipes.why: Ten rupees ninety a head. In thanda din the pata is fifteen rupees a kilo at Kohima bazar and there is no root and no fresh ginger anywhere in it.
recipes.why_l: Ek manu te dosh taka nobbei. Thanda din te Kohima bazar te sorisa pata to kilo te pandhra taka, aru tar bhitorte mati laga saman aru notun ada kotina bi nai.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Forty minutes, in two batches.
start.l: Kunu saman bhijai rakha nalage. Chalis minute, duibar kori.

vessel.en: A wide 30 L kadai, uncovered. One cook.
vessel.l: Chaura tirish litre kadai, dhaki nadi kene. Ekjon randhoni.

season.en: Sarot to gorom din, while the pata is in the market.
season.l: Sarot pora gorom din tak, pata bazar te thaka homoi te.

recipes.name: Jain Tomato Jhol
recipes.sub: Tomato cooked thin with roasted rice flour and dry ginger
recipes.sub_l: Bilahi ke bhaja chaul gura aru sukha ada logote polka randha

method.en: Roast the bilahi on the flame and peel it. The skin in a jhol rolls up into strings and every devotee finds one.
method.l: Bilahi to jui upor te puri kene chal sarabi. Jhol te chal to sutli nisina gutai jai aru bhokot sob pora ekta pai.

method.en: Dry ginger and not fresh, a hundred grams in twenty-six litres. It is four times the strength of the fresh root.
method.l: Sukha ada, notun nohoi; chabbis litre te ek sou gram. Eitu notun ada pora sari gun tez.

method.en: Mix the rice flour to a slurry in cold water before it goes in. Thrown in dry, four hundred grams becomes forty lumps.
method.l: Hala nadi kene chaul gura to thanda pani te gola kori lobi. Sukha thaka homoi te hala dile sari sou gram pora chalis dola hoi.

method.en: Keep it thin. A bilahi jhol is drunk off the plate at the end of the meal and a thick one is a chutney in the wrong vessel.
method.l: Polka rakhibi. Bilahi jhol to khana laga hekh te thali pora khai aru gadha hoile bhul bela te thaka chutney he.

recipes.why: Nine rupees ninety a head. Tomato is at Dimapur bazar every month of the year and there is no root and no fresh ginger anywhere in it, so a Jain guest is not given a separate plate.
recipes.why_l: Ek manu te no taka nobbei. Bochor laga mah sob te Dimapur bazar te bilahi thake, aru tar bhitorte mati laga saman aru notun ada kotina bi nai; karone Jain manu ke alag thali nadiye.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Fifty minutes, most of it roasting and peeling.
start.l: Kunu saman bhijai rakha nalage. Pachas minute, tar bisi bhag to puri kene chal sarai.

vessel.en: An open flame for the roasting and a 35 L vessel. Two cooks.
vessel.l: Puribole khula jui aru paitirish litre bela. Duijon randhoni.

season.en: All year, and cheapest in sarot.
season.l: Pura bochor, aru sarot te sobse sosta.

recipes.name: Jain Cabbage Fry
recipes.sub: Cabbage and peas cooked dry with asafoetida and no root
recipes.sub_l: Bandha kobi aru motor ke hing logote sukha randha, mati laga saman eku nai

method.en: No water at any point. Twelve kilos of kobi gives up three litres in the first ten minutes and that is all it needs.
method.l: Kotina bi pani nai. Baro kilo kobi pora poila dosh minute te tin litre ulai aru titan he lage.

method.en: The peas go in with the fire off. Cooked twenty minutes they are grey and two kilos of grey peas is seen from the door.
method.l: Motor to jui bondh kori kene hala. Bis minute randhile dhusor hoi jai aru dui kilo dhusor motor to duar pora dekha pai.

method.en: Asafoetida in the tempering, sixty grams in eighteen kilos. In a Jain kadai it is the only thing standing where an onion would.
method.l: Phoron te hing, atharo kilo te sathi gram. Jain kadai te pyaj laga jagate thiya thaka saman to eitu mattro.

method.en: Take it off while a shred still snaps. A kobi cooked through is grey and eighteen kilos of grey cabbage comes back.
method.l: Ekta tukra phata thaka homoi te namai lobi. Puri randhise kobi to dhusor hoi aru dhusor bandha kobi atharo kilo wapas ahe.

recipes.why: Eleven rupees sixty a head. Bandha kobi keeps ten days in a Kohima store room where a green leaf keeps two, and there is no root anywhere in it.
recipes.why_l: Ek manu te egaro taka sathi. Hariyali pata dui din he thaka Kohima bhoral te bandha kobi to dosh din thake, aru tar bhitorte mati laga saman kotina bi nai.

start.en: Nothing soaks. Forty minutes, in two batches, uncovered.
start.l: Kunu saman bhijai rakha nalage. Chalis minute, duibar kori, dhaki nadi kene.

vessel.en: A wide 30 L kadai, uncovered. One cook.
vessel.l: Chaura tirish litre kadai, dhaki nadi kene. Ekjon randhoni.

season.en: Sarot to gorom din, while the kobi is in the market.
season.l: Sarot pora gorom din tak, kobi bazar te thaka homoi te.

recipes.name: Jain Paneer Jhol
recipes.sub: Paneer in a tomato and cashew gravy with dry ginger
recipes.sub_l: Paneer ke bilahi aru kaju laga jhol te, sukha ada logote

method.en: Soak the kaju an hour and grind it with the tomato. In a Jain gravy the cashew does the work of both an onion and a garlic and there is no cheaper honest way.
method.l: Kaju to ek ghanta bhijai kene bilahi logote pisi lobi. Jain jhol te kaju pora pyaj aru naharu duita laga kaam kore aru eitu pora sosta thaka dusra sidha rasta nai.

method.en: Cook the tomato paste twenty-five minutes before the ghee goes in. Under-cooked tomato is sour and no chini can be added to a Jain vessel to hide it.
method.l: Ghee hala nadi kene bilahi laga dola to pochish minute randhibi. Kom randhise bilahi to tenga hoi aru eitu dhakibole Jain bela te chini dibole napare.

method.en: Dry ginger and not fresh, a hundred grams in twenty-six litres. It is four times the strength of the fresh root.
method.l: Sukha ada, notun nohoi; chabbis litre te ek sou gram. Eitu notun ada pora sari gun tez.

method.en: The paneer goes in four minutes before serving and no earlier. Five kilos boiled in gravy is five kilos of rubber at the counter.
method.l: Dibole laga sari minute age te paneer hala, tatu age nohoi. Jhol te ukhalise pas kilo to dibole laga jagate pas kilo rubber hoi.

recipes.why: Thirty-six rupees fifty a head. It is the dish that lets a Jain guest sit at a wedding plate and be given the same festival gravy as everybody else, with no root and no fresh ginger in it.
recipes.why_l: Ek manu te chattis taka pachas. Mati laga saman aru notun ada nadi kene, Jain manu ke biya laga thali te bohi kene dusra sob logote eke utsav laga jhol dibole para khana to eitu he.

start.en: Cashew soaks an hour. Two hours in all.
start.l: Kaju to ek ghanta bhijai. Sob milai dui ghanta.

vessel.en: A 35 L vessel, a grinder and a holding pot for the paneer. Two cooks.
vessel.l: Paitirish litre bela, pisibole chakki aru paneer rakhibole bela. Duijon randhoni.

season.en: At a wedding and at Hornbill.
season.l: Biya aru Hornbill te.
